v gold_bea.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column table_code text
    column table_title text
    column line_code text
    column description text
    column unit text
    column dollar_basis text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT (table_code || ':'::text) || line_code AS source_object_key,
    body     table_code,
    body     table_title,
    body     line_code,
    body     description,
    body     unit,
    body     dollar_basis,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     parser_contract_version AS schema_version
    body    FROM silver_bea.dim_line line;

v gold_bea.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'BEA'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     ((((line.description || ' ('::text) || line.table_code) || ', BEA '::text) || lower(line.unit)) || ')'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     line.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_bea', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'Bureau of Economic Analysis regional economic accounts'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-economic-accounts'::text AS source_type,
    body     line.methodology_url AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             latest.table_code,
    body             latest.line_code,
    body             max(latest.release_date)::text AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.retrieved_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(capture.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_bea.observation_latest latest
    body              JOIN control.bea_table_capture capture ON capture.capture_id = latest.capture_id
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key, latest.table_code, latest.line_code) served
    body      JOIN silver_bea.dim_line line ON line.table_code = served.table_code AND line.line_code = served.line_code
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_bea.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column table_code text
    column table_title text
    column line_code text
    column description text
    column unit text
    column dollar_basis text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column release_date date
    column release_key text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     table_code,
    body     table_title,
    body     line_code,
    body     description,
    body     unit,
    body     dollar_basis,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     release_date,
    body     release_key,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_bea.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, release_date DESC, retrieved_at DESC, capture_id DESC;

v gold_bea.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column table_code text
    column table_title text
    column line_code text
    column description text
    column unit text
    column dollar_basis text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column release_date date
    column release_key text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT (fact.table_code || ':'::text) || fact.line_code AS metric_key,
    body     fact.table_code,
    body     line.table_title,
    body     fact.line_code,
    body     line.description,
    body     line.unit,
    body     line.dollar_basis,
    body     line.observation_basis,
    body     fact.year,
    body     make_date(fact.year, 1, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date(fact.year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) AS geo_level,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.release_date,
    body     fact.release_date::text AS release_key,
    body     fact.retrieved_at,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id
    body    FROM silver_bea.fact_observation fact
    body      JOIN silver_bea.dim_line line ON line.table_code = fact.table_code AND line.line_code = fact.line_code
    body      JOIN control.bea_table_capture capture ON capture.capture_id = fact.capture_id
    body   WHERE capture.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text]));

v gold_bls.calendar_window_observation
    column metric_code text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column subject_code text
    column unit text
    column grain text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column derivation_kind text
    column method text
    column method_version integer
    column expected_periods integer
    column present_periods integer
    column refusal_reason text
    column component_releases text[]
    column as_of_date date
    body WITH served AS (
    body          SELECT DISTINCT ON (mv_bls_latest.series_id, mv_bls_latest.geo_id) mv_bls_latest.series_id,
    body             mv_bls_latest.geo_id,
    body             mv_bls_latest.geo_level,
    body             mv_bls_latest.units,
    body             mv_bls_latest.metric_code
    body            FROM gold_bls.mv_bls_latest
    body           ORDER BY mv_bls_latest.series_id, mv_bls_latest.geo_id, mv_bls_latest.observation_date DESC
    body         ), provider AS (
    body          SELECT served.metric_code,
    body             served.geo_id,
    body             served.geo_level,
    body             served.units,
    body             annual.period_start,
    body             annual.period_end,
    body             annual.value,
    body             annual.value_status,
    body             annual.ingested_at
    body            FROM gold_bls.provider_annual_average annual
    body              JOIN served ON served.series_id = annual.series_id::text AND served.geo_id = annual.geo_id::text
    body         )
    body  SELECT provider.metric_code,
    body     provider.geo_id,
    body     provider.geo_level,
    body     NULL::text AS subject_code,
    body     provider.units AS unit,
    body     'year'::text AS grain,
    body     provider.period_start,
    body     provider.period_end,
    body     provider.value,
    body     provider.value_status,
    body     'provider_published'::text AS derivation_kind,
    body     NULL::text AS method,
    body     NULL::integer AS method_version,
    body     NULL::integer AS expected_periods,
    body     NULL::integer AS present_periods,
    body     NULL::text AS refusal_reason,
    body     NULL::text[] AS component_releases,
    body     provider.ingested_at::date AS as_of_date
    body    FROM provider
    body UNION ALL
    body  SELECT derived.metric_code,
    body     derived.geo_id,
    body     derived.geo_level,
    body     derived.subject_code,
    body     derived.unit,
    body     derived.grain,
    body     derived.window_start AS period_start,
    body     derived.window_end AS period_end,
    body     derived.value,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN derived.value IS NULL THEN 'incomplete_window'::text
    body             ELSE 'valid'::text
    body         END AS value_status,
    body     'derived'::text AS derivation_kind,
    body     derived.method,
    body     derived.method_version,
    body     derived.expected_periods,
    body     derived.present_periods,
    body     derived.refusal_reason,
    body     derived.component_releases,
    body     derived.refreshed_at::date AS as_of_date
    body    FROM gold_bls.derived_calendar_rollup derived
    body   WHERE NOT (derived.grain = 'year'::text AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
    body            FROM provider
    body           WHERE provider.metric_code = derived.metric_code AND NOT provider.geo_id IS DISTINCT FROM derived.geo_id AND provider.period_start = derived.window_start)));

r gold_bls.derived_calendar_rollup
    column metric_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column subject_code text
    column unit text
    column grain text NOT NULL
    column window_start date NOT NULL
    column window_end date NOT NULL
    column method text NOT NULL
    column method_version integer NOT NULL
    column expected_periods integer NOT NULL
    column present_periods integer NOT NULL
    column value numeric
    column refusal_reason text
    column component_releases text[] NOT NULL
    column derived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
    column refreshed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint bls_rollup_value_or_reason CHECK ((((present_periods = expected_periods) AND (value IS NOT NULL) AND (refusal_reason IS NULL)) OR ((present_periods < expected_periods) AND (value IS NULL) AND (refusal_reason IS NOT NULL))))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_check CHECK ((window_end > window_start))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_check1 CHECK (((present_periods >= 0) AND (present_periods <= expected_periods)))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_derived_check CHECK (derived)
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_expected_periods_check CHECK ((expected_periods = ANY (ARRAY[3, 12])))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_grain_check CHECK ((grain = ANY (ARRAY['quarter'::text, 'year'::text])))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_method_check CHECK ((method = ANY (ARRAY['sum'::text, 'mean'::text])))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_method_version_check CHECK ((method_version >= 1))
    index uq_bls_derived_calendar_rollup CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_bls_derived_calendar_rollup ON gold_bls.derived_calendar_rollup USING btree (metric_code, COALESCE(geo_id, ''::text), COALESCE(subject_code, ''::text), grain, window_start)

r gold_bls.dim_bls_measure
    column bls_measure_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_bls.dim_bls_measure_bls_measure_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column program_code text NOT NULL
    column measure_code text NOT NULL
    column metric_key text NOT NULL
    column metric_display_name text NOT NULL
    column unit_of_measure text
    column value_type text NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_bls_measure_metric_key_key UNIQUE (metric_key)
    constraint dim_bls_measure_pkey PRIMARY KEY (bls_measure_sk)
    constraint dim_bls_measure_program_code_measure_code_key UNIQUE (program_code, measure_code)
    constraint dim_bls_measure_value_type_check CHECK ((value_type = ANY (ARRAY['LEVEL'::text, 'RATE'::text, 'INDEX'::text, 'PERCENT'::text, 'CURRENCY'::text, 'RATIO'::text, 'OTHER'::text])))
    index dim_bls_measure_metric_key_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_measure_metric_key_key ON gold_bls.dim_bls_measure USING btree (metric_key)
    index dim_bls_measure_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_measure_pkey ON gold_bls.dim_bls_measure USING btree (bls_measure_sk)
    index dim_bls_measure_program_code_measure_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_measure_program_code_measure_code_key ON gold_bls.dim_bls_measure USING btree (program_code, measure_code)

r gold_bls.dim_bls_series
    column bls_series_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_bls.dim_bls_series_bls_series_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column bls_survey_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column program_code text NOT NULL
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column series_title text
    column measure_name text
    column measure_category text NOT NULL
    column unit_of_measure text
    column value_type text NOT NULL
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column geographic_level text
    column gold_metric_name text
    column analytic_role text
    column semantic_notes text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_bls_series_bls_survey_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (bls_survey_sk) REFERENCES gold_bls.dim_bls_survey(bls_survey_sk)
    constraint dim_bls_series_measure_category_check CHECK ((measure_category = ANY (ARRAY['EMPLOYMENT'::text, 'UNEMPLOYMENT'::text, 'LABOR_FORCE'::text, 'PARTICIPATION'::text, 'POPULATION'::text, 'EARNINGS'::text, 'HOURS'::text, 'PRICE_INDEX'::text, 'AVERAGE_PRICE'::text, 'OPENINGS'::text, 'HIRES'::text, 'QUITS'::text, 'LAYOFFS'::text, 'SEPARATIONS'::text, 'OTHER'::text])))
    constraint dim_bls_series_pkey PRIMARY KEY (bls_series_sk)
    constraint dim_bls_series_series_id_key UNIQUE (series_id)
    constraint dim_bls_series_value_type_check CHECK ((value_type = ANY (ARRAY['LEVEL'::text, 'RATE'::text, 'INDEX'::text, 'PERCENT'::text, 'CURRENCY'::text, 'RATIO'::text, 'OTHER'::text])))
    index dim_bls_series_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_series_pkey ON gold_bls.dim_bls_series USING btree (bls_series_sk)
    index dim_bls_series_series_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_series_series_id_key ON gold_bls.dim_bls_series USING btree (series_id)

r gold_bls.dim_bls_survey
    column bls_survey_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_bls.dim_bls_survey_bls_survey_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column program_code text NOT NULL
    column survey_name text NOT NULL
    column survey_universe text
    column observation_basis text NOT NULL
    column primary_concept text
    column id_construction_type text
    column comparison_warning text
    column reference_url text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_bls_survey_observation_basis_check CHECK ((observation_basis = ANY (ARRAY['PEOPLE'::text, 'JOBS'::text, 'PRICES'::text, 'FLOWS'::text])))
    constraint dim_bls_survey_pkey PRIMARY KEY (bls_survey_sk)
    constraint dim_bls_survey_program_code_key UNIQUE (program_code)
    index dim_bls_survey_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_survey_pkey ON gold_bls.dim_bls_survey USING btree (bls_survey_sk)
    index dim_bls_survey_program_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_bls_survey_program_code_key ON gold_bls.dim_bls_survey USING btree (program_code)

v gold_bls.fact_bls_observation
    column geo_id character varying(255)
    column geo_level text
    column time_sk integer
    column period_date date
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column bls_survey_sk bigint
    column bls_series_sk bigint
    column program_code text
    column value numeric
    column period_code character varying(10)
    column seasonal_adjustment_status character varying(1)
    column observation_basis text
    column measure_category text
    column value_type text
    column as_of_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column measure_code character varying(10)
    column value_status text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT s.geo_id,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM s.geo_level), ''::text) <> ''::text THEN gold_glossary.geo_grain(s.geo_level::text)
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text = 'us:1'::text THEN 'NATIONAL'::text
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text ~~ 'state:%|county:%'::text THEN 'COUNTY'::text
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text ~~ 'state:%'::text THEN 'STATE'::text
    body             ELSE 'NATIONAL'::text
    body         END AS geo_level,
    body     s.time_sk,
    body     s.period_date,
    body     s.duration_start,
    body     s.duration_end,
    body     sr.bls_survey_sk,
    body     sr.bls_series_sk,
    body     upper(s.program::text) AS program_code,
    body     s.value,
    body     s.period AS period_code,
    body     s.seasonal_adjustment AS seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     sv.observation_basis,
    body     sr.measure_category,
    body     sr.value_type,
    body     s.ingested_at::date AS as_of_date,
    body     s.ingested_at AS updated_at,
    body     s.measure_code,
    body     s.value_status,
    body     s.source_value,
    body     s.capture_id
    body    FROM silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics s
    body      JOIN gold_bls.dim_bls_series sr ON sr.series_id = s.series_id::text
    body      JOIN gold_bls.dim_bls_survey sv ON sv.bls_survey_sk = sr.bls_survey_sk
    body   WHERE s.series_id IS NOT NULL AND s.series_id::text <> ''::text AND s.period::text <> 'M13'::text;

v gold_bls.fact_observation
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     program_code AS dataset_code,
    body     program_code AS dataset,
    body     NULL::integer AS vintage_year,
    body     NULL::text AS vintage,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations;

v gold_bls.measure_export
    column bls_measure_sk bigint
    column program_code text
    column source_object_key text
    column metric_display_name text
    column unit_of_measure text
    column value_type text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    body SELECT measure.bls_measure_sk,
    body     measure.program_code,
    body     measure.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     measure.metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit_of_measure,
    body     measure.value_type,
    body     COALESCE(served.valid_geo_grains, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body     COALESCE(served.publication_time, max(fact.updated_at)) AS publication_time
    body    FROM gold_bls.dim_bls_measure measure
    body      JOIN gold_bls.fact_bls_observation fact ON fact.program_code = measure.program_code AND fact.measure_code::text = measure.measure_code
    body      LEFT JOIN ( SELECT latest.metric_code,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             max(latest.updated_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_bls.mv_bls_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_code) served ON served.metric_code = ('BLS:'::text || measure.metric_key)
    body   GROUP BY measure.bls_measure_sk, served.valid_geo_grains, served.publication_time;

v gold_bls.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'BLS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     series.series_id AS source_object_key,
    body     'series'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     COALESCE(NULLIF(series.series_title, ''::text), series.series_id) AS metric_display_name,
    body     series.unit_of_measure AS units,
    body     series.value_type AS measure_kind,
    body     COALESCE(served.valid_geo_grains, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['MONTHLY'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_bls', 'relation', 'fact_bls_observation', 'key', series.series_id) AS physical_lineage,
    body     COALESCE(served.publication_time, series.updated_at)::text AS source_watermark,
    body     NULL::uuid AS source_run_id,
    body     COALESCE(served.publication_time, series.updated_at) AS publication_time,
    body     'U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics'::text AS source_name,
    body     'official-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     survey.reference_url
    body    FROM gold_bls.dim_bls_series series
    body      JOIN gold_bls.dim_bls_survey survey USING (bls_survey_sk)
    body      LEFT JOIN ( SELECT latest.series_id,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             max(latest.updated_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_bls.mv_bls_latest latest
    body           WHERE latest.metric_code = ('BLS:'::text || latest.series_id)
    body           GROUP BY latest.series_id) served ON served.series_id = series.series_id
    body   WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
    body            FROM gold_bls.fact_bls_observation fact
    body              JOIN gold_bls.dim_bls_measure measure ON measure.program_code = fact.program_code AND measure.measure_code = fact.measure_code::text
    body           WHERE fact.bls_series_sk = series.bls_series_sk)) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
    body            FROM gold_bls.fact_bls_observation fact
    body           WHERE fact.bls_series_sk = series.bls_series_sk)) OR NOT (series.program_code IN ( SELECT DISTINCT dim_bls_measure.program_code
    body            FROM gold_bls.dim_bls_measure)))
    body   GROUP BY series.bls_series_sk, survey.bls_survey_sk, served.valid_geo_grains, served.publication_time
    body UNION ALL
    body  SELECT 'BLS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     export.source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit_of_measure AS units,
    body     export.value_type AS measure_kind,
    body     export.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['MONTHLY'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_bls', 'relation', 'fact_bls_observation', 'key', export.source_object_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     export.publication_time::text AS source_watermark,
    body     NULL::uuid AS source_run_id,
    body     export.publication_time,
    body     'U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics'::text AS source_name,
    body     'official-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     survey.reference_url
    body    FROM gold_bls.measure_export export
    body      JOIN gold_bls.dim_bls_survey survey ON survey.program_code = export.program_code;

r gold_bls.mv_bls_latest
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BLS'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_level text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column program_code text NOT NULL
    column survey_name text
    column series_title text
    column measure_name text
    column measure_category text
    column observation_basis text
    column units text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    column value_type text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column gold_metric_name text
    column comparison_warning text
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    index ix_mv_bls_latest_metric_geo CREATE INDEX ix_mv_bls_latest_metric_geo ON gold_bls.mv_bls_latest USING btree (metric_code, geo_id)
    index ix_mv_bls_latest_observation_date CREATE INDEX ix_mv_bls_latest_observation_date ON gold_bls.mv_bls_latest USING btree (observation_date)
    index ix_mv_bls_latest_source_metric CREATE INDEX ix_mv_bls_latest_source_metric ON gold_bls.mv_bls_latest USING btree (source_code, metric_code)
    index uq_mv_bls_latest CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_bls_latest ON gold_bls.mv_bls_latest USING btree (geo_id, series_id, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text))

v gold_bls.provider_annual_average
    column series_id character varying(255)
    column program_code text
    column geo_id character varying(255)
    column geo_sk bigint
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column source_value text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status character varying(1)
    column capture_id uuid
    column ingested_at timestamp with time zone
    column time_sk integer
    body SELECT series_id,
    body     upper(program::text) AS program_code,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     year,
    body     duration_start AS period_start,
    body     duration_end AS period_end,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     source_value,
    body     seasonal_adjustment AS seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     capture_id,
    body     ingested_at,
    body     time_sk
    body    FROM silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics s
    body   WHERE period::text = 'M13'::text AND series_id IS NOT NULL AND series_id::text <> ''::text;

r gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BLS'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_level text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column program_code text NOT NULL
    column survey_name text
    column series_title text
    column measure_name text
    column measure_category text
    column observation_basis text
    column units text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    column value_type text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column gold_metric_name text
    column comparison_warning text
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    constraint rpt_bls_observations_published_value_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint rpt_bls_observations_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'invalid'::text])))
    index ix_rpt_bls_latest_selection CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_latest_selection ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (geo_id, series_id, metric_code, observation_date DESC, updated_at DESC)
    index ix_rpt_bls_observations_metric_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_observations_metric_date ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (metric_code, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_bls_observations_metric_geo_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_observations_metric_geo_date ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (metric_code, geo_id, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_bls_observations_obs_brin CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_observations_obs_brin ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING brin (observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_bls_observations_source_geo_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_observations_source_geo_date ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (source_code, geo_id, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_bls_observations_updated_at CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_bls_observations_updated_at ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (updated_at DESC)
    index uq_rpt_bls_observations_nk CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rpt_bls_observations_nk ON gold_bls.rpt_bls_observations USING btree (geo_id, observation_date, series_id, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text))

v gold_bls.v_metric_latest_by_geo
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     program_code AS dataset_code,
    body     program_code AS dataset,
    body     NULL::integer AS vintage_year,
    body     NULL::text AS vintage,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_bls.mv_bls_latest;

v gold_bls_qcew.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column period_kind text
    column observation_basis text
    column industry_code text
    column industry_title text
    column own_code text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT (((measure.measure_id || ':'::text) || industry.industry_code) || ':'::text) || ownership.own_code AS source_object_key,
    body     measure.measure_id,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.period_kind,
    body     measure.observation_basis,
    body     industry.industry_code,
    body     industry.industry_title,
    body     ownership.own_code,
    body     measure.parser_contract_version AS schema_version
    body    FROM silver_bls_qcew.dim_measure measure
    body      CROSS JOIN silver_bls_qcew.dim_industry industry
    body      CROSS JOIN ( VALUES ('0'::text), ('5'::text)) ownership(own_code)
    body   WHERE ownership.own_code = '5'::text OR industry.industry_level = 'total'::text;

v gold_bls_qcew.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'BLS_QCEW'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     ((((measure.measure_label || ', '::text) || industry.industry_title) || ', '::text) ||
    body         CASE served.own_code
    body             WHEN '0'::text THEN 'total covered'::text
    body             ELSE 'private'::text
    body         END) || ' (jobs located here)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY[upper(
    body         CASE measure.period_kind
    body             WHEN 'month'::text THEN 'monthly'::text
    body             WHEN 'quarter'::text THEN 'quarterly'::text
    body             ELSE 'annual'::text
    body         END)] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_bls_qcew', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'Bureau of Labor Statistics Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-establishment-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     measure.methodology_url AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             latest.measure_id,
    body             latest.industry_code,
    body             latest.own_code,
    body             max(to_char(latest.period_end::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text)) AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.retrieved_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(slice.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_bls_qcew.observation_latest latest
    body              JOIN control.bls_qcew_slice slice ON slice.capture_id = latest.capture_id
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key, latest.measure_id, latest.industry_code, latest.own_code) served
    body      JOIN silver_bls_qcew.dim_measure measure ON measure.measure_id = served.measure_id
    body      JOIN silver_bls_qcew.dim_industry industry ON industry.industry_code = served.industry_code
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_bls_qcew.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column period_kind text
    column observation_basis text
    column industry_code text
    column industry_title text
    column industry_level text
    column own_code text
    column ownership_title text
    column year integer
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column disclosure_code text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, period_start) metric_key,
    body     measure_id,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     period_kind,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     industry_code,
    body     industry_title,
    body     industry_level,
    body     own_code,
    body     ownership_title,
    body     year,
    body     period,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     disclosure_code,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     release_key,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_bls_qcew.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, period_start, retrieved_at DESC, capture_id DESC;

v gold_bls_qcew.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column period_kind text
    column observation_basis text
    column industry_code text
    column industry_title text
    column industry_level text
    column own_code text
    column ownership_title text
    column year integer
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column disclosure_code text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT (((fact.measure_id || ':'::text) || fact.industry_code) || ':'::text) || fact.own_code AS metric_key,
    body     fact.measure_id,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.period_kind,
    body     measure.observation_basis,
    body     fact.industry_code,
    body     industry.industry_title,
    body     industry.industry_level,
    body     fact.own_code,
    body         CASE fact.own_code
    body             WHEN '0'::text THEN 'Total covered'::text
    body             WHEN '5'::text THEN 'Private'::text
    body             ELSE NULL::text
    body         END AS ownership_title,
    body     fact.year,
    body     fact.period,
    body     fact.period_start,
    body     fact.period_end,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) AS geo_level,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.disclosure_code,
    body     fact.retrieved_at,
    body     to_char((fact.retrieved_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'::text) AS release_key,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id
    body    FROM silver_bls_qcew.fact_observation fact
    body      JOIN silver_bls_qcew.dim_measure measure ON measure.measure_id = fact.measure_id
    body      JOIN silver_bls_qcew.dim_industry industry ON industry.industry_code = fact.industry_code
    body      JOIN control.bls_qcew_slice slice ON slice.capture_id = fact.capture_id
    body   WHERE slice.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text]));

v gold_cdc.health_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column asset_id text
    column dataset_title text
    column release_watermark text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_label text
    column topic text
    column value_type_id text
    column value_type_label text
    column period_start integer
    column period_end integer
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column unit text
    column adjustment_status text
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column footnote_code text
    column footnote_text text
    column stratum_id text
    column strata jsonb
    column estimate_method text
    column population_basis text
    column total_population numeric
    column population_18_plus numeric
    column methodology_url text
    column geography_basis text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT fact.observation_sk,
    body     fact.asset_id,
    body     release.title AS dataset_title,
    body     fact.release_watermark,
    body     fact.measure_id,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.topic,
    body     fact.value_type_id,
    body     measure.value_type_label,
    body     fact.period_start,
    body     fact.period_end,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.unit,
    body     fact.adjustment_status,
    body     fact.confidence_lower,
    body     fact.confidence_upper,
    body     fact.footnote_code,
    body     fact.footnote_text,
    body     fact.stratum_id,
    body     stratum.strata,
    body     fact.estimate_method,
    body     fact.population_basis,
    body     fact.total_population,
    body     fact.population_18_plus,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.geography_basis,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id
    body    FROM silver_cdc.fact_health_observation fact
    body      JOIN silver_cdc.dim_dataset_release release ON release.asset_id = fact.asset_id AND release.release_watermark = fact.release_watermark
    body      JOIN silver_cdc.dim_measure measure ON measure.asset_id = fact.asset_id AND measure.measure_id = fact.measure_id AND measure.value_type_id = fact.value_type_id
    body      JOIN silver_cdc.dim_stratum stratum USING (stratum_id)
    body   WHERE release.status = 'published'::text AND fact.geography_status <> 'unsupported'::text;

v gold_cdc.latest_release_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column asset_id text
    column dataset_title text
    column release_watermark text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_label text
    column topic text
    column value_type_id text
    column value_type_label text
    column period_start integer
    column period_end integer
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column unit text
    column adjustment_status text
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column footnote_code text
    column footnote_text text
    column stratum_id text
    column strata jsonb
    column estimate_method text
    column population_basis text
    column total_population numeric
    column population_18_plus numeric
    column methodology_url text
    column geography_basis text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT observation.observation_sk,
    body     observation.asset_id,
    body     observation.dataset_title,
    body     observation.release_watermark,
    body     observation.measure_id,
    body     observation.measure_label,
    body     observation.topic,
    body     observation.value_type_id,
    body     observation.value_type_label,
    body     observation.period_start,
    body     observation.period_end,
    body     observation.geo_id,
    body     observation.geo_sk,
    body     observation.geo_type,
    body     observation.geography_status,
    body     observation.value_source,
    body     observation.value,
    body     observation.value_status,
    body     observation.unit,
    body     observation.adjustment_status,
    body     observation.confidence_lower,
    body     observation.confidence_upper,
    body     observation.footnote_code,
    body     observation.footnote_text,
    body     observation.stratum_id,
    body     observation.strata,
    body     observation.estimate_method,
    body     observation.population_basis,
    body     observation.total_population,
    body     observation.population_18_plus,
    body     observation.methodology_url,
    body     observation.geography_basis,
    body     observation.source_record_id,
    body     observation.capture_id
    body    FROM gold_cdc.health_observation observation
    body      JOIN ( SELECT dim_dataset_release.asset_id,
    body             max(dim_dataset_release.release_watermark::bigint) AS release_watermark
    body            FROM silver_cdc.dim_dataset_release
    body           WHERE dim_dataset_release.status = 'published'::text
    body           GROUP BY dim_dataset_release.asset_id) latest ON latest.asset_id = observation.asset_id AND latest.release_watermark::text = observation.release_watermark;

v gold_cdc.measure_export
    column source_dataset text
    column source_measure_code text
    column source_value_type_code text
    column display_name text
    column topic text
    column value_type_label text
    column unit text
    column adjustment_status text
    column estimate_method text
    column population_basis text
    column source_watermark text
    column methodology_url text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure.asset_id AS source_dataset,
    body     measure.measure_id AS source_measure_code,
    body     measure.value_type_id AS source_value_type_code,
    body     measure.measure_label AS display_name,
    body     measure.topic,
    body     measure.value_type_label,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.adjustment_status,
    body     measure.estimate_method,
    body     measure.population_basis,
    body     release.release_watermark AS source_watermark,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.parser_contract_version AS schema_version
    body    FROM silver_cdc.dim_measure measure
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.asset_id,
    body             candidate.release_watermark,
    body             candidate.socrata_id,
    body             candidate.title,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.geography_basis,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.estimate_method,
    body             candidate.population_basis,
    body             candidate.metadata_capture_id,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_cdc.dim_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.asset_id = measure.asset_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY (candidate.release_watermark::bigint) DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

v gold_cdc.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'CDC'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     (((measure.asset_id || ':'::text) || measure.measure_id) || ':'::text) || measure.value_type_id AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     measure.measure_label AS metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     measure.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_cdc', 'relation', 'health_observation', 'asset_id', measure.asset_id, 'measure_id', measure.measure_id, 'value_type_id', measure.value_type_id) AS physical_lineage,
    body     release.release_watermark AS source_watermark,
    body     release.source_run_id,
    body     release.published_at AS publication_time,
    body     'Centers for Disease Control and Prevention'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-public-health'::text AS source_type,
    body     release.methodology_url AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT measure_1.asset_id,
    body             measure_1.measure_id,
    body             measure_1.value_type_id,
    body             measure_1.measure_label,
    body             measure_1.unit,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE fact.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains
    body            FROM silver_cdc.dim_measure measure_1
    body              JOIN silver_cdc.fact_health_observation fact ON fact.asset_id = measure_1.asset_id AND fact.measure_id = measure_1.measure_id AND fact.value_type_id = measure_1.value_type_id
    body              JOIN silver_cdc.dim_dataset_release release_1 ON release_1.asset_id = fact.asset_id AND release_1.release_watermark = fact.release_watermark
    body           WHERE release_1.status = 'published'::text AND fact.geography_status <> 'unsupported'::text
    body           GROUP BY measure_1.asset_id, measure_1.measure_id, measure_1.value_type_id, measure_1.measure_label, measure_1.unit) measure
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.asset_id,
    body             candidate.release_watermark,
    body             candidate.socrata_id,
    body             candidate.title,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.geography_basis,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.estimate_method,
    body             candidate.population_basis,
    body             candidate.metadata_capture_id,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_cdc.dim_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.asset_id = measure.asset_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY (candidate.release_watermark::bigint) DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

r gold_census.dim_acs_table
    column acs_table_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_census.dim_acs_table_acs_table_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column vintage_year integer NOT NULL
    column table_id text NOT NULL
    column table_title text
    column concept text
    column universe text
    column survey_span_years integer NOT NULL
    column reference_url text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_acs_table_dataset_code_check CHECK ((dataset_code = ANY (ARRAY['acs1'::text, 'acs5'::text])))
    constraint dim_acs_table_dataset_code_vintage_year_table_id_key UNIQUE (dataset_code, vintage_year, table_id)
    constraint dim_acs_table_pkey PRIMARY KEY (acs_table_sk)
    constraint dim_acs_table_survey_span_years_check CHECK ((survey_span_years = ANY (ARRAY[1, 5])))
    index dim_acs_table_dataset_code_vintage_year_table_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_acs_table_dataset_code_vintage_year_table_id_key ON gold_census.dim_acs_table USING btree (dataset_code, vintage_year, table_id)
    index dim_acs_table_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_acs_table_pkey ON gold_census.dim_acs_table USING btree (acs_table_sk)

r gold_census.dim_acs_variable
    column acs_variable_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_census.dim_acs_variable_acs_variable_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column acs_table_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column vintage_year integer NOT NULL
    column variable_code text NOT NULL
    column variable_label text
    column concept text
    column universe text
    column value_role text NOT NULL
    column denominator_hint text
    column is_publishable_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_acs_variable_acs_table_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (acs_table_sk) REFERENCES gold_census.dim_acs_table(acs_table_sk)
    constraint dim_acs_variable_dataset_code_check CHECK ((dataset_code = ANY (ARRAY['acs1'::text, 'acs5'::text])))
    constraint dim_acs_variable_dataset_code_vintage_year_variable_code_key UNIQUE (dataset_code, vintage_year, variable_code)
    constraint dim_acs_variable_pkey PRIMARY KEY (acs_variable_sk)
    constraint dim_acs_variable_value_role_check CHECK ((value_role = ANY (ARRAY['ESTIMATE'::text, 'MOE'::text, 'ANNOTATION'::text])))
    index dim_acs_variable_dataset_code_vintage_year_variable_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_acs_variable_dataset_code_vintage_year_variable_code_key ON gold_census.dim_acs_variable USING btree (dataset_code, vintage_year, variable_code)
    index dim_acs_variable_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_acs_variable_pkey ON gold_census.dim_acs_variable USING btree (acs_variable_sk)

v gold_census.fact_acs_observation
    column geo_id character varying(255)
    column geo_level text
    column time_sk integer
    column observation_date date
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column acs_table_sk bigint
    column acs_variable_sk bigint
    column dataset_code character varying(50)
    column vintage_year integer
    column estimate_value numeric
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    column estimate_annotation text
    column moe_annotation text
    column as_of_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column value_status text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT s.geo_id,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH FROM s.geo_level), ''::text) <> ''::text THEN gold_glossary.geo_grain(s.geo_level::text)
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text = 'us:1'::text THEN 'NATIONAL'::text
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text ~~ 'state:%|county:%'::text THEN 'COUNTY'::text
    body             WHEN s.geo_id::text ~~ 'state:%'::text THEN 'STATE'::text
    body             ELSE 'NATIONAL'::text
    body         END AS geo_level,
    body     s.time_sk,
    body     make_date(s.estimate_year, 1, 1) AS observation_date,
    body     s.duration_start,
    body     s.duration_end,
    body     av.acs_table_sk,
    body     av.acs_variable_sk,
    body     s.dataset AS dataset_code,
    body     s.estimate_year AS vintage_year,
    body     s.estimate_value,
    body     s.margin_of_error,
    body     s.margin_of_error_pct,
    body     NULL::text AS estimate_annotation,
    body     NULL::text AS moe_annotation,
    body     s.ingested_at::date AS as_of_date,
    body     s.ingested_at AS updated_at,
    body     s.value_status,
    body     s.source_value,
    body     s.capture_id
    body    FROM silver_census.fact_demographics s
    body      JOIN gold_census.dim_acs_variable av ON av.dataset_code = s.dataset::text AND av.vintage_year = s.estimate_year AND av.variable_code = s.variable_code::text
    body   WHERE s.variable_code IS NOT NULL AND s.variable_code::text <> ''::text;

v gold_census.fact_observation
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     NULL::text AS seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     dataset_code AS dataset,
    body     vintage_year,
    body     vintage_year::text AS vintage,
    body     margin_of_error,
    body     margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_census.rpt_acs_observations;

v gold_census.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (variable.dataset_code, variable.variable_code) 'CENSUS_ACS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     (variable.dataset_code || ':'::text) || variable.variable_code AS source_object_key,
    body     'variable'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     COALESCE(NULLIF(variable.variable_label, ''::text), variable.variable_code) AS metric_display_name,
    body     NULL::text AS units,
    body     variable.value_role AS measure_kind,
    body     COALESCE(served.valid_geo_grains, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_census', 'relation', 'fact_acs_observation', 'key', (variable.dataset_code || ':'::text) || variable.variable_code) AS physical_lineage,
    body     variable.updated_at::text AS source_watermark,
    body     NULL::uuid AS source_run_id,
    body     variable.updated_at AS publication_time,
    body     'U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey'::text AS source_name,
    body     'official-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     table_definition.reference_url
    body    FROM gold_census.dim_acs_variable variable
    body      JOIN gold_census.dim_acs_table table_definition USING (acs_table_sk)
    body      LEFT JOIN ( SELECT latest.metric_code,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains
    body            FROM gold_census.mv_acs_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_code) served ON served.metric_code = ((('CENSUS_ACS:'::text || variable.dataset_code) || ':'::text) || variable.variable_code)
    body   ORDER BY variable.dataset_code, variable.variable_code, variable.vintage_year DESC, variable.updated_at DESC;

r gold_census.mv_acs_latest
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CENSUS_ACS'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_level text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column value numeric
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column vintage_year integer NOT NULL
    column table_id text NOT NULL
    column table_title text
    column variable_code text NOT NULL
    column variable_label text
    column concept text
    column universe text
    column denominator_hint text
    column is_publishable_default boolean
    column estimate_value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    column estimate_annotation text
    column moe_annotation text
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    index ix_mv_acs_latest_metric_geo CREATE INDEX ix_mv_acs_latest_metric_geo ON gold_census.mv_acs_latest USING btree (metric_code, geo_id)
    index ix_mv_acs_latest_source_metric CREATE INDEX ix_mv_acs_latest_source_metric ON gold_census.mv_acs_latest USING btree (source_code, metric_code)
    index ix_mv_acs_latest_vintage CREATE INDEX ix_mv_acs_latest_vintage ON gold_census.mv_acs_latest USING btree (dataset_code, vintage_year)
    index uq_mv_acs_latest CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_acs_latest ON gold_census.mv_acs_latest USING btree (geo_id, dataset_code, vintage_year, variable_code, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text))

p gold_census.rpt_acs_observations
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CENSUS_ACS'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_level text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column value numeric
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column vintage_year integer NOT NULL
    column table_id text NOT NULL
    column table_title text
    column variable_code text NOT NULL
    column variable_label text
    column concept text
    column universe text
    column denominator_hint text
    column is_publishable_default boolean
    column estimate_value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column source_value text
    column capture_id uuid
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    column estimate_annotation text
    column moe_annotation text
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    constraint rpt_acs_observations_dataset_code_check CHECK ((dataset_code = ANY (ARRAY['acs1'::text, 'acs5'::text])))
    constraint rpt_acs_observations_published_value_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (estimate_value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint rpt_acs_observations_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'absent'::text, 'blank'::text, 'sentinel'::text, 'invalid'::text])))
    index ix_rpt_acs_latest_selection CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_latest_selection ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (geo_id, variable_code, metric_code, observation_date DESC, updated_at DESC, (
CASE dataset_code
    WHEN 'acs1'::text THEN 1
    WHEN 'acs5'::text THEN 2
    ELSE 9
END), vintage_year DESC)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_dataset_vintage CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_dataset_vintage ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (dataset_code, vintage_year)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_date ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (metric_code, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_geo_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_geo_date ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (metric_code, geo_id, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_vintage CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_metric_vintage ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (metric_code, vintage_year, as_of_date)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_source_geo_date CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_source_geo_date ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (source_code, geo_id, observation_date)
    index ix_rpt_acs_observations_updated_at CREATE INDEX ix_rpt_acs_observations_updated_at ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (updated_at DESC)
    index uq_rpt_acs_observations_nk CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_rpt_acs_observations_nk ON ONLY gold_census.rpt_acs_observations USING btree (geo_id, observation_date, dataset_code, vintage_year, variable_code, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text))
    partitioned by RANGE (observation_date)
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2000 FOR VALUES FROM ('2000-01-01') TO ('2001-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2001 FOR VALUES FROM ('2001-01-01') TO ('2002-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2002 FOR VALUES FROM ('2002-01-01') TO ('2003-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2003 FOR VALUES FROM ('2003-01-01') TO ('2004-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2004 FOR VALUES FROM ('2004-01-01') TO ('2005-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2005 FOR VALUES FROM ('2005-01-01') TO ('2006-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2006 FOR VALUES FROM ('2006-01-01') TO ('2007-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2007 FOR VALUES FROM ('2007-01-01') TO ('2008-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2008 FOR VALUES FROM ('2008-01-01') TO ('2009-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2009 FOR VALUES FROM ('2009-01-01') TO ('2010-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2010 FOR VALUES FROM ('2010-01-01') TO ('2011-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2011 FOR VALUES FROM ('2011-01-01') TO ('2012-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2012 FOR VALUES FROM ('2012-01-01') TO ('2013-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2013 FOR VALUES FROM ('2013-01-01') TO ('2014-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2014 FOR VALUES FROM ('2014-01-01') TO ('2015-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2015 FOR VALUES FROM ('2015-01-01') TO ('2016-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2016 FOR VALUES FROM ('2016-01-01') TO ('2017-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2017 FOR VALUES FROM ('2017-01-01') TO ('2018-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2018 FOR VALUES FROM ('2018-01-01') TO ('2019-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2019 FOR VALUES FROM ('2019-01-01') TO ('2020-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2020 FOR VALUES FROM ('2020-01-01') TO ('2021-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2021 FOR VALUES FROM ('2021-01-01') TO ('2022-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2022 FOR VALUES FROM ('2022-01-01') TO ('2023-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2023 FOR VALUES FROM ('2023-01-01') TO ('2024-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2024 FOR VALUES FROM ('2024-01-01') TO ('2025-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2025 FOR VALUES FROM ('2025-01-01') TO ('2026-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2026 FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-01-01') TO ('2027-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2027 FOR VALUES FROM ('2027-01-01') TO ('2028-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2028 FOR VALUES FROM ('2028-01-01') TO ('2029-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2029 FOR VALUES FROM ('2029-01-01') TO ('2030-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2030 FOR VALUES FROM ('2030-01-01') TO ('2031-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2031 FOR VALUES FROM ('2031-01-01') TO ('2032-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2032 FOR VALUES FROM ('2032-01-01') TO ('2033-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2033 FOR VALUES FROM ('2033-01-01') TO ('2034-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2034 FOR VALUES FROM ('2034-01-01') TO ('2035-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_2035 FOR VALUES FROM ('2035-01-01') TO ('2036-01-01')
    partition rpt_acs_observations_unranged DEFAULT

v gold_census.v_metric_latest_by_geo
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     NULL::text AS seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     dataset_code AS dataset,
    body     vintage_year,
    body     vintage_year::text AS vintage,
    body     margin_of_error,
    body     margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_census.mv_acs_latest;

v gold_census.v_metric_timeseries_by_geo
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     unit,
    body     seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     dataset,
    body     vintage_year,
    body     vintage,
    body     margin_of_error,
    body     margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_census.fact_observation;

v gold_census_bps.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_label text
    column structure_type text
    column structure_label text
    column frequency text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT (((measure.measure_id || ':'::text) || measure.structure_type) || ':'::text) || frequency.frequency AS source_object_key,
    body     measure.measure_id,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.structure_type,
    body     measure.structure_label,
    body     frequency.frequency,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.observation_basis,
    body     measure.parser_contract_version AS schema_version
    body    FROM silver_census_bps.dim_measure measure
    body      CROSS JOIN ( VALUES ('monthly'::text), ('annual'::text)) frequency(frequency);

v gold_census_bps.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'CENSUS_BPS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     ((((measure.measure_label || ', '::text) || lower(measure.structure_label)) || ', '::text) || served.frequency) || ' (authorized, not started or completed)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY[upper(served.frequency)] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_census_bps', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'Census Bureau Building Permits Survey'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-administrative-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     measure.methodology_url AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             latest.measure_id,
    body             latest.structure_type,
    body             latest.frequency,
    body             max(to_char(latest.period_end::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text)) AS source_watermark,
