    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.retrieved_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(slice.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_census_bps.observation_latest latest
    body              JOIN control.census_bps_slice slice ON slice.capture_id = latest.capture_id
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key, latest.measure_id, latest.structure_type, latest.frequency) served
    body      JOIN silver_census_bps.dim_measure measure ON measure.measure_id = served.measure_id AND measure.structure_type = served.structure_type
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_census_bps.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_label text
    column structure_type text
    column structure_label text
    column frequency text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column year integer
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column reported_value numeric
    column value_status text
    column months_reported integer
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, period_start) metric_key,
    body     measure_id,
    body     measure_label,
    body     structure_type,
    body     structure_label,
    body     frequency,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     year,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     reported_value,
    body     value_status,
    body     months_reported,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     release_key,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_census_bps.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, period_start, retrieved_at DESC, capture_id DESC;

v gold_census_bps.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_label text
    column structure_type text
    column structure_label text
    column frequency text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column year integer
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column reported_value numeric
    column value_status text
    column months_reported integer
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT (((fact.measure_id || ':'::text) || fact.structure_type) || ':'::text) || fact.frequency AS metric_key,
    body     fact.measure_id,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     fact.structure_type,
    body     measure.structure_label,
    body     fact.frequency,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.observation_basis,
    body     fact.period_start,
    body     fact.period_end,
    body     EXTRACT(year FROM fact.period_start)::integer AS year,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) AS geo_level,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.reported_value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.months_reported,
    body     fact.retrieved_at,
    body     to_char((fact.retrieved_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'::text) AS release_key,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id
    body    FROM silver_census_bps.fact_observation fact
    body      JOIN silver_census_bps.dim_measure measure ON measure.measure_id = fact.measure_id AND measure.structure_type = fact.structure_type
    body      JOIN control.census_bps_slice slice ON slice.capture_id = fact.capture_id
    body   WHERE slice.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text]));

v gold_census_cbp.measure_definition
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    body SELECT measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     (('County Business Patterns: employer establishments in the private '::text || 'nonfarm economy, employment in the pay period including March 12; '::text) || 'excludes the self-employed, private households, railroads, crop and '::text) || 'animal production and most government employees'::text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('est'::text,'Establishments'::text,'establishments'::text), ('emp'::text,'Employees in the pay period including March 12'::text,'employees'::text), ('qp1'::text,'First-quarter payroll'::text,'thousands of dollars'::text), ('ap'::text,'Annual payroll'::text,'thousands of dollars'::text)) measure(measure, measure_label, unit);

v gold_census_cbp.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column naics_key text
    column naics_label text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT (measure.measure || ':'::text) || sector.naics_key AS source_object_key,
    body     measure.measure,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.observation_basis,
    body     sector.naics_key,
    body     sector.naics_label,
    body     'census_cbp_csv:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM gold_census_cbp.measure_definition measure
    body      CROSS JOIN gold_census_cbp.sector_definition sector;

v gold_census_cbp.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'CENSUS_CBP'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     ((export.measure_label || ', '::text) || export.naics_label) || ' (County Business Patterns)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_census_cbp', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'Census Bureau County Business Patterns'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/cbp.html'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.year)::text AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.retrieved_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(file.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_census_cbp.observation_latest latest
    body              JOIN control.census_cbp_file file ON file.capture_id = latest.capture_id
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_census_cbp.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_census_cbp.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column naics_key text
    column naics_code text
    column naics_label text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column noise_flag text
    column employment_range text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     naics_key,
    body     naics_code,
    body     naics_label,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     noise_flag,
    body     employment_range,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     release_key,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_census_cbp.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, retrieved_at DESC, capture_id DESC;

v gold_census_cbp.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column naics_key text
    column naics_code text
    column naics_label text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column noise_flag text
    column employment_range text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT (fact.measure || ':'::text) || fact.naics_key AS metric_key,
    body     fact.measure,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.observation_basis,
    body     fact.naics_key,
    body     fact.naics_code,
    body     sector.naics_label,
    body     fact.year,
    body     make_date(fact.year, 1, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date(fact.year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) AS geo_level,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.noise_flag,
    body     fact.employment_range,
    body     fact.retrieved_at,
    body     to_char((fact.retrieved_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'::text) AS release_key,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id
    body    FROM silver_census_cbp.fact_observation fact
    body      JOIN gold_census_cbp.measure_definition measure ON measure.measure = fact.measure
    body      JOIN gold_census_cbp.sector_definition sector ON sector.naics_key = fact.naics_key
    body      JOIN control.census_cbp_file file ON file.capture_id = fact.capture_id
    body   WHERE file.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text]));

v gold_census_cbp.sector_definition
    column naics_key text
    column naics_label text
    body SELECT naics_key,
    body     naics_label
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('total'::text,'Total for all sectors'::text), ('11'::text,'Forestry, fishing, hunting, and agriculture support'::text), ('21'::text,'Mining, quarrying, and oil and gas extraction'::text), ('22'::text,'Utilities'::text), ('23'::text,'Construction'::text), ('31'::text,'Manufacturing'::text), ('42'::text,'Wholesale trade'::text), ('44'::text,'Retail trade'::text), ('48'::text,'Transportation and warehousing'::text), ('51'::text,'Information'::text), ('52'::text,'Finance and insurance'::text), ('53'::text,'Real estate and rental and leasing'::text), ('54'::text,'Professional, scientific, and technical services'::text), ('55'::text,'Management of companies and enterprises'::text), ('56'::text,'Administrative and support and waste management and remediation services'::text), ('61'::text,'Educational services'::text), ('62'::text,'Health care and social assistance'::text), ('71'::text,'Arts, entertainment, and recreation'::text), ('72'::text,'Accommodation and food services'::text), ('81'::text,'Other services (except public administration)'::text), ('99'::text,'Industries not classified'::text)) sector(naics_key, naics_label);

v gold_census_lodes.measure_definition
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    body SELECT measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     'jobs'::text AS unit,
    body     ('LEHD LODES: jobs counted from administrative records, summed from '::text || 'census blocks by this warehouse; workplace counts carry noise and '::text) || 'residence counts are synthesized, so each is a protected estimate'::text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('resident_workers'::text,'Jobs held by people living here'::text), ('jobs'::text,'Jobs located here'::text), ('live_and_work'::text,'Jobs held by people living and working here'::text), ('inbound'::text,'Jobs here held by people living elsewhere'::text), ('outbound_in_state'::text,'Jobs elsewhere in the state held by people living here'::text)) measure(measure, measure_label);

v gold_census_lodes.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure AS source_object_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     'census_lodes8_csv:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM gold_census_lodes.measure_definition;

v gold_census_lodes.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'CENSUS_LODES'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.measure_label || ' (LEHD LODES)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_census_lodes', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'Census Bureau LEHD Origin-Destination Employment Statistics'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://lehd.ces.census.gov/data/'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.year)::text AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.retrieved_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(file.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_census_lodes.observation_latest latest
    body              JOIN control.census_lodes_slice file ON file.run_id = latest.run_id
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_census_lodes.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_census_lodes.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column release_key text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     release_key,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_census_lodes.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, release_key DESC, retrieved_at DESC, run_id DESC;

v gold_census_lodes.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column release_key text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body WITH published AS (
    body          SELECT slice.run_id,
    body             slice.state,
    body             slice.year,
    body             slice.data_vintage,
    body             slice.published_at
    body            FROM control.census_lodes_slice slice
    body           WHERE slice.status = 'published'::text
    body         ), area AS (
    body          SELECT area.run_id,
    body             area.family,
    body             area.geo_id,
    body             area.geo_sk,
    body             area.value,
    body             area.capture_id
    body            FROM silver_census_lodes.fact_area area
    body              JOIN published published_1 USING (run_id)
    body           WHERE area.column_code = 'C000'::text AND (area.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unmapped'::text]))
    body         ), flow AS (
    body          SELECT flow.run_id,
    body             flow.part,
    body             flow.home_geo_id,
    body             flow.work_geo_id,
    body             flow.year,
    body             flow.capture_id,
    body             flow.home_geo_sk,
    body             flow.work_geo_sk,
    body             flow.jobs,
    body             flow.created_at
    body            FROM silver_census_lodes.fact_flow flow
    body              JOIN published published_1 USING (run_id)
    body         ), county AS (
    body          SELECT area.run_id,
    body                 CASE area.family
    body                     WHEN 'rac'::text THEN 'resident_workers'::text
    body                     ELSE 'jobs'::text
    body                 END AS measure,
    body             area.geo_id,
    body             area.value,
    body             area.capture_id
    body            FROM area
    body         UNION ALL
    body          SELECT flow.run_id,
    body             'live_and_work'::text,
    body             flow.work_geo_id,
    body             sum(flow.jobs) AS sum,
    body             min(flow.capture_id::text)::uuid AS min
    body            FROM flow
    body           WHERE flow.part = 'main'::text AND flow.home_geo_id = flow.work_geo_id
    body           GROUP BY flow.run_id, flow.work_geo_id
    body         UNION ALL
    body          SELECT flow.run_id,
    body             'inbound'::text,
    body             flow.work_geo_id,
    body             sum(flow.jobs) AS sum,
    body             min(flow.capture_id::text)::uuid AS min
    body            FROM flow
    body           WHERE flow.home_geo_id <> flow.work_geo_id
    body           GROUP BY flow.run_id, flow.work_geo_id
    body         UNION ALL
    body          SELECT flow.run_id,
    body             'outbound_in_state'::text,
    body             flow.home_geo_id,
    body             sum(flow.jobs) AS sum,
    body             min(flow.capture_id::text)::uuid AS min
    body            FROM flow
    body           WHERE flow.part = 'main'::text AND flow.home_geo_id <> flow.work_geo_id
    body           GROUP BY flow.run_id, flow.home_geo_id
    body         ), state AS (
    body          SELECT area.run_id,
    body                 CASE area.family
    body                     WHEN 'rac'::text THEN 'resident_workers'::text
    body                     ELSE 'jobs'::text
    body                 END AS measure,
    body             split_part(area.geo_id, '|'::text, 1) AS geo_id,
    body             sum(area.value) AS value,
    body             min(area.capture_id::text)::uuid AS capture_id
    body            FROM silver_census_lodes.fact_area area
    body              JOIN published published_1 USING (run_id)
    body           WHERE area.column_code = 'C000'::text
    body           GROUP BY area.run_id, area.family, (split_part(area.geo_id, '|'::text, 1))
    body         UNION ALL
    body          SELECT flow.run_id,
    body                 CASE flow.part
    body                     WHEN 'main'::text THEN 'live_and_work'::text
    body                     ELSE 'inbound'::text
    body                 END AS "case",
    body             split_part(flow.work_geo_id, '|'::text, 1) AS split_part,
    body             sum(flow.jobs) AS sum,
    body             min(flow.capture_id::text)::uuid AS min
    body            FROM flow
    body           GROUP BY flow.run_id, flow.part, (split_part(flow.work_geo_id, '|'::text, 1))
    body         ), measured AS (
    body          SELECT county.run_id,
    body             county.measure,
    body             county.geo_id,
    body             county.value,
    body             county.capture_id,
    body             'county'::text AS geo_type
    body            FROM county
    body         UNION ALL
    body          SELECT state.run_id,
    body             state.measure,
    body             state.geo_id,
    body             state.value,
    body             state.capture_id,
    body             'state'::text AS text
    body            FROM state
    body         )
    body  SELECT measured.measure AS metric_key,
    body     measured.measure,
    body     definition.measure_label,
    body     definition.unit,
    body     definition.observation_basis,
    body     published.year,
    body     make_date(published.year, 1, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date(published.year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
    body     measured.geo_id,
    body     entity.geo_sk,
    body     measured.geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain(measured.geo_type) AS geo_level,
    body     measured.value,
    body     'valid'::text AS value_status,
    body     published.data_vintage AS release_key,
    body     published.published_at AS retrieved_at,
    body     md5((((((measured.measure || '|'::text) || measured.geo_id) || '|'::text) || published.year::text) || '|'::text) || published.data_vintage) AS source_record_id,
    body     measured.capture_id,
    body     measured.run_id
    body    FROM measured
    body      JOIN published USING (run_id)
    body      JOIN gold_census_lodes.measure_definition definition ON definition.measure = measured.measure
    body      JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_entity entity ON entity.geo_id = measured.geo_id;

v gold_census_sae.estimate_latest
    column dataset_id text
    column measure_id text
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column universe text
    column estimate_method text
    column methodology_url text
    column estimate_year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (dataset_id, measure_id, estimate_year, geo_id) dataset_id,
    body     measure_id,
    body     metric_key,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     universe,
    body     estimate_method,
    body     methodology_url,
    body     estimate_year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     confidence_lower,
    body     confidence_upper,
    body     margin_of_error,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     release_key,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_census_sae.estimate_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY dataset_id, measure_id, estimate_year, geo_id, retrieved_at DESC, capture_id DESC;

v gold_census_sae.estimate_revision
    column dataset_id text
    column measure_id text
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column universe text
    column estimate_method text
    column methodology_url text
    column estimate_year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT fact.dataset_id,
    body     fact.measure_id,
    body     (fact.dataset_id || ':'::text) || fact.measure_id AS metric_key,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.universe,
    body     measure.estimate_method,
    body     measure.methodology_url,
    body     fact.estimate_year,
    body     make_date(fact.estimate_year, 1, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date(fact.estimate_year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) AS geo_level,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.confidence_lower,
    body     fact.confidence_upper,
    body     fact.margin_of_error,
    body     fact.retrieved_at,
    body     to_char((fact.retrieved_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'::text) AS release_key,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id
    body    FROM silver_census_sae.fact_estimate fact
    body      JOIN silver_census_sae.dim_measure measure ON measure.dataset_id = fact.dataset_id AND measure.measure_id = fact.measure_id
    body      JOIN control.census_sae_slice slice ON slice.capture_id = fact.capture_id
    body   WHERE slice.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text]));

v gold_census_sae.measure_export
    column source_dataset text
    column source_measure_code text
    column display_name text
    column unit text
    column universe text
    column estimate_method text
    column methodology_url text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT dataset_id AS source_dataset,
    body     measure_id AS source_measure_code,
    body     measure_label AS display_name,
    body     unit,
    body     universe,
    body     estimate_method,
    body     methodology_url,
    body     parser_contract_version AS schema_version
    body    FROM silver_census_sae.dim_measure measure;

v gold_census_sae.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'CENSUS_SAIPE_SAHIE'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     (measure.dataset_id || ':'::text) || measure.measure_id AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     measure.measure_label AS metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_census_sae', 'relation', 'estimate_revision', 'key', (measure.dataset_id || ':'::text) || measure.measure_id) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'Census Bureau Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates and Small Area Health Insurance Estimates'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     measure.methodology_url AS reference_url
    body    FROM silver_census_sae.dim_measure measure
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT max(latest.estimate_year)::text AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.retrieved_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(slice.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_census_sae.estimate_latest latest
    body              JOIN control.census_sae_slice slice ON slice.capture_id = latest.capture_id
    body           WHERE latest.dataset_id = measure.dataset_id AND latest.measure_id = measure.measure_id) served ON served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_eia.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column product text
    column unit text
    body SELECT DISTINCT product AS source_object_key,
    body     product,
    body     'U.S. dollars per gallon'::text AS unit
    body    FROM silver_eia.fact_retail_price fact;

v gold_eia.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'EIA'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     grade || ' retail price, weekly (EIA-878, U.S. dollars per gallon)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     'U.S. dollars per gallon'::text AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['WEEKLY'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_eia', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     source_watermark,
    body     source_run_id,
    body     publication_time,
    body     'U.S. Energy Information Administration, Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Update (EIA-878)'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-energy-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             min(latest.grade) AS grade,
    body             max(latest.week_start)::text AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.retrieved_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(read.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_eia.observation_latest latest
    body              JOIN control.eia_read read ON read.run_id = latest.run_id
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body   WHERE publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_eia.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column product text
    column grade text
    column series_id text
    column week_start date
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column duoarea text
    column area_name text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column unit text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_date date
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (series_id, week_start) metric_key,
    body     product,
    body     grade,
    body     series_id,
    body     week_start,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     duoarea,
    body     area_name,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     unit,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     release_date,
    body     release_key,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_eia.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY series_id, week_start, retrieved_at DESC, capture_id DESC;

v gold_eia.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column product text
    column grade text
    column series_id text
    column week_start date
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column duoarea text
    column area_name text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column unit text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_date date
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT fact.product AS metric_key,
    body     fact.product,
    body         CASE fact.product
    body             WHEN 'EPMR'::text THEN 'Regular gasoline'::text
    body             WHEN 'EPMM'::text THEN 'Midgrade gasoline'::text
    body             WHEN 'EPMP'::text THEN 'Premium gasoline'::text
    body             WHEN 'EPM0'::text THEN 'All grades gasoline'::text
    body             ELSE NULL::text
    body         END AS grade,
    body     fact.series_id,
    body     fact.week_start,
    body     fact.week_start AS period_start,
    body     fact.week_start + 6 AS period_end,
    body     fact.duoarea,
    body     fact.area_name,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) AS geo_level,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     'U.S. dollars per gallon'::text AS unit,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.retrieved_at,
    body     fact.retrieved_at::date AS release_date,
    body     fact.retrieved_at::date::text AS release_key,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id
    body    FROM silver_eia.fact_retail_price fact
    body      JOIN control.eia_read read ON read.run_id = fact.run_id
    body   WHERE read.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text])) AND fact.geo_id IS NOT NULL;

v gold_epa_aqs.measure_definition
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    body SELECT measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     ((((('EPA Air Quality System (AirData annual monitor file): this warehouse''s county figure '::text || 'is the highest value among the county''s monitors with a complete year (Completeness '::text) || 'Indicator Y), from every measured value with exceptional events included; it is a '::text) || 'derived summary, not an EPA design value or a regulatory determination. '::text) || statistic) || ' Source: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Air Quality '::text) || 'System (AirData).'::text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('pm25_annual_mean'::text,'PM2.5 annual mean, highest complete monitor'::text,'micrograms per cubic meter'::text,'The statistic is the annual arithmetic mean under the 2024 annual PM2.5 standard (FRM/FEM, parameter 88101).'::text), ('ozone_8hour_4th_max'::text,'Ozone fourth-highest daily maximum 8-hour average, highest complete monitor'::text,'parts per million'::text,'The statistic is the year''s fourth-highest daily maximum 8-hour average under the 2015 ozone standard (parameter 44201).'::text)) measure(measure, measure_label, unit, statistic);

v gold_epa_aqs.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure AS source_object_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     'epa_aqs_csv:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM gold_epa_aqs.measure_definition;

v gold_epa_aqs.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'EPA_AQS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.measure_label || ' (EPA AirData, derived county figure)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body     'derived_summary'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_epa_aqs', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Air Quality System'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://aqs.epa.gov/aqsweb/airdata/download_files.html'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.release_key) AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.published_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(latest.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_epa_aqs.observation_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_epa_aqs.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_epa_aqs.monitor_observation
    column run_id uuid
    column monitor_id text
    column sample_duration text
    column pollutant_standard text
    column event_type text
    column year integer
    column capture_id uuid
    column source_row_index integer
    column measure text
    column parameter_code text
    column poc integer
    column site_number text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text
    column completeness text
    column certification text
    column observation_count integer
    column units text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column date_of_last_change date
    column source_record_id text
    column created_at timestamp with time zone
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    body SELECT fact.run_id,
    body     fact.monitor_id,
    body     fact.sample_duration,
    body     fact.pollutant_standard,
    body     fact.event_type,
    body     fact.year,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.source_row_index,
    body     fact.measure,
    body     fact.parameter_code,
    body     fact.poc,
    body     fact.site_number,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.completeness,
    body     fact.certification,
    body     fact.observation_count,
    body     fact.units,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.date_of_last_change,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.created_at,
    body     file.published_at
    body    FROM silver_epa_aqs.monitor_fact fact
    body      JOIN control.epa_aqs_file file ON file.run_id = fact.run_id
    body   WHERE file.status = 'published'::text;

v gold_epa_aqs.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column highest_monitor text
    column complete_monitors bigint
    column certification text
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     highest_monitor,
    body     complete_monitors,
    body     certification,
    body     release_key,
    body     published_at,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_epa_aqs.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, published_at DESC, run_id DESC;

v gold_epa_aqs.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column highest_monitor text
    column complete_monitors bigint
    column certification text
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body WITH eligible AS (
    body          SELECT monitor.run_id,
    body             monitor.monitor_id,
    body             monitor.sample_duration,
    body             monitor.pollutant_standard,
    body             monitor.event_type,
    body             monitor.year,
    body             monitor.capture_id,
    body             monitor.source_row_index,
    body             monitor.measure,
    body             monitor.parameter_code,
    body             monitor.poc,
    body             monitor.site_number,
    body             monitor.geo_id,
    body             monitor.geo_sk,
    body             monitor.geography_status,
    body             monitor.completeness,
    body             monitor.certification,
    body             monitor.observation_count,
    body             monitor.units,
    body             monitor.value_source,
    body             monitor.value,
    body             monitor.value_status,
    body             monitor.date_of_last_change,
    body             monitor.source_record_id,
    body             monitor.created_at,
    body             monitor.published_at
    body            FROM gold_epa_aqs.monitor_observation monitor
    body           WHERE monitor.completeness = 'Y'::text AND (monitor.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['No Events'::text, 'Events Included'::text])) AND monitor.value_status = 'valid'::text
    body         ), ranked AS (
    body          SELECT eligible.run_id,
    body             eligible.monitor_id,
    body             eligible.sample_duration,
    body             eligible.pollutant_standard,
    body             eligible.event_type,
    body             eligible.year,
    body             eligible.capture_id,
    body             eligible.source_row_index,
    body             eligible.measure,
    body             eligible.parameter_code,
    body             eligible.poc,
    body             eligible.site_number,
    body             eligible.geo_id,
    body             eligible.geo_sk,
    body             eligible.geography_status,
    body             eligible.completeness,
    body             eligible.certification,
    body             eligible.observation_count,
    body             eligible.units,
    body             eligible.value_source,
    body             eligible.value,
    body             eligible.value_status,
    body             eligible.date_of_last_change,
    body             eligible.source_record_id,
    body             eligible.created_at,
    body             eligible.published_at,
    body             row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY eligible.run_id, eligible.measure, eligible.geo_id ORDER BY eligible.value DESC, eligible.monitor_id) AS rank,
    body             count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY eligible.run_id, eligible.measure, eligible.geo_id) AS monitors
    body            FROM eligible
    body         )
    body  SELECT ranked.measure AS metric_key,
    body     definition.measure_label,
    body     definition.unit,
    body     definition.observation_basis,
    body     ranked.year,
    body     make_date(ranked.year, 1, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date(ranked.year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
    body     ranked.geo_id,
    body     ranked.geo_sk,
    body     'county'::text AS geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain('county'::text) AS geo_level,
    body     ranked.geography_status,
    body     ranked.value,
    body     'valid'::text AS value_status,
    body     ranked.monitor_id AS highest_monitor,
    body     ranked.monitors AS complete_monitors,
    body     ranked.certification,
    body     (('AirData '::text || ranked.year::text) || ' read '::text) || to_char((ranked.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'::text) AS release_key,
    body     ranked.published_at,
    body     md5((((((ranked.measure || '|'::text) || ranked.geo_id) || '|'::text) || ranked.year::text) || '|'::text) || ranked.run_id::text) AS source_record_id,
    body     ranked.capture_id,
    body     ranked.run_id
    body    FROM ranked
    body      JOIN gold_epa_aqs.measure_definition definition ON definition.measure = ranked.measure
    body   WHERE ranked.rank = 1 AND (ranked.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unmapped'::text]));

v gold_fbi.agency_geography
    column relationship_sk bigint
    column ori text
    column state_code text
    column agency_name text
    column agency_type text
    column county_labels text[]
    column relationship_type text
    column source_label text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column resolution_method text
    column resolution_status text
    column confidence_class text
    column reason_code text
    column effective_start date
    column effective_end date
    column geography_vintage integer
    column evidence_source text
    column evidence_capture_id uuid
    column release_key text
    column agency_geo_sk bigint
    body SELECT relationship.relationship_sk,
    body     relationship.ori,
    body     agency.state_code,
    body     version.agency_name,
    body     version.agency_type,
    body     version.county_labels,
    body     relationship.relationship_type,
    body     relationship.source_label,
    body     relationship.geo_id,
    body     relationship.geo_sk,
    body     relationship.resolution_method,
    body     relationship.resolution_status,
    body     relationship.confidence_class,
    body     relationship.reason_code,
    body     relationship.effective_start,
    body     relationship.effective_end,
    body     relationship.geography_vintage,
    body     relationship.evidence_source,
    body     relationship.evidence_capture_id,
    body     relationship.release_key,
    body     agency.geo_sk AS agency_geo_sk
    body    FROM silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship relationship
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_agency agency USING (ori)
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_agency_version version ON version.ori = relationship.ori AND version.release_key = relationship.release_key
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release release ON release.product_id = relationship.product_id AND release.release_key = relationship.release_key
    body   WHERE release.status = 'published'::text;

v gold_fbi.agency_observation_area_filter
    column observation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column release_key text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_form text
    column counted_entity_basis text
    column unit text
    column ori text
    column agency_name text
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column participation_status text
    column coverage_percent numeric
    column filter_geography_type text
    column filter_geo_id text
    column filter_geo_sk bigint
    column filter_source_label text
    column filter_confidence_class text
    column result_label text
    column observation_grain text
    body SELECT observation.observation_sk,
    body     observation.product_id,
    body     observation.release_key,
    body     observation.measure_id,
    body     observation.measure_form,
    body     observation.counted_entity_basis,
    body     observation.unit,
    body     observation.subject_code AS ori,
    body     observation.subject_label AS agency_name,
    body     observation.period,
    body     observation.period_start,
    body     observation.period_end,
    body     observation.value,
    body     observation.value_status,
    body     observation.participation_status,
    body     observation.coverage_percent,
    body     relationship.relationship_type AS filter_geography_type,
    body     relationship.geo_id AS filter_geo_id,
    body     relationship.geo_sk AS filter_geo_sk,
    body     relationship.source_label AS filter_source_label,
    body     relationship.confidence_class AS filter_confidence_class,
    body         CASE relationship.relationship_type
    body             WHEN 'county'::text THEN 'agency-reported for agencies associated with this county'::text
    body             WHEN 'place'::text THEN 'agency-reported for agencies mapped to this place'::text
    body             ELSE 'agency-reported for agencies associated with this state'::text
    body         END AS result_label,
    body     'agency'::text AS observation_grain
    body    FROM gold_fbi.crime_observation observation
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship relationship ON relationship.ori = observation.subject_code AND relationship.product_id = observation.product_id AND observation.period_start >= relationship.effective_start AND observation.period_end <= relationship.effective_end
    body   WHERE observation.subject_type = 'agency'::text AND relationship.resolution_status = 'resolved'::text;

v gold_fbi.calendar_window_observation
    column metric_code text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column subject_code text
    column unit text
    column grain text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column derivation_kind text
    column method text
    column method_version integer
    column expected_periods integer
    column present_periods integer
    column refusal_reason text
    column component_releases text[]
    column as_of_date date
    body SELECT metric_code,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     subject_code,
    body     unit,
    body     grain,
    body     window_start AS period_start,
    body     window_end AS period_end,
    body     value,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN value IS NULL THEN 'incomplete_window'::text
    body             ELSE 'reported'::text
    body         END AS value_status,
    body     'derived'::text AS derivation_kind,
    body     method,
    body     method_version,
    body     expected_periods,
    body     present_periods,
    body     refusal_reason,
    body     component_releases,
    body     refreshed_at::date AS as_of_date
    body    FROM gold_fbi.derived_calendar_rollup derived;

v gold_fbi.county_rollup
    column product_id text
    column release_key text
    column refresh_date date
    column max_data_month text
    column ucr_program text
    column offense_code text
    column offense_label text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_form text
    column counted_entity_basis text
    column unit text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column county_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column value numeric
    column contributing_oris text[]
    column reporting_agency_count bigint
    column mapped_agency_count bigint
    column includes_multi_county_agency boolean
    column derived boolean
    column derivation_method text
    column result_label text
    column methodology_note text
    column counted_entity_note text
    column methodology_url text
    column documentation_url text
    body WITH county_link AS (
    body          SELECT relationship.product_id,
    body             relationship.ori,
    body             relationship.geo_id,
    body             relationship.geo_sk,
    body             relationship.effective_start,
    body             relationship.effective_end
    body            FROM silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship relationship
    body           WHERE relationship.relationship_type = 'county'::text AND relationship.resolution_status = 'resolved'::text
    body         ), contribution AS (
    body          SELECT DISTINCT observation.product_id,
    body             observation.release_key,
    body             observation.measure_id,
    body             link.geo_id,
    body             link.geo_sk,
    body             observation.period,
    body             observation.period_start,
    body             observation.period_end,
    body             observation.subject_code AS ori,
    body             observation.value,
    body             observation.value_status,
    body             ( SELECT count(DISTINCT sibling.geo_id) > 1
    body                    FROM county_link sibling
    body                   WHERE sibling.product_id = observation.product_id AND sibling.ori = observation.subject_code AND observation.period_start >= sibling.effective_start AND observation.period_end <= sibling.effective_end) AS is_multi_county
    body            FROM gold_fbi.crime_observation observation
    body              JOIN county_link link ON link.product_id = observation.product_id AND link.ori = observation.subject_code AND observation.period_start >= link.effective_start AND observation.period_end <= link.effective_end
    body           WHERE observation.subject_type = 'agency'::text AND observation.measure_form = 'absolute_total'::text AND (observation.counted_entity_basis = ANY (ARRAY['offense'::text, 'clearance'::text]))
    body         ), summed AS (
    body          SELECT contribution.product_id,
    body             contribution.release_key,
    body             contribution.measure_id,
    body             contribution.geo_id,
    body             contribution.geo_sk,
    body             contribution.period,
    body             contribution.period_start,
    body             contribution.period_end,
    body             sum(contribution.value) FILTER (WHERE contribution.value_status = 'reported'::text) AS value,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT contribution.ori ORDER BY contribution.ori) FILTER (WHERE contribution.value_status = 'reported'::text) AS contributing_oris,
    body             count(DISTINCT contribution.ori) FILTER (WHERE contribution.value_status = 'reported'::text) AS reporting_agency_count,
    body             bool_or(contribution.is_multi_county) FILTER (WHERE contribution.value_status = 'reported'::text) AS includes_multi_county_agency
    body            FROM contribution
    body           GROUP BY contribution.product_id, contribution.release_key, contribution.measure_id, contribution.geo_id, contribution.geo_sk, contribution.period, contribution.period_start, contribution.period_end
    body          HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE contribution.value_status = 'reported'::text) > 0
    body         )
    body  SELECT summed.product_id,
    body     summed.release_key,
    body     release.refresh_date,
    body     release.max_data_month,
    body     release.ucr_program,
    body     measure.offense_code,
    body     measure.offense_label,
    body     summed.measure_id,
    body     measure.measure_form,
    body     measure.counted_entity_basis,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     summed.geo_id,
    body     summed.geo_sk,
    body     county.county_name,
    body     county.state_fips,
    body     county.county_fips,
    body     summed.period,
    body     summed.period_start,
    body     summed.period_end,
    body     summed.value,
    body     summed.contributing_oris,
    body     summed.reporting_agency_count,
    body     mapped.mapped_agency_count,
    body     summed.includes_multi_county_agency,
    body     true AS derived,
    body     'sum_of_agency_reported_totals'::text AS derivation_method,
    body     'derived county roll-up of agency-reported totals'::text AS result_label,
    body     ((('Each mapped agency''s whole published count is summed; an agency '::text || 'serving more than one county is counted in full in each of its '::text) || 'counties, so county values are not additive to state totals. '::text) || 'Agency months the provider did not publish are excluded, never '::text) || 'zero.'::text AS methodology_note,
    body     release.counted_entity_note,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.documentation_url
    body    FROM summed
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_offense_measure measure ON measure.product_id = summed.product_id AND measure.measure_id = summed.measure_id
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release release ON release.product_id = summed.product_id AND release.release_key = summed.release_key
    body      JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_current county ON county.geo_id = summed.geo_id
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(DISTINCT county_link.ori) AS mapped_agency_count
    body            FROM county_link
    body           WHERE county_link.product_id = summed.product_id AND county_link.geo_id = summed.geo_id AND summed.period_start >= county_link.effective_start AND summed.period_end <= county_link.effective_end) mapped ON true;

v gold_fbi.crime_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column offense_code text
    column offense_label text
    column ucr_program text
    column release_key text
    column refresh_date date
    column max_data_month text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_form text
    column counted_entity_basis text
    column unit text
    column reported_status text
    column subject_type text
    column subject_code text
    column subject_label text
    column source_geo_level text
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text
    column geography_basis text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column population_denominator numeric
    column population numeric
    column participated_population numeric
    column coverage_percent numeric
    column coverage_basis text
    column participation_status text
    column counted_entity_note text
    column methodology_url text
    column documentation_url text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT fact.observation_sk,
    body     fact.product_id,
    body     release.offense_code,
    body     release.offense_label,
    body     release.ucr_program,
    body     fact.release_key,
    body     release.refresh_date,
    body     release.max_data_month,
    body     fact.measure_id,
    body     measure.measure_form,
    body     measure.counted_entity_basis,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.reported_status,
    body     fact.subject_type,
    body     fact.subject_code,
    body     fact.subject_label,
    body     fact.source_geo_level,
    body     fact.period,
    body     fact.period_start,
    body     fact.period_end,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body         CASE fact.subject_type
    body             WHEN 'national'::text THEN 'provider-published national total'::text
    body             WHEN 'state'::text THEN 'provider-published state total'::text
    body             ELSE 'agency-reported for one law-enforcement agency'::text
    body         END AS geography_basis,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.population_denominator,
    body     coverage.population,
    body     coverage.participated_population,
    body     coverage.coverage_percent,
    body     coverage.coverage_basis,
    body     coverage.participation_status,
    body     release.counted_entity_note,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.documentation_url,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id
    body    FROM silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation fact
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release release ON release.product_id = fact.product_id AND release.release_key = fact.release_key
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_offense_measure measure ON measure.product_id = fact.product_id AND measure.measure_id = fact.measure_id
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.fact_reporting_participation coverage ON coverage.product_id = fact.product_id AND coverage.release_key = fact.release_key AND coverage.subject_type = fact.subject_type AND coverage.subject_code = fact.subject_code AND coverage.period = fact.period
    body   WHERE release.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['ambiguous'::text, 'unsupported'::text]));

r gold_fbi.derived_calendar_rollup
    column metric_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column subject_code text
    column unit text
    column grain text NOT NULL
    column window_start date NOT NULL
    column window_end date NOT NULL
    column method text NOT NULL
    column method_version integer NOT NULL
    column expected_periods integer NOT NULL
    column present_periods integer NOT NULL
    column value numeric
    column refusal_reason text
    column component_releases text[] NOT NULL
    column derived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
    column refreshed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_check CHECK ((window_end > window_start))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_check1 CHECK (((present_periods >= 0) AND (present_periods <= expected_periods)))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_derived_check CHECK (derived)
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_expected_periods_check CHECK ((expected_periods = ANY (ARRAY[3, 12])))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_grain_check CHECK ((grain = ANY (ARRAY['quarter'::text, 'year'::text])))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_method_check CHECK ((method = ANY (ARRAY['sum'::text, 'mean'::text])))
    constraint derived_calendar_rollup_method_version_check CHECK ((method_version >= 1))
    constraint fbi_rollup_value_or_reason CHECK ((((present_periods = expected_periods) AND (value IS NOT NULL) AND (refusal_reason IS NULL)) OR ((present_periods < expected_periods) AND (value IS NULL) AND (refusal_reason IS NOT NULL))))
    index uq_fbi_derived_calendar_rollup CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_fbi_derived_calendar_rollup ON gold_fbi.derived_calendar_rollup USING btree (metric_code, COALESCE(geo_id, ''::text), COALESCE(subject_code, ''::text), grain, window_start)

v gold_fbi.latest_county_rollup
    column product_id text
    column release_key text
    column refresh_date date
    column max_data_month text
    column ucr_program text
    column offense_code text
    column offense_label text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_form text
    column counted_entity_basis text
    column unit text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column county_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column value numeric
    column contributing_oris text[]
    column reporting_agency_count bigint
    column mapped_agency_count bigint
    column includes_multi_county_agency boolean
    column derived boolean
    column derivation_method text
    column result_label text
    column methodology_note text
    column counted_entity_note text
    column methodology_url text
    column documentation_url text
    body SELECT rollup.product_id,
    body     rollup.release_key,
    body     rollup.refresh_date,
    body     rollup.max_data_month,
    body     rollup.ucr_program,
    body     rollup.offense_code,
    body     rollup.offense_label,
    body     rollup.measure_id,
    body     rollup.measure_form,
    body     rollup.counted_entity_basis,
    body     rollup.unit,
    body     rollup.geo_id,
    body     rollup.geo_sk,
    body     rollup.county_name,
    body     rollup.state_fips,
    body     rollup.county_fips,
    body     rollup.period,
    body     rollup.period_start,
    body     rollup.period_end,
    body     rollup.value,
    body     rollup.contributing_oris,
    body     rollup.reporting_agency_count,
    body     rollup.mapped_agency_count,
    body     rollup.includes_multi_county_agency,
    body     rollup.derived,
    body     rollup.derivation_method,
    body     rollup.result_label,
    body     rollup.methodology_note,
    body     rollup.counted_entity_note,
    body     rollup.methodology_url,
    body     rollup.documentation_url
    body    FROM gold_fbi.county_rollup rollup
    body      JOIN ( SELECT dim_ucr_dataset_release.product_id,
    body             max(dim_ucr_dataset_release.refresh_date) AS refresh_date
    body            FROM silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release
    body           WHERE dim_ucr_dataset_release.status = 'published'::text
    body           GROUP BY dim_ucr_dataset_release.product_id) latest ON latest.product_id = rollup.product_id AND latest.refresh_date = rollup.refresh_date;

v gold_fbi.latest_release_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column offense_code text
    column offense_label text
    column ucr_program text
    column release_key text
    column refresh_date date
    column max_data_month text
    column measure_id text
    column measure_form text
    column counted_entity_basis text
    column unit text
    column reported_status text
    column subject_type text
    column subject_code text
    column subject_label text
    column source_geo_level text
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text
    column geography_basis text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column population_denominator numeric
    column population numeric
    column participated_population numeric
    column coverage_percent numeric
    column coverage_basis text
    column participation_status text
    column counted_entity_note text
    column methodology_url text
    column documentation_url text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT observation.observation_sk,
    body     observation.product_id,
    body     observation.offense_code,
    body     observation.offense_label,
    body     observation.ucr_program,
    body     observation.release_key,
    body     observation.refresh_date,
    body     observation.max_data_month,
    body     observation.measure_id,
    body     observation.measure_form,
    body     observation.counted_entity_basis,
    body     observation.unit,
    body     observation.reported_status,
    body     observation.subject_type,
    body     observation.subject_code,
    body     observation.subject_label,
    body     observation.source_geo_level,
    body     observation.period,
    body     observation.period_start,
    body     observation.period_end,
    body     observation.geo_id,
    body     observation.geo_sk,
    body     observation.geography_status,
    body     observation.geography_basis,
    body     observation.value_source,
    body     observation.value,
    body     observation.value_status,
    body     observation.population_denominator,
    body     observation.population,
    body     observation.participated_population,
    body     observation.coverage_percent,
    body     observation.coverage_basis,
    body     observation.participation_status,
    body     observation.counted_entity_note,
    body     observation.methodology_url,
    body     observation.documentation_url,
    body     observation.source_record_id,
    body     observation.capture_id
    body    FROM gold_fbi.crime_observation observation
    body      JOIN ( SELECT dim_ucr_dataset_release.product_id,
    body             max(dim_ucr_dataset_release.refresh_date) AS refresh_date
    body            FROM silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release
    body           WHERE dim_ucr_dataset_release.status = 'published'::text
    body           GROUP BY dim_ucr_dataset_release.product_id) latest ON latest.product_id = observation.product_id AND latest.refresh_date = observation.refresh_date;

v gold_fbi.measure_export
    column source_dataset text
    column source_measure_code text
    column source_offense_code text
    column display_name text
    column ucr_program text
    column measure_form text
    column counted_entity_basis text
    column unit text
    column reported_status text
    column source_watermark text
    column methodology_url text
    column counted_entity_note text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure.product_id AS source_dataset,
    body     measure.measure_id AS source_measure_code,
    body     measure.offense_code AS source_offense_code,
    body     measure.offense_label AS display_name,
    body     measure.ucr_program,
    body     measure.measure_form,
    body     measure.counted_entity_basis,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.reported_status,
    body     release.release_key AS source_watermark,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.counted_entity_note,
    body     release.parser_contract_version AS schema_version
    body    FROM silver_fbi.dim_offense_measure measure
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.product_id,
    body             candidate.release_key,
    body             candidate.refresh_date,
    body             candidate.max_data_month,
    body             candidate.ucr_program,
    body             candidate.offense_code,
    body             candidate.offense_label,
    body             candidate.period_start,
    body             candidate.period_end,
    body             candidate.documentation_url,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.reported_status,
    body             candidate.counted_entity_note,
    body             candidate.release_capture_id,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.product_id = measure.product_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY candidate.refresh_date DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

v gold_fbi.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'FBI_UCR'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     (measure.product_id || ':'::text) || measure.measure_id AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     ((((measure.offense_label || ' '::text) || measure.counted_entity_basis) || ' ('::text) || measure.measure_form) || ')'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     measure.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['MONTHLY'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN measure.measure_form = 'absolute_total'::text THEN 'additive_within_subject'::text
    body             ELSE 'non_additive'::text
    body         END AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_fbi', 'relation', 'crime_observation', 'product_id', measure.product_id, 'measure_id', measure.measure_id) AS physical_lineage,
    body     release.release_key AS source_watermark,
    body     release.source_run_id,
    body     release.published_at AS publication_time,
    body     'Federal Bureau of Investigation Uniform Crime Reporting Program'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-law-enforcement'::text AS source_type,
    body     release.methodology_url AS reference_url
