    body    FROM ( SELECT measure_1.product_id,
    body             measure_1.measure_id,
    body             measure_1.offense_label,
    body             measure_1.counted_entity_basis,
    body             measure_1.measure_form,
    body             measure_1.unit,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.subject_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.subject_type))) FILTER (WHERE fact.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains
    body            FROM silver_fbi.dim_offense_measure measure_1
    body              JOIN silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation fact ON fact.product_id = measure_1.product_id AND fact.measure_id = measure_1.measure_id
    body              JOIN silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release release_1 ON release_1.product_id = fact.product_id AND release_1.release_key = fact.release_key
    body           WHERE release_1.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['ambiguous'::text, 'unsupported'::text]))
    body           GROUP BY measure_1.product_id, measure_1.measure_id, measure_1.offense_label, measure_1.counted_entity_basis, measure_1.measure_form, measure_1.unit) measure
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.product_id,
    body             candidate.release_key,
    body             candidate.refresh_date,
    body             candidate.max_data_month,
    body             candidate.ucr_program,
    body             candidate.offense_code,
    body             candidate.offense_label,
    body             candidate.period_start,
    body             candidate.period_end,
    body             candidate.documentation_url,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.reported_status,
    body             candidate.counted_entity_note,
    body             candidate.release_capture_id,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.product_id = measure.product_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY candidate.refresh_date DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

v gold_fbi.reporting_coverage
    column participation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column release_key text
    column ucr_program text
    column subject_type text
    column subject_code text
    column subject_label text
    column source_geo_level text
    column period text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text
    column population numeric
    column participated_population numeric
    column coverage_percent numeric
    column coverage_basis text
    column participation_status text
    column refresh_date date
    column methodology_url text
    column capture_id uuid
    body SELECT coverage.participation_sk,
    body     coverage.product_id,
    body     coverage.release_key,
    body     coverage.ucr_program,
    body     coverage.subject_type,
    body     coverage.subject_code,
    body     coverage.subject_label,
    body     coverage.source_geo_level,
    body     coverage.period,
    body     coverage.period_start,
    body     coverage.period_end,
    body     coverage.geo_id,
    body     coverage.geo_sk,
    body     coverage.geography_status,
    body     coverage.population,
    body     coverage.participated_population,
    body     coverage.coverage_percent,
    body     coverage.coverage_basis,
    body     coverage.participation_status,
    body     release.refresh_date,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     coverage.capture_id
    body    FROM silver_fbi.fact_reporting_participation coverage
    body      JOIN silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release release ON release.product_id = coverage.product_id AND release.release_key = coverage.release_key
    body   WHERE release.status = 'published'::text;

v gold_fcc_bdc.availability_observation
    column run_id uuid
    column geo_id text
    column technology text
    column capture_id uuid
    column source_row_index integer
    column geography_type text
    column geography_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text
    column total_units integer
    column speed_02_02 numeric
    column speed_10_1 numeric
    column speed_25_3 numeric
    column speed_100_20 numeric
    column speed_250_25 numeric
    column speed_1000_100 numeric
    column value_source text
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column created_at timestamp with time zone
    column as_of_date date
    column file_name text
    column revision text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    body SELECT availability.run_id,
    body     availability.geo_id,
    body     availability.technology,
    body     availability.capture_id,
    body     availability.source_row_index,
    body     availability.geography_type,
    body     availability.geography_id,
    body     availability.geo_sk,
    body     availability.geography_status,
    body     availability.total_units,
    body     availability.speed_02_02,
    body     availability.speed_10_1,
    body     availability.speed_25_3,
    body     availability.speed_100_20,
    body     availability.speed_250_25,
    body     availability.speed_1000_100,
    body     availability.value_source,
    body     availability.value_status,
    body     availability.missing_reason,
    body     availability.created_at,
    body     read.as_of_date,
    body     file.file_name,
    body     file.revision,
    body     read.published_at
    body    FROM silver_fcc_bdc.availability_row availability
    body      JOIN control.fcc_bdc_read read ON read.run_id = availability.run_id
    body      JOIN control.fcc_bdc_file file ON file.run_id = availability.run_id AND file.capture_id = availability.capture_id
    body   WHERE read.status = 'published'::text;

v gold_fcc_bdc.measure_definition
    column measure text
    column technology text
    column tier_column text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    body SELECT measure,
    body     technology,
    body     tier_column,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     (((((('FCC National Broadband Map, fixed broadband availability summary (total area, residential '::text || 'units): what providers report they could serve, not what households subscribe to and not '::text) || 'a measured speed; distinct from the ACS broadband subscription measures. The FCC '::text) || 'aggregates its Broadband Serviceable Locations to the nation, states, counties and places '::text) || 'itself; this warehouse does not re-aggregate. '::text) || definition) || ' Source: Federal Communications Commission, National Broadband Map (Broadband Data '::text) || 'Collection).'::text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('residential_units'::text,'Any Technology'::text,NULL::text,'Residential broadband serviceable units'::text,'units'::text,'The count of residential units at broadband serviceable locations, the denominator of the shares.'::text), ('share_any_25_3'::text,'Any Technology'::text,'speed_25_3'::text,'Share of residential units with fixed broadband reported at 25/3 Mbps or faster'::text,'share of units'::text,'The share of units where any provider reports fixed service of at least 25 Mbps down and 3 up, by any technology.'::text), ('share_any_100_20'::text,'Any Technology'::text,'speed_100_20'::text,'Share of residential units with fixed broadband reported at 100/20 Mbps or faster'::text,'share of units'::text,'The share of units where any provider reports fixed service of at least 100 Mbps down and 20 up, by any technology.'::text), ('share_any_1000_100'::text,'Any Technology'::text,'speed_1000_100'::text,'Share of residential units with fixed broadband reported at 1000/100 Mbps or faster'::text,'share of units'::text,'The share of units where any provider reports fixed service of at least 1000 Mbps down and 100 up, by any technology.'::text), ('share_terrestrial_100_20'::text,'Any Terrestrial'::text,'speed_100_20'::text,'Share of residential units with terrestrial fixed broadband reported at 100/20 Mbps or faster'::text,'share of units'::text,'As share_any_100_20, counting terrestrial technologies only (not satellite).'::text), ('share_wired_100_20'::text,'All Wired'::text,'speed_100_20'::text,'Share of residential units with wired broadband reported at 100/20 Mbps or faster'::text,'share of units'::text,'As share_any_100_20, counting wired technologies only (copper, cable, fiber).'::text)) measure(measure, technology, tier_column, measure_label, unit, definition);

v gold_fcc_bdc.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure AS source_object_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     'fcc_bdc_summary_csv:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM gold_fcc_bdc.measure_definition;

v gold_fcc_bdc.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'FCC_BDC'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.measure_label || ' (FCC National Broadband Map, provider-reported availability)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_fcc_bdc', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'Federal Communications Commission National Broadband Map'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://broadbandmap.fcc.gov/data-download'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.release_key) AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.published_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(latest.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_fcc_bdc.observation_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_fcc_bdc.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_fcc_bdc.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column total_units integer
    column as_of_date text
    column revision text
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     missing_reason,
    body     total_units,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     revision,
    body     release_key,
    body     published_at,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_fcc_bdc.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, published_at DESC, run_id DESC;

v gold_fcc_bdc.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column total_units integer
    column as_of_date text
    column revision text
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT definition.measure AS metric_key,
    body     definition.measure_label,
    body     definition.unit,
    body     definition.observation_basis,
    body     EXTRACT(year FROM "row".as_of_date)::integer AS year,
    body     "row".as_of_date AS period_start,
    body     "row".as_of_date AS period_end,
    body     "row".geo_id,
    body     "row".geo_sk,
    body     "row".geography_type AS geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain("row".geography_type) AS geo_level,
    body     "row".geography_status,
    body         CASE definition.tier_column
    body             WHEN 'speed_25_3'::text THEN "row".speed_25_3
    body             WHEN 'speed_100_20'::text THEN "row".speed_100_20
    body             WHEN 'speed_1000_100'::text THEN "row".speed_1000_100
    body             ELSE "row".total_units::numeric
    body         END AS value,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN definition.tier_column IS NULL THEN 'valid'::text
    body             ELSE "row".value_status
    body         END AS value_status,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN definition.tier_column IS NULL THEN NULL::text
    body             ELSE "row".missing_reason
    body         END AS missing_reason,
    body     "row".total_units,
    body     "row".as_of_date::text AS as_of_date,
    body     "row".revision,
    body     (((('BDC '::text || "row".as_of_date::text) || ' rev '::text) || "row".revision) || ' read '::text) || to_char(("row".published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'::text) AS release_key,
    body     "row".published_at,
    body     md5((((definition.measure || '|'::text) || "row".geo_id) || '|'::text) || "row".run_id::text) AS source_record_id,
    body     "row".capture_id,
    body     "row".run_id
    body    FROM gold_fcc_bdc.availability_observation "row"
    body      JOIN gold_fcc_bdc.measure_definition definition ON definition.technology = "row".technology
    body   WHERE "row".geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unmapped'::text]);

v gold_fema_nri.declaration_count
    column metric_key text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column year integer
    column value bigint
    column declarations text
    column last_refresh timestamp with time zone
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    body WITH current_revision AS (
    body          SELECT DISTINCT ON (revision.declaration_id) revision.declaration_id,
    body             revision.revision_hash,
    body             revision.run_id,
    body             revision.capture_id,
    body             revision.record_index,
    body             revision.declaration_string,
    body             revision.disaster_number,
    body             revision.declaration_type,
    body             revision.declaration_date,
    body             revision.incident_type,
    body             revision.state_fips,
    body             revision.county_fips,
    body             revision.place_code,
    body             revision.designated_area,
    body             revision.last_refresh,
    body             revision.geo_id,
    body             revision.geo_sk,
    body             revision.geography_status,
    body             revision.created_at
    body            FROM silver_fema_nri.declaration_revision revision
    body              JOIN control.fema_nri_run run ON run.run_id = revision.run_id
    body           WHERE run.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY revision.declaration_id, revision.last_refresh DESC, revision.created_at DESC
    body         ), latest_read AS (
    body          SELECT max(fema_nri_run.published_at) AS published_at
    body            FROM control.fema_nri_run
    body           WHERE fema_nri_run.stream = 'declarations'::text AND fema_nri_run.status = 'published'::text
    body         )
    body  SELECT
    body         CASE declaration_type
    body             WHEN 'DR'::text THEN 'major_disaster_declarations'::text
    body             WHEN 'EM'::text THEN 'emergency_declarations'::text
    body             ELSE 'fire_management_declarations'::text
    body         END AS metric_key,
    body     geo_id,
    body     min(geo_sk) AS geo_sk,
    body     EXTRACT(year FROM declaration_date)::integer AS year,
    body     count(DISTINCT disaster_number) AS value,
    body     string_agg(DISTINCT declaration_string, ', '::text ORDER BY declaration_string) AS declarations,
    body     max(last_refresh) AS last_refresh,
    body     min(capture_id::text)::uuid AS capture_id,
    body     min(run_id::text)::uuid AS run_id,
    body     ( SELECT latest_read.published_at
    body            FROM latest_read) AS published_at
    body    FROM current_revision
    body   WHERE geography_status = 'resolved'::text
    body   GROUP BY (
    body         CASE declaration_type
    body             WHEN 'DR'::text THEN 'major_disaster_declarations'::text
    body             WHEN 'EM'::text THEN 'emergency_declarations'::text
    body             ELSE 'fire_management_declarations'::text
    body         END), geo_id, (EXTRACT(year FROM declaration_date)::integer);

v gold_fema_nri.measure_definition
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column stream text
    column observation_basis text
    body WITH hazard(prefix, hazard_key, hazard_name) AS (
    body          VALUES ('AVLN'::text,'avalanche'::text,'Avalanche'::text), ('CFLD'::text,'coastal_flooding'::text,'Coastal Flooding'::text), ('CWAV'::text,'cold_wave'::text,'Cold Wave'::text), ('DRGT'::text,'drought'::text,'Drought'::text), ('ERQK'::text,'earthquake'::text,'Earthquake'::text), ('HAIL'::text,'hail'::text,'Hail'::text), ('HWAV'::text,'heat_wave'::text,'Heat Wave'::text), ('HRCN'::text,'hurricane'::text,'Hurricane'::text), ('ISTM'::text,'ice_storm'::text,'Ice Storm'::text), ('LNDS'::text,'landslide'::text,'Landslide'::text), ('LTNG'::text,'lightning'::text,'Lightning'::text), ('IFLD'::text,'inland_flooding'::text,'Inland Flooding'::text), ('SWND'::text,'strong_wind'::text,'Strong Wind'::text), ('TRND'::text,'tornado'::text,'Tornado'::text), ('TSUN'::text,'tsunami'::text,'Tsunami'::text), ('VLCN'::text,'volcanic_activity'::text,'Volcanic Activity'::text), ('WFIR'::text,'wildfire'::text,'Wildfire'::text), ('WNTW'::text,'winter_weather'::text,'Winter Weather'::text)
    body         ), nri_basis(text) AS (
    body          VALUES (((('FEMA National Risk Index: a modelled estimate for planning, not a measurement; '::text || 'expected annual loss is annualized frequency times exposure times historic loss '::text) || 'ratio, in dollars per year, with no margin of error, and methods change between '::text) || 'versions. National Risk Index data: Federal Emergency Management Agency, FEMA '::text) || 'National Risk Index.'::text)
    body         )
    body  SELECT 'expected_annual_loss'::text AS measure,
    body     'Expected Annual Loss - Total - Composite'::text AS measure_label,
    body     'dollars per year'::text AS unit,
    body     'nri'::text AS stream,
    body     nri_basis.text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM nri_basis
    body UNION ALL
    body  SELECT 'expected_annual_loss_'::text || hazard.hazard_key AS measure,
    body     hazard.hazard_name || ' - Expected Annual Loss - Total'::text AS measure_label,
    body     'dollars per year'::text AS unit,
    body     'nri'::text AS stream,
    body     nri_basis.text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM hazard
    body      CROSS JOIN nri_basis
    body UNION ALL
    body  SELECT 'annualized_frequency_'::text || hazard.hazard_key AS measure,
    body     hazard.hazard_name || ' - Annualized Frequency'::text AS measure_label,
    body     'events per year'::text AS unit,
    body     'nri'::text AS stream,
    body     nri_basis.text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM hazard
    body      CROSS JOIN nri_basis
    body   WHERE hazard.prefix = ANY (ARRAY['IFLD'::text, 'TRND'::text, 'WFIR'::text, 'HRCN'::text, 'HWAV'::text])
    body UNION ALL
    body  SELECT declaration.measure,
    body     declaration.label AS measure_label,
    body     'declarations'::text AS unit,
    body     'declarations'::text AS stream,
    body     (((('FEMA disaster declarations (OpenFEMA DisasterDeclarationsSummaries): the number of '::text || 'distinct declarations of this type that designated this county, by the calendar '::text) || 'year of the declaration date; a statewide or tribal-area designation is not '::text) || 'counted toward a county, and a year with no declaration has no row. This product '::text) || 'uses the Federal Emergency Management Agency''s OpenFEMA API, but is not endorsed '::text) || 'by FEMA.'::text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('major_disaster_declarations'::text,'Major disaster declarations'::text,'DR'::text), ('emergency_declarations'::text,'Emergency declarations'::text,'EM'::text), ('fire_management_declarations'::text,'Fire management assistance declarations'::text,'FM'::text)) declaration(measure, label, declaration_type);

v gold_fema_nri.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column stream text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure AS source_object_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     stream,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     'fema_nri_json:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM gold_fema_nri.measure_definition;

v gold_fema_nri.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'FEMA_NRI'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.measure_label || ' (FEMA)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body         CASE export.stream
    body             WHEN 'nri'::text THEN 'modelled_estimate'::text
    body             ELSE 'derived_count'::text
    body         END AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_fema_nri', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'Federal Emergency Management Agency National Risk Index and OpenFEMA'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://www.fema.gov/about/openfema/data-sets/national-risk-index-data'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.release_key) AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.published_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(latest.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_fema_nri.observation_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_fema_nri.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_fema_nri.nri_observation
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column field text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text
    column year integer
    column release_key text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column rating text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    body SELECT fact.measure AS metric_key,
    body     fact.measure,
    body     fact.field,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     "right"(fact.nri_version, 4)::integer AS year,
    body     fact.nri_version AS release_key,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.missing_reason,
    body     fact.rating,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id,
    body     run.published_at
    body    FROM silver_fema_nri.nri_fact fact
    body      JOIN control.fema_nri_run run ON run.run_id = fact.run_id
    body   WHERE run.status = 'published'::text AND "right"(fact.nri_version, 4) ~ '^[0-9]{4}$'::text;

v gold_fema_nri.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column rating text
    column declarations text
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     missing_reason,
    body     rating,
    body     declarations,
    body     release_key,
    body     published_at,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_fema_nri.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, published_at DESC, run_id DESC;

v gold_fema_nri.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column rating text
    column declarations text
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT observation.metric_key,
    body     definition.measure_label,
    body     definition.unit,
    body     definition.observation_basis,
    body     observation.year,
    body     make_date(observation.year, 1, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date(observation.year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
    body     observation.geo_id,
    body     observation.geo_sk,
    body     'county'::text AS geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain('county'::text) AS geo_level,
    body     observation.value,
    body     observation.value_status,
    body     observation.missing_reason,
    body     observation.rating,
    body     observation.declarations,
    body     observation.release_key,
    body     observation.published_at,
    body     observation.source_record_id,
    body     observation.capture_id,
    body     observation.run_id
    body    FROM ( SELECT nri.metric_key,
    body             nri.year,
    body             nri.geo_id,
    body             nri.geo_sk,
    body             nri.geography_status,
    body             nri.value,
    body             nri.value_status,
    body             nri.missing_reason,
    body             nri.rating,
    body             NULL::text AS declarations,
    body             nri.release_key,
    body             nri.published_at,
    body             nri.source_record_id,
    body             nri.capture_id,
    body             nri.run_id
    body            FROM gold_fema_nri.nri_observation nri
    body         UNION ALL
    body          SELECT counted.metric_key,
    body             counted.year,
    body             counted.geo_id,
    body             counted.geo_sk,
    body             'resolved'::text,
    body             counted.value::numeric AS value,
    body             'valid'::text,
    body             NULL::text,
    body             NULL::text,
    body             counted.declarations,
    body             'OpenFEMA '::text || to_char((counted.last_refresh AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text),
    body             counted.published_at,
    body             md5((((counted.metric_key || '|'::text) || counted.geo_id) || '|'::text) || counted.year::text) AS md5,
    body             counted.capture_id,
    body             counted.run_id
    body            FROM gold_fema_nri.declaration_count counted) observation
    body      JOIN gold_fema_nri.measure_definition definition ON definition.measure = observation.metric_key
    body   WHERE observation.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unmapped'::text]);

v gold_fhfa_hpi.measure_definition
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    body SELECT measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     (((('FHFA all-transactions House Price Index (annual, developmental): a '::text || 'nominal, not seasonally adjusted repeat-sales index of conventional '::text) || 'single-family mortgages bought or guaranteed by Fannie Mae and Freddie '::text) || 'Mac, not a price level; jumbo, FHA/VA, condominium and multi-unit '::text) || 'loans are out of scope. This product uses FHFA data but is neither '::text) || 'endorsed nor certified by FHFA.'::text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('annual_change_pct'::text,'Annual change in the house price index'::text,'percent'::text), ('hpi_base_2000'::text,'House price index, 2000 = 100'::text,'index, 2000 = 100'::text)) measure(measure, measure_label, unit);

v gold_fhfa_hpi.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure AS source_object_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     'fhfa_hpi_xlsx:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM gold_fhfa_hpi.measure_definition;

v gold_fhfa_hpi.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'FHFA_HPI'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.measure_label || ' (FHFA all-transactions, nominal, not seasonally adjusted)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_fhfa_hpi', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'Federal Housing Finance Agency House Price Index'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://www.fhfa.gov/data/hpi/datasets'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.release_key) AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.published_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(latest.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_fhfa_hpi.observation_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_fhfa_hpi.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_fhfa_hpi.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column fips_code text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric(12,2)
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column provider_vintage date
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     fips_code,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     missing_reason,
    body     provider_vintage,
    body     release_key,
    body     published_at,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_fhfa_hpi.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, provider_vintage DESC, published_at DESC, run_id DESC;

v gold_fhfa_hpi.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column fips_code text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric(12,2)
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column provider_vintage date
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body WITH published AS (
    body          SELECT file.run_id,
    body             file.capture_id,
    body             file.provider_vintage,
    body             file.published_at,
    body             to_char(file.provider_vintage::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) ||
    body                 CASE
    body                     WHEN row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY file.kind, file.provider_vintage ORDER BY file.published_at, file.run_id) > 1 THEN '.'::text || row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY file.kind, file.provider_vintage ORDER BY file.published_at, file.run_id)::text
    body                     ELSE ''::text
    body                 END AS release_key
    body            FROM control.fhfa_hpi_file file
    body           WHERE file.status = 'published'::text
    body         )
    body  SELECT fact.measure AS metric_key,
    body     fact.measure,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.observation_basis,
    body     fact.year,
    body     make_date(fact.year, 1, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date(fact.year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     'county'::text AS geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain('county'::text) AS geo_level,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.fips_code,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.missing_reason,
    body     published.provider_vintage,
    body     published.release_key,
    body     published.published_at,
    body     fact.retrieved_at,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id
    body    FROM silver_fhfa_hpi.fact_observation fact
    body      JOIN published ON published.run_id = fact.run_id
    body      JOIN gold_fhfa_hpi.measure_definition measure ON measure.measure = fact.measure
    body   WHERE fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unmapped'::text]);

r gold_fred.dim_fred_series
    column fred_series_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_fred.dim_fred_series_fred_series_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column series_title text
    column source_provider text
    column original_source_name text
    column is_primary_source_series boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
    column is_republished_series boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
    column frequency text
    column units text
    column seasonal_adjustment text
    column transformation_method text
    column realtime_available boolean
    column lineage_notes text
    column reference_url text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_fred_series_pkey PRIMARY KEY (fred_series_sk)
    constraint dim_fred_series_series_id_key UNIQUE (series_id)
    index dim_fred_series_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_fred_series_pkey ON gold_fred.dim_fred_series USING btree (fred_series_sk)
    index dim_fred_series_series_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_fred_series_series_id_key ON gold_fred.dim_fred_series USING btree (series_id)

v gold_fred.fact_fred_observation
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column time_sk integer
    column observation_date date
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column fred_series_sk bigint
    column value numeric
    column realtime_start date
    column realtime_end date
    column frequency character varying(50)
    column units character varying(255)
    column seasonal_adjustment character varying(50)
    column transform_applied text
    column source_provider text
    column as_of_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    body SELECT 'us:1'::text AS geo_id,
    body     'NATIONAL'::text AS geo_level,
    body     s.time_sk,
    body     s.observation_date,
    body     s.duration_start,
    body     s.duration_end,
    body     fs.fred_series_sk,
    body     s.value,
    body     s.realtime_start,
    body     s.realtime_end,
    body     s.frequency,
    body     s.unit_of_measure AS units,
    body     s.seasonal_adjustment,
    body     NULL::text AS transform_applied,
    body     'FRED'::text AS source_provider,
    body     s.ingested_at::date AS as_of_date,
    body     s.ingested_at AS updated_at
    body    FROM silver_fred.fact_economic_indicators s
    body      JOIN gold_fred.dim_fred_series fs ON fs.series_id = s.series_id::text
    body   WHERE s.is_missing = false AND s.series_id IS NOT NULL AND s.series_id::text <> ''::text;

v gold_fred.fact_observation
    column source_code text
    column source text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column release_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_name text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column unit text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column dataset text
    column vintage_year integer
    column vintage text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT source_code,
    body     source_code AS source,
    body     observation_date,
    body     observation_date::text AS period,
    body     duration_start,
    body     duration_end,
    body     time_sk,
    body     as_of_date,
    body     as_of_date AS release_date,
    body     updated_at,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_level,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_name(place_name, county_name, state_name, geo_id) AS geo_name,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     geo_latitude,
    body     geo_longitude,
    body     metric_code,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     value,
    body     value_type,
    body     units,
    body     units AS unit,
    body     seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     'fred'::text AS dataset_code,
    body     'fred'::text AS dataset,
    body     NULL::integer AS vintage_year,
    body     NULL::text AS vintage,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_fred.rpt_fred_observations;

v gold_fred.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'FRED'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     series.series_id AS source_object_key,
    body     'series'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     COALESCE(NULLIF(series.series_title, ''::text), series.series_id) AS metric_display_name,
    body     series.units,
    body     NULL::text AS measure_kind,
    body     COALESCE(served.valid_geo_grains, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN lower(COALESCE(series.frequency, ''::text)) ~~ '%daily%'::text THEN ARRAY['DAILY'::text]
    body             WHEN lower(COALESCE(series.frequency, ''::text)) ~~ '%weekly%'::text THEN ARRAY['WEEKLY'::text]
    body             WHEN lower(COALESCE(series.frequency, ''::text)) ~~ '%quarter%'::text THEN ARRAY['QUARTERLY'::text]
    body             WHEN lower(COALESCE(series.frequency, ''::text)) ~~ '%annual%'::text THEN ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text]
    body             ELSE ARRAY['MONTHLY'::text]
    body         END AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_fred', 'relation', 'fact_fred_observation', 'key', series.series_id) AS physical_lineage,
    body     COALESCE(max(fact.updated_at), series.updated_at)::text AS source_watermark,
    body     NULL::uuid AS source_run_id,
    body     COALESCE(max(fact.updated_at), series.updated_at) AS publication_time,
    body     'Federal Reserve Economic Data'::text AS source_name,
    body     'economic-data-aggregator'::text AS source_type,
    body     series.reference_url
    body    FROM gold_fred.dim_fred_series series
    body      LEFT JOIN gold_fred.fact_fred_observation fact ON fact.fred_series_sk = series.fred_series_sk
    body      LEFT JOIN ( SELECT latest.metric_code,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_level))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains
    body            FROM gold_fred.mv_fred_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_code) served ON served.metric_code = ('FRED:'::text || series.series_id)
    body   GROUP BY series.fred_series_sk, served.valid_geo_grains;

r gold_fred.mv_fred_latest
    column source_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'FRED'::text
    column observation_date date NOT NULL
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'us:1'::text
    column geo_level text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NATIONAL'::text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column series_title text
    column value numeric NOT NULL
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column frequency text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column source_provider text
    column original_source_name text
    column is_primary_source_series boolean
    column is_republished_series boolean
    column transformation_method text
    column realtime_start date
    column realtime_end date
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    index ix_mv_fred_latest_metric_geo CREATE INDEX ix_mv_fred_latest_metric_geo ON gold_fred.mv_fred_latest USING btree (metric_code, geo_id)
    index ix_mv_fred_latest_observation_date CREATE INDEX ix_mv_fred_latest_observation_date ON gold_fred.mv_fred_latest USING btree (observation_date)
    index ix_mv_fred_latest_source_metric CREATE INDEX ix_mv_fred_latest_source_metric ON gold_fred.mv_fred_latest USING btree (source_code, metric_code)
    index uq_mv_fred_latest CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_fred_latest ON gold_fred.mv_fred_latest USING btree (series_id, COALESCE(metric_code, ''::text), COALESCE(realtime_start, '0001-01-01'::date), COALESCE(realtime_end, '0001-01-01'::date))

r gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_level text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column latitude double precision
    column longitude double precision
    column geo_geom geometry(MultiPolygon,4326)
    column boundary_vintage integer
    column geography_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'current'::text
    column retired_at timestamp with time zone
    column refreshed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column area_name text
    constraint ck_dim_geo_latest_geography_state CHECK ((geography_state = ANY (ARRAY['current'::text, 'retired'::text])))
    constraint dim_geo_latest_pkey PRIMARY KEY (geo_id)
    index dim_geo_latest_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_geo_latest_pkey ON gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest USING btree (geo_id)
    index ix_gold_glossary_dim_geo_latest_geom CREATE INDEX ix_gold_glossary_dim_geo_latest_geom ON gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest USING gist (geo_geom)
    index ix_gold_glossary_dim_geo_latest_state CREATE INDEX ix_gold_glossary_dim_geo_latest_state ON gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest USING btree (geography_state)

    column county_name text

    column geo_longitude double precision

r gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog
    column metric_catalog_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog_metric_catalog_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column metric_code text NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column source_object_type text NOT NULL
    column source_object_key text
    column metric_display_name text NOT NULL
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY[]::text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY[]::text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column harvested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column freshness_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'current'::text
    column missing_harvest_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_freshness_state_check CHECK ((freshness_state = ANY (ARRAY['current'::text, 'stale'::text, 'retired'::text])))
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_metric_code_key UNIQUE (metric_code)
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_missing_harvest_count_check CHECK ((missing_harvest_count >= 0))
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_pkey PRIMARY KEY (metric_catalog_sk)
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_source_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_code) REFERENCES gold_glossary.dim_source_system(source_code)
    constraint dim_metric_catalog_source_code_source_object_type_source_ob_key UNIQUE (source_code, source_object_type, source_object_key)
    index dim_metric_catalog_metric_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_metric_catalog_metric_code_key ON gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog USING btree (metric_code)
    index dim_metric_catalog_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_metric_catalog_pkey ON gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog USING btree (metric_catalog_sk)
    index dim_metric_catalog_source_code_source_object_type_source_ob_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_metric_catalog_source_code_source_object_type_source_ob_key ON gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog USING btree (source_code, source_object_type, source_object_key)
    index metric_catalog_source_freshness_idx CREATE INDEX metric_catalog_source_freshness_idx ON gold_glossary.dim_metric_catalog USING btree (source_code, freshness_state)

r gold_glossary.dim_source_system
    column source_system_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('gold_glossary.dim_source_system_source_system_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column source_name text NOT NULL
    column source_type text NOT NULL
    column reference_url text
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column first_harvested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_harvested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_source_system_pkey PRIMARY KEY (source_system_sk)
    constraint dim_source_system_source_code_key UNIQUE (source_code)
    index dim_source_system_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_source_system_pkey ON gold_glossary.dim_source_system USING btree (source_system_sk)
    index dim_source_system_source_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_source_system_source_code_key ON gold_glossary.dim_source_system USING btree (source_code)

v gold_glossary.geo_relationship
    column geo_id text
    column related_geo_id text
    column relationship_type text
    column geography_vintage integer
    column overlap_area_m2 numeric
    column overlap_weight numeric
    column evidence_source text
    body SELECT parent.geo_id,
    body     related.geo_id AS related_geo_id,
    body     relationship.relationship_type,
    body     relationship.geography_vintage,
    body     relationship.overlap_area_m2,
    body     relationship.overlap_weight,
    body     relationship.evidence_source
    body    FROM silver_ref.bridge_geo_relationship_version relationship
    body      JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_entity parent_entity ON parent_entity.geo_sk = relationship.parent_geo_sk
    body      JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_entity related_entity ON related_entity.geo_sk = relationship.related_geo_sk
    body      JOIN gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest parent ON parent.geo_id = parent_entity.geo_id AND parent.geography_state = 'current'::text
    body      JOIN gold_glossary.dim_geo_latest related ON related.geo_id = related_entity.geo_id AND related.geography_state = 'current'::text
    body   WHERE (relationship.relationship_type = ANY (ARRAY['contains'::text, 'intersects'::text, 'adjacent'::text])) AND relationship.geography_vintage = (( SELECT max(newest.geography_vintage) AS max
    body            FROM silver_ref.bridge_geo_relationship_version newest
    body           WHERE newest.parent_geo_sk = relationship.parent_geo_sk AND newest.relationship_type = relationship.relationship_type));

r gold_glossary.publisher_harvest_state
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column publisher_contract_version text NOT NULL
    column last_source_watermark text
    column last_source_run_id uuid
    column last_publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column last_harvest_started_at timestamp with time zone
    column last_harvest_completed_at timestamp with time zone
    column status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::text
    column last_error text
    column last_content_fingerprint text
    column last_harvest_forced boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
    constraint publisher_harvest_state_pkey PRIMARY KEY (source_code)
    constraint publisher_harvest_state_source_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_code) REFERENCES gold_glossary.dim_source_system(source_code)
    constraint publisher_harvest_state_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'running'::text, 'success'::text, 'failed'::text, 'stale'::text])))
    index publisher_harvest_state_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publisher_harvest_state_pkey ON gold_glossary.publisher_harvest_state USING btree (source_code)

r gold_glossary.publisher_registry
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column publisher_schema text NOT NULL
    column publisher_view text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'metric_publisher'::text
    column publisher_contract_version text NOT NULL
    column discovery_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'::text
    column last_discovered_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_error text
    constraint publisher_registry_discovery_status_check CHECK ((discovery_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'invalid'::text, 'unavailable'::text, 'retired'::text])))
    constraint publisher_registry_pkey PRIMARY KEY (source_code)
    constraint publisher_registry_publisher_schema_publisher_view_key UNIQUE (publisher_schema, publisher_view)
    index publisher_registry_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publisher_registry_pkey ON gold_glossary.publisher_registry USING btree (source_code)
    index publisher_registry_publisher_schema_publisher_view_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publisher_registry_publisher_schema_publisher_view_key ON gold_glossary.publisher_registry USING btree (publisher_schema, publisher_view)

v gold_hud_fmr_il.measure_definition
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column dataset text
    column observation_basis text
    body SELECT measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     dataset,
    body         CASE dataset
    body             WHEN 'fmr'::text THEN ((((('HUD Fair Market Rent: the gross rent (shelter plus utilities) HUD sets '::text || 'for the fiscal year from the 40th percentile of rents recent movers '::text) || 'paid for standard-quality units in the HUD FMR area this county '::text) || 'belongs to; an area value repeated for each county, not a county '::text) || 'estimate and not the ACS median rent. Source: U.S. Department of '::text) || 'Housing and Urban Development, HUD User. This product uses the HUD User Data '::text) || 'API but is not endorsed or certified by HUD User.'::text
    body             ELSE (((('HUD Section 8 income limits: program eligibility thresholds and the '::text || 'area median family income they are based on, set for the fiscal year '::text) || 'for the HUD area this county belongs to; an area value repeated for '::text) || 'each county, not a county estimate and not the ACS median income. '::text) || 'Source: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, HUD User. This '::text) || 'product uses the HUD User Data API but is not endorsed or certified by HUD User.'::text
    body         END AS observation_basis
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('fmr_0br'::text,'Fair Market Rent, efficiency'::text,'dollars per month'::text,'fmr'::text), ('fmr_1br'::text,'Fair Market Rent, one bedroom'::text,'dollars per month'::text,'fmr'::text), ('fmr_2br'::text,'Fair Market Rent, two bedrooms'::text,'dollars per month'::text,'fmr'::text), ('fmr_3br'::text,'Fair Market Rent, three bedrooms'::text,'dollars per month'::text,'fmr'::text), ('fmr_4br'::text,'Fair Market Rent, four bedrooms'::text,'dollars per month'::text,'fmr'::text), ('median_family_income'::text,'HUD area median family income'::text,'dollars per year'::text,'il'::text), ('income_limit_30_4p'::text,'Extremely low income limit (30%), four-person household'::text,'dollars per year'::text,'il'::text), ('income_limit_50_4p'::text,'Very low income limit (50%), four-person household'::text,'dollars per year'::text,'il'::text), ('income_limit_80_4p'::text,'Low income limit (80%), four-person household'::text,'dollars per year'::text,'il'::text)) measure(measure, measure_label, unit, dataset);

v gold_hud_fmr_il.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure AS source_object_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     'hud_fmr_il_xlsx:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM gold_hud_fmr_il.measure_definition;

v gold_hud_fmr_il.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'HUD_FMR_IL'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.measure_label || ' (HUD program reference value)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_hud_fmr_il', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'HUD Fair Market Rents and Section 8 Income Limits'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://www.huduser.gov/portal/datasets/fmr.html'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.release_key) AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.published_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(latest.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_hud_fmr_il.observation_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_hud_fmr_il.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_hud_fmr_il.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column dataset text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column effective_date date
    column edition text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column fips_code text
    column hud_area_code text
    column hud_area_name text
    column metro boolean
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     dataset,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     effective_date,
    body     edition,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     fips_code,
    body     hud_area_code,
    body     hud_area_name,
    body     metro,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     missing_reason,
    body     release_key,
    body     published_at,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_hud_fmr_il.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, (edition = 'revised'::text) DESC, published_at DESC, run_id DESC;

v gold_hud_fmr_il.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column dataset text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column effective_date date
    column edition text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column fips_code text
    column hud_area_code text
    column hud_area_name text
    column metro boolean
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT fact.measure AS metric_key,
    body     fact.measure,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.observation_basis,
    body     fact.dataset,
    body     fact.fiscal_year AS year,
    body     make_date(fact.fiscal_year - 1, 10, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date(fact.fiscal_year, 9, 30) AS period_end,
    body     fact.effective_date,
    body     fact.edition,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) AS geo_level,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.fips_code,
    body     fact.hud_area_code,
    body     fact.hud_area_name,
    body     fact.metro,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.missing_reason,
    body     ('FY'::text || fact.fiscal_year::text) ||
    body         CASE fact.edition
    body             WHEN 'revised'::text THEN '-revised'::text
    body             ELSE ''::text
    body         END AS release_key,
    body     file.published_at,
    body     fact.retrieved_at,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id
    body    FROM silver_hud_fmr_il.fact_observation fact
    body      JOIN control.hud_fmr_il_file file ON file.run_id = fact.run_id
    body      JOIN gold_hud_fmr_il.measure_definition measure ON measure.measure = fact.measure
    body   WHERE file.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unmapped'::text]));

v gold_irs_migration.flow_latest
    column direction text
    column year_pair text
    column year1 integer
    column year2 integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column subject_geo_id text
    column subject_geo_sk bigint
    column category text
    column counterpart_code text
    column counterpart_label text
    column origin_geo_id text
    column origin_geo_sk bigint
    column destination_geo_id text
    column destination_geo_sk bigint
    column returns bigint
    column individuals bigint
    column agi numeric
    column value_status text
    column value_source text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (direction, year_pair, subject_geo_id, counterpart_code) direction,
    body     year_pair,
    body     year1,
    body     year2,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     subject_geo_id,
    body     subject_geo_sk,
    body     category,
    body     counterpart_code,
    body     counterpart_label,
    body     origin_geo_id,
    body     origin_geo_sk,
    body     destination_geo_id,
    body     destination_geo_sk,
    body     returns,
    body     individuals,
    body     agi,
    body     value_status,
    body     value_source,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     release_key,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_irs_migration.flow_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY direction, year_pair, subject_geo_id, counterpart_code, retrieved_at DESC, capture_id DESC;

v gold_irs_migration.flow_revision
    column direction text
    column year_pair text
    column year1 integer
    column year2 integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column subject_geo_id text
    column subject_geo_sk bigint
    column category text
    column counterpart_code text
    column counterpart_label text
    column origin_geo_id text
    column origin_geo_sk bigint
    column destination_geo_id text
    column destination_geo_sk bigint
    column returns bigint
    column individuals bigint
    column agi numeric
    column value_status text
    column value_source text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT fact.direction,
    body     fact.year_pair,
    body     fact.year1,
    body     fact.year2,
    body     make_date(fact.year1, 1, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date(fact.year2, 12, 31) AS period_end,
    body     fact.subject_geo_id,
    body     fact.subject_geo_sk,
    body     fact.category,
    body     fact.counterpart_code,
    body     fact.counterpart_label,
    body     fact.origin_geo_id,
    body     fact.origin_geo_sk,
    body     fact.destination_geo_id,
    body     fact.destination_geo_sk,
    body     fact.returns,
    body     fact.individuals,
    body     fact.agi,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.retrieved_at,
    body     to_char((fact.retrieved_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'::text) AS release_key,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id
    body    FROM silver_irs_migration.fact_flow fact
    body      JOIN control.irs_migration_file file ON file.capture_id = fact.capture_id
    body   WHERE file.status = 'published'::text;

v gold_irs_migration.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column direction text
    column category text
    column category_label text
    column measure text
    column unit text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT (((direction.direction || ':'::text) || category.category) || ':'::text) || measure.measure AS source_object_key,
    body     direction.direction,
    body     category.category,
    body     category.label AS category_label,
    body     measure.measure,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     'irs_soi_county_migration_csv:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('inflow'::text), ('outflow'::text)) direction(direction)
    body      CROSS JOIN ( VALUES ('total_us_and_foreign'::text,'Total migration, US and foreign'::text), ('total_us'::text,'Total migration, US'::text), ('total_same_state'::text,'Total migration, same state'::text), ('total_different_state'::text,'Total migration, different state'::text), ('total_foreign'::text,'Total migration, foreign'::text), ('non_migrants'::text,'Non-migrants'::text)) category(category, label)
    body      CROSS JOIN ( VALUES ('returns'::text,'returns'::text), ('individuals'::text,'individuals'::text), ('agi'::text,'thousands of dollars'::text)) measure(measure, unit);

v gold_irs_migration.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'IRS_MIGRATION'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     ((((export.category_label || ', '::text) || export.direction) || ' ('::text) || export.unit) || ', IRS SOI county migration)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_irs_migration', 'relation', 'total_observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'IRS Statistics of Income county-to-county migration data'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-administrative-records'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://www.irs.gov/statistics/soi-tax-stats-migration-data'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.year_pair) AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.retrieved_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(file.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_irs_migration.total_observation_latest latest
    body              JOIN control.irs_migration_file file ON file.capture_id = latest.capture_id
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_irs_migration.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_irs_migration.total_observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column direction text
    column category text
    column measure text
    column unit text
    column year_pair text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column value_source text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year_pair) metric_key,
    body     direction,
    body     category,
    body     measure,
    body     unit,
    body     year_pair,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     value_source,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     release_key,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_irs_migration.total_observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year_pair, retrieved_at DESC, capture_id DESC;

v gold_irs_migration.total_observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column direction text
    column category text
    column measure text
    column unit text
    column year_pair text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column value_source text
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column release_key text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT (((revision.direction || ':'::text) || revision.category) || ':'::text) || measure.measure AS metric_key,
    body     revision.direction,
    body     revision.category,
    body     measure.measure,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     revision.year_pair,
    body     revision.year2 AS year,
    body     revision.period_start,
    body     revision.period_end,
    body     revision.subject_geo_id AS geo_id,
    body     revision.subject_geo_sk AS geo_sk,
    body     'county'::text AS geo_type,
    body         CASE measure.measure
    body             WHEN 'returns'::text THEN revision.returns::numeric
    body             WHEN 'individuals'::text THEN revision.individuals::numeric
    body             ELSE revision.agi
    body         END AS value,
    body     revision.value_status,
    body     revision.value_source,
    body     revision.retrieved_at,
    body     revision.release_key,
    body     revision.source_record_id,
    body     revision.capture_id,
    body     revision.run_id
    body    FROM gold_irs_migration.flow_revision revision
    body      CROSS JOIN ( VALUES ('returns'::text,'returns'::text), ('individuals'::text,'individuals'::text), ('agi'::text,'thousands of dollars'::text)) measure(measure, unit)
    body   WHERE revision.category = ANY (ARRAY['total_us_and_foreign'::text, 'total_us'::text, 'total_same_state'::text, 'total_different_state'::text, 'total_foreign'::text, 'non_migrants'::text]);

v gold_nass.crop_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column product_label text
    column release_watermark text
    column slice_mode text
    column source_desc text
    column sector_desc text
    column group_desc text
    column commodity_desc text
    column class_desc text
    column prodn_practice_desc text
    column util_practice_desc text
    column commodity_sk text
    column statisticcat_desc text
    column short_desc text
    column unit_desc text
    column freq_desc text
    column value_kind text
    column calculation_basis text
    column additive_behavior text
    column additive_behavior_known boolean
    column statistic_sk text
    column domain_desc text
    column domaincat_desc text
    column domain_sk text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_status text
    column geo_source_code text
    column agg_level_desc text
    column location_desc text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
