    column year integer
    column begin_code text
    column end_code text
    column reference_period_desc text
    column week_ending date
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column suppression_code text
    column cv_source text
    column cv_value numeric
    column cv_status text
    column cv_symbol text
    column load_time timestamp without time zone
    column methodology_url text
    column release_expectation text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column slice_key text
    body SELECT fact.observation_sk,
    body     fact.product_id,
    body     release.label AS product_label,
    body     fact.release_watermark,
    body     release.slice_mode,
    body     fact.source_desc,
    body     commodity.sector_desc,
    body     commodity.group_desc,
    body     commodity.commodity_desc,
    body     commodity.class_desc,
    body     commodity.prodn_practice_desc,
    body     commodity.util_practice_desc,
    body     fact.commodity_sk,
    body     statistic.statisticcat_desc,
    body     statistic.short_desc,
    body     statistic.unit_desc,
    body     statistic.freq_desc,
    body     statistic.value_kind,
    body     statistic.calculation_basis,
    body     statistic.additive_behavior,
    body     statistic.additive_behavior_known,
    body     fact.statistic_sk,
    body     domain.domain_desc,
    body     domain.domaincat_desc,
    body     fact.domain_sk,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     fact.geo_type,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.geo_source_code,
    body     fact.agg_level_desc,
    body     fact.location_desc,
    body     fact.state_fips,
    body     fact.county_fips,
    body     fact.year,
    body     fact.begin_code,
    body     fact.end_code,
    body     fact.reference_period_desc,
    body     fact.week_ending,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.suppression_code,
    body     fact.cv_source,
    body     fact.cv_value,
    body     fact.cv_status,
    body     fact.cv_symbol,
    body     fact.load_time,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.release_expectation,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.slice_key
    body    FROM silver_nass.fact_crop_observation fact
    body      JOIN silver_nass.dim_dataset_release release ON release.product_id = fact.product_id AND release.release_watermark = fact.release_watermark
    body      JOIN silver_nass.dim_commodity commodity USING (commodity_sk)
    body      JOIN silver_nass.dim_statistic statistic USING (statistic_sk)
    body      JOIN silver_nass.dim_domain domain USING (domain_sk)
    body   WHERE release.status = 'published'::text AND fact.geography_status <> 'unsupported'::text;

v gold_nass.crop_series
    column series_id text
    column product_id text
    column commodity_sk text
    column statistic_sk text
    column domain_sk text
    column sector_desc text
    column group_desc text
    column commodity_desc text
    column class_desc text
    column prodn_practice_desc text
    column util_practice_desc text
    column statisticcat_desc text
    column short_desc text
    column unit_desc text
    column value_kind text
    column additive_behavior text
    column additive_behavior_known boolean
    column domain_desc text
    column domaincat_desc text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_type text
    column agg_level_desc text
    column freq_desc text
    column source_desc text
    column first_year integer
    column last_year integer
    column observation_count bigint
    column numeric_observation_count bigint
    column non_numeric_observation_count bigint
    column latest_release_watermark text
    body SELECT md5((((((((((product_id || '|'::text) || commodity_sk) || '|'::text) || statistic_sk) || '|'::text) || domain_sk) || '|'::text) || COALESCE(geo_id, geo_source_code)) || '|'::text) || freq_desc) AS series_id,
    body     product_id,
    body     commodity_sk,
    body     statistic_sk,
    body     domain_sk,
    body     sector_desc,
    body     group_desc,
    body     commodity_desc,
    body     class_desc,
    body     prodn_practice_desc,
    body     util_practice_desc,
    body     statisticcat_desc,
    body     short_desc,
    body     unit_desc,
    body     value_kind,
    body     additive_behavior,
    body     additive_behavior_known,
    body     domain_desc,
    body     domaincat_desc,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_type,
    body     agg_level_desc,
    body     freq_desc,
    body     source_desc,
    body     min(year) AS first_year,
    body     max(year) AS last_year,
    body     count(*) AS observation_count,
    body     count(*) FILTER (WHERE value_status = 'valid'::text) AS numeric_observation_count,
    body     count(*) FILTER (WHERE value_status <> 'valid'::text) AS non_numeric_observation_count,
    body     max(release_watermark) AS latest_release_watermark
    body    FROM gold_nass.crop_observation observation
    body   GROUP BY product_id, commodity_sk, statistic_sk, domain_sk, sector_desc, group_desc, commodity_desc, class_desc, prodn_practice_desc, util_practice_desc, statisticcat_desc, short_desc, unit_desc, value_kind, additive_behavior, additive_behavior_known, domain_desc, domaincat_desc, geo_id, geo_source_code, geo_type, agg_level_desc, freq_desc, source_desc;

v gold_nass.latest_release_observation
    column observation_sk bigint
    column product_id text
    column product_label text
    column release_watermark text
    column slice_mode text
    column source_desc text
    column sector_desc text
    column group_desc text
    column commodity_desc text
    column class_desc text
    column prodn_practice_desc text
    column util_practice_desc text
    column commodity_sk text
    column statisticcat_desc text
    column short_desc text
    column unit_desc text
    column freq_desc text
    column value_kind text
    column calculation_basis text
    column additive_behavior text
    column additive_behavior_known boolean
    column statistic_sk text
    column domain_desc text
    column domaincat_desc text
    column domain_sk text
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_status text
    column geo_source_code text
    column agg_level_desc text
    column location_desc text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column year integer
    column begin_code text
    column end_code text
    column reference_period_desc text
    column week_ending date
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column suppression_code text
    column cv_source text
    column cv_value numeric
    column cv_status text
    column cv_symbol text
    column load_time timestamp without time zone
    column methodology_url text
    column release_expectation text
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column slice_key text
    body SELECT observation.observation_sk,
    body     observation.product_id,
    body     observation.product_label,
    body     observation.release_watermark,
    body     observation.slice_mode,
    body     observation.source_desc,
    body     observation.sector_desc,
    body     observation.group_desc,
    body     observation.commodity_desc,
    body     observation.class_desc,
    body     observation.prodn_practice_desc,
    body     observation.util_practice_desc,
    body     observation.commodity_sk,
    body     observation.statisticcat_desc,
    body     observation.short_desc,
    body     observation.unit_desc,
    body     observation.freq_desc,
    body     observation.value_kind,
    body     observation.calculation_basis,
    body     observation.additive_behavior,
    body     observation.additive_behavior_known,
    body     observation.statistic_sk,
    body     observation.domain_desc,
    body     observation.domaincat_desc,
    body     observation.domain_sk,
    body     observation.geo_id,
    body     observation.geo_sk,
    body     observation.geo_type,
    body     observation.geography_status,
    body     observation.geo_source_code,
    body     observation.agg_level_desc,
    body     observation.location_desc,
    body     observation.state_fips,
    body     observation.county_fips,
    body     observation.year,
    body     observation.begin_code,
    body     observation.end_code,
    body     observation.reference_period_desc,
    body     observation.week_ending,
    body     observation.value_source,
    body     observation.value,
    body     observation.value_status,
    body     observation.suppression_code,
    body     observation.cv_source,
    body     observation.cv_value,
    body     observation.cv_status,
    body     observation.cv_symbol,
    body     observation.load_time,
    body     observation.methodology_url,
    body     observation.release_expectation,
    body     observation.source_record_id,
    body     observation.capture_id,
    body     observation.slice_key
    body    FROM gold_nass.crop_observation observation
    body      JOIN ( SELECT dim_dataset_release.product_id,
    body             max(dim_dataset_release.release_watermark) AS release_watermark
    body            FROM silver_nass.dim_dataset_release
    body           WHERE dim_dataset_release.status = 'published'::text
    body           GROUP BY dim_dataset_release.product_id) latest ON latest.product_id = observation.product_id AND latest.release_watermark = observation.release_watermark;

v gold_nass.measure_export
    column source_dataset text
    column source_measure_code text
    column display_name text
    column statisticcat_desc text
    column unit text
    column freq_desc text
    column value_kind text
    column calculation_basis text
    column additive_behavior text
    column additive_behavior_known boolean
    column source_program text
    column source_watermark text
    column methodology_url text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT statistic.product_id AS source_dataset,
    body     statistic.statistic_sk AS source_measure_code,
    body     statistic.short_desc AS display_name,
    body     statistic.statisticcat_desc,
    body     statistic.unit_desc AS unit,
    body     statistic.freq_desc,
    body     statistic.value_kind,
    body     statistic.calculation_basis,
    body     statistic.additive_behavior,
    body     statistic.additive_behavior_known,
    body     statistic.source_desc AS source_program,
    body     release.release_watermark AS source_watermark,
    body     release.methodology_url,
    body     release.parser_contract_version AS schema_version
    body    FROM ( SELECT release_1.product_id,
    body             statistic_1.statistic_sk,
    body             statistic_1.short_desc,
    body             statistic_1.statisticcat_desc,
    body             statistic_1.unit_desc,
    body             statistic_1.freq_desc,
    body             statistic_1.value_kind,
    body             statistic_1.calculation_basis,
    body             statistic_1.additive_behavior,
    body             statistic_1.additive_behavior_known,
    body             statistic_1.source_desc
    body            FROM silver_nass.dim_statistic statistic_1
    body              JOIN silver_nass.fact_crop_observation fact ON fact.statistic_sk = statistic_1.statistic_sk
    body              JOIN silver_nass.dim_dataset_release release_1 ON release_1.product_id = fact.product_id AND release_1.release_watermark = fact.release_watermark
    body           WHERE release_1.status = 'published'::text
    body           GROUP BY release_1.product_id, statistic_1.statistic_sk, statistic_1.short_desc, statistic_1.statisticcat_desc, statistic_1.unit_desc, statistic_1.freq_desc, statistic_1.value_kind, statistic_1.calculation_basis, statistic_1.additive_behavior, statistic_1.additive_behavior_known, statistic_1.source_desc) statistic
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.product_id,
    body             candidate.release_watermark,
    body             candidate.label,
    body             candidate.source_desc,
    body             candidate.slice_mode,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.incremental_field,
    body             candidate.release_expectation,
    body             candidate.registered_years,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.slice_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_nass.dim_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.product_id = statistic.product_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY candidate.release_watermark DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

v gold_nass.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'USDA_NASS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     (statistic.product_id || ':'::text) || statistic.statistic_sk AS source_object_key,
    body     'statistic'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     statistic.short_desc AS metric_display_name,
    body     statistic.unit_desc AS units,
    body     'source_fact'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     statistic.valid_geo_grains,
    body     statistic.valid_time_grains,
    body     statistic.additive_behavior AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_nass', 'relation', 'crop_observation', 'product_id', statistic.product_id, 'statistic_sk', statistic.statistic_sk, 'statisticcat_desc', statistic.statisticcat_desc, 'unit_desc', statistic.unit_desc) AS physical_lineage,
    body     release.release_watermark AS source_watermark,
    body     release.source_run_id,
    body     release.published_at AS publication_time,
    body     'USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-agricultural-statistics'::text AS source_type,
    body     release.methodology_url AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT fact.product_id,
    body             fact.statistic_sk,
    body             statistic_1.short_desc,
    body             statistic_1.unit_desc,
    body             statistic_1.statisticcat_desc,
    body             statistic_1.additive_behavior,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(fact.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE fact.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             array_agg(DISTINCT upper(statistic_1.freq_desc) ORDER BY (upper(statistic_1.freq_desc))) AS valid_time_grains
    body            FROM silver_nass.dim_statistic statistic_1
    body              JOIN silver_nass.fact_crop_observation fact ON fact.statistic_sk = statistic_1.statistic_sk
    body              JOIN silver_nass.dim_dataset_release release_1 ON release_1.product_id = fact.product_id AND release_1.release_watermark = fact.release_watermark
    body           WHERE release_1.status = 'published'::text AND fact.geography_status <> 'unsupported'::text
    body           GROUP BY fact.product_id, fact.statistic_sk, statistic_1.short_desc, statistic_1.unit_desc, statistic_1.statisticcat_desc, statistic_1.additive_behavior) statistic
    body      JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT candidate.product_id,
    body             candidate.release_watermark,
    body             candidate.label,
    body             candidate.source_desc,
    body             candidate.slice_mode,
    body             candidate.methodology_url,
    body             candidate.parser_contract_version,
    body             candidate.incremental_field,
    body             candidate.release_expectation,
    body             candidate.registered_years,
    body             candidate.source_run_id,
    body             candidate.source_record_count,
    body             candidate.quarantine_count,
    body             candidate.slice_count,
    body             candidate.status,
    body             candidate.reconciled_at,
    body             candidate.published_at,
    body             candidate.created_at,
    body             candidate.updated_at
    body            FROM silver_nass.dim_dataset_release candidate
    body           WHERE candidate.product_id = statistic.product_id AND candidate.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY candidate.release_watermark DESC
    body          LIMIT 1) release ON true;

v gold_nces_ccd.measure_definition
    column measure text
    column component text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    body SELECT measure,
    body     component,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     ((((((('NCES Common Core of Data (public schools): NCES publishes schools, not counties or states; '::text || 'this warehouse''s figure is the sum over the public schools that NCES''s EDGE geocode file '::text) || 'places in the county (by its five-digit county code) or state (by the school''s physical '::text) || 'state, never the BIE or DoDEA operating code), counting only values NCES flags Reported. '::text) || 'schools_without_value says how many placed schools had none, so a partial sum is never '::text) || 'silent. '::text) || definition) || ' Source: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics, Common '::text) || 'Core of Data and EDGE school geocodes.'::text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('operating_schools'::text,'directory'::text,'Operating public schools'::text,'schools'::text,'A school is counted when its directory status that year is Open, New, Added, Reopened or Changed Boundary/Agency.'::text), ('charter_schools'::text,'directory'::text,'Operating public charter schools'::text,'schools'::text,'An operating school whose directory charter flag is Yes.'::text), ('student_membership'::text,'membership'::text,'Students enrolled (membership)'::text,'students'::text,'Membership is the school''s reported enrollment count on or about October 1.'::text), ('teacher_fte'::text,'staff'::text,'Teachers (full-time equivalent)'::text,'full-time-equivalent teachers'::text,'Classroom teachers in full-time equivalents.'::text), ('frpl_eligible'::text,'lunch'::text,'Students eligible for free or reduced-price lunch'::text,'students'::text,'Free lunch is family income below 130 percent of poverty or direct certification; reduced-price is 130 to 185 percent. Since 2016-17 states may report this, direct certification, or both, and Community Eligibility Provision schools may report every student as free-eligible.'::text), ('free_lunch_eligible'::text,'lunch'::text,'Students eligible for free lunch'::text,'students'::text,'Family income below 130 percent of poverty or categorical eligibility; Community Eligibility Provision schools may report every student.'::text), ('reduced_price_lunch_eligible'::text,'lunch'::text,'Students eligible for reduced-price lunch'::text,'students'::text,'Family income from 130 to 185 percent of poverty.'::text), ('direct_certification'::text,'lunch'::text,'Students directly certified for free meals'::text,'students'::text,'Students categorically eligible and reported to USDA (FNS-742); a separate measure from free or reduced-price eligibility, never a substitute for it.'::text)) measure(measure, component, measure_label, unit, definition);

v gold_nces_ccd.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure AS source_object_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     'nces_ccd_csv:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM gold_nces_ccd.measure_definition;

v gold_nces_ccd.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'NCES_CCD'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.measure_label || ' (NCES Common Core of Data, summed from schools)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body     'derived_summary'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_nces_ccd', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'National Center for Education Statistics Common Core of Data'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://nces.ed.gov/ccd/files.asp'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.release_key) AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.published_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(latest.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_nces_ccd.observation_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_nces_ccd.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_nces_ccd.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column school_year text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column schools_with_value bigint
    column schools_without_value bigint
    column completeness text
    column ccd_file text
    column geocode_file text
    column release_key text
    column version_rank integer
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     year,
    body     school_year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     schools_with_value,
    body     schools_without_value,
    body     completeness,
    body     ccd_file,
    body     geocode_file,
    body     release_key,
    body     version_rank,
    body     published_at,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_nces_ccd.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, version_rank DESC, published_at DESC, run_id DESC;

v gold_nces_ccd.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column school_year text
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column schools_with_value bigint
    column schools_without_value bigint
    column completeness text
    column ccd_file text
    column geocode_file text
    column release_key text
    column version_rank integer
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body WITH grains AS (
    body          SELECT school.run_id,
    body             school.component,
    body             school.school_year,
    body             school.file_stem,
    body             school.release_version,
    body             school.version_rank,
    body             school.published_at,
    body             school.capture_id,
    body             school.ncessch,
    body             school.measure,
    body             school.value,
    body             school.value_status,
    body             school.dms_flag,
    body             school.geocode_file,
    body             school.state_fips,
    body             school.county_fips,
    body             school.county_geo_id,
    body             school.county_geo_sk,
    body             school.county_status,
    body             'county'::text AS geo_type,
    body             school.county_geo_id AS geo_id,
    body             school.county_geo_sk AS geo_sk
    body            FROM gold_nces_ccd.school_observation school
    body           WHERE school.county_status = 'resolved'::text
    body         UNION ALL
    body          SELECT school.run_id,
    body             school.component,
    body             school.school_year,
    body             school.file_stem,
    body             school.release_version,
    body             school.version_rank,
    body             school.published_at,
    body             school.capture_id,
    body             school.ncessch,
    body             school.measure,
    body             school.value,
    body             school.value_status,
    body             school.dms_flag,
    body             school.geocode_file,
    body             school.state_fips,
    body             school.county_fips,
    body             school.county_geo_id,
    body             school.county_geo_sk,
    body             school.county_status,
    body             'state'::text AS text,
    body             entity.geo_id,
    body             entity.geo_sk
    body            FROM gold_nces_ccd.school_observation school
    body              JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_entity entity ON entity.geo_id = ('state:'::text || school.state_fips) AND entity.geo_type = 'state'::text
    body         ), rolled AS (
    body          SELECT grains.run_id,
    body             grains.measure,
    body             grains.geo_type,
    body             grains.geo_id,
    body             min(grains.geo_sk) AS geo_sk,
    body             sum(grains.value) FILTER (WHERE grains.value_status = 'valid'::text) AS value,
    body             count(*) FILTER (WHERE grains.value_status = 'valid'::text) AS schools_with_value,
    body             count(*) FILTER (WHERE grains.value_status <> 'valid'::text) AS schools_without_value,
    body             min(grains.school_year) AS school_year,
    body             min(grains.file_stem) AS file_stem,
    body             min(grains.release_version) AS release_version,
    body             min(grains.version_rank) AS version_rank,
    body             min(grains.geocode_file) AS geocode_file,
    body             min(grains.capture_id::text)::uuid AS capture_id,
    body             min(grains.published_at) AS published_at
    body            FROM grains
    body           GROUP BY grains.run_id, grains.measure, grains.geo_type, grains.geo_id
    body         )
    body  SELECT rolled.measure AS metric_key,
    body     definition.measure_label,
    body     definition.unit,
    body     definition.observation_basis,
    body     "left"(rolled.school_year, 4)::integer AS year,
    body     rolled.school_year,
    body     make_date("left"(rolled.school_year, 4)::integer, 7, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date("right"(rolled.school_year, 4)::integer, 6, 30) AS period_end,
    body     rolled.geo_id,
    body     rolled.geo_sk,
    body     rolled.geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain(rolled.geo_type) AS geo_level,
    body     'resolved'::text AS geography_status,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN rolled.schools_with_value > 0 THEN rolled.value
    body             ELSE NULL::numeric
    body         END AS value,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN rolled.schools_with_value > 0 THEN 'valid'::text
    body             ELSE 'missing'::text
    body         END AS value_status,
    body     rolled.schools_with_value,
    body     rolled.schools_without_value,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN rolled.schools_without_value = 0 THEN 'complete'::text
    body             ELSE 'partial'::text
    body         END AS completeness,
    body     rolled.file_stem AS ccd_file,
    body     rolled.geocode_file,
    body     (((('CCD '::text || rolled.school_year) || ' v'::text) || rolled.release_version) || ' read '::text) || to_char((rolled.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'::text) AS release_key,
    body     rolled.version_rank,
    body     rolled.published_at,
    body     md5((((rolled.measure || '|'::text) || rolled.geo_id) || '|'::text) || rolled.run_id::text) AS source_record_id,
    body     rolled.capture_id,
    body     rolled.run_id
    body    FROM rolled
    body      JOIN gold_nces_ccd.measure_definition definition ON definition.measure = rolled.measure;

v gold_nces_ccd.school_observation
    column run_id uuid
    column component text
    column school_year text
    column file_stem text
    column release_version text
    column version_rank integer
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column capture_id uuid
    column ncessch text
    column measure text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column dms_flag text
    column geocode_file text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column county_geo_id text
    column county_geo_sk bigint
    column county_status text
    body WITH published AS (
    body          SELECT file.run_id,
    body             file.component,
    body             file.school_year,
    body             file.file_stem,
    body             file.release_version,
    body             file.version_rank,
    body             file.capture_id,
    body             file.payload_checksum,
    body             file.row_count,
    body             file.kept_row_count,
    body             file.status,
    body             file.published_at,
    body             file.created_at,
    body             file.updated_at
    body            FROM control.nces_ccd_file file
    body           WHERE file.status = 'published'::text AND file.component <> 'geocode'::text
    body         ), school_values AS (
    body          SELECT count.run_id,
    body             count.ncessch,
    body             count.measure,
    body             count.value,
    body             count.value_status,
    body             count.dms_flag,
    body             count.capture_id
    body            FROM silver_nces_ccd.school_count count
    body         UNION ALL
    body          SELECT directory.run_id,
    body             directory.ncessch,
    body             'operating_schools'::text,
    body             1,
    body             'valid'::text,
    body             'Reported'::text,
    body             directory.capture_id
    body            FROM silver_nces_ccd.school_directory directory
    body           WHERE directory.school_status = ANY (ARRAY['Open'::text, 'New'::text, 'Added'::text, 'Reopened'::text, 'Changed Boundary/Agency'::text])
    body         UNION ALL
    body          SELECT directory.run_id,
    body             directory.ncessch,
    body             'charter_schools'::text,
    body                 CASE
    body                     WHEN directory.charter = 'Yes'::text THEN 1
    body                     ELSE 0
    body                 END AS "case",
    body             'valid'::text,
    body             'Reported'::text,
    body             directory.capture_id
    body            FROM silver_nces_ccd.school_directory directory
    body           WHERE directory.school_status = ANY (ARRAY['Open'::text, 'New'::text, 'Added'::text, 'Reopened'::text, 'Changed Boundary/Agency'::text])
    body         )
    body  SELECT published.run_id,
    body     published.component,
    body     published.school_year,
    body     published.file_stem,
    body     published.release_version,
    body     published.version_rank,
    body     published.published_at,
    body     school_values.capture_id,
    body     school_values.ncessch,
    body     school_values.measure,
    body     school_values.value,
    body     school_values.value_status,
    body     school_values.dms_flag,
    body     placement.geocode_file,
    body     placement.state_fips,
    body     placement.county_fips,
    body     placement.county_geo_id,
    body     placement.county_geo_sk,
    body     placement.county_status
    body    FROM school_values
    body      JOIN published ON published.run_id = school_values.run_id
    body      LEFT JOIN gold_nces_ccd.school_placement placement ON placement.school_year = published.school_year AND placement.ncessch = school_values.ncessch;

v gold_nces_ccd.school_placement
    column school_year text
    column geocode_file text
    column ncessch text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column operating_state_fips text
    column county_geo_id text
    column county_geo_sk bigint
    column county_status text
    body WITH selected AS (
    body          SELECT DISTINCT ON (file.school_year) file.run_id,
    body             file.school_year,
    body             file.file_stem
    body            FROM control.nces_ccd_file file
    body           WHERE file.component = 'geocode'::text AND file.status = 'published'::text
    body           ORDER BY file.school_year, file.version_rank DESC, file.published_at DESC, file.run_id DESC
    body         )
    body  SELECT selected.school_year,
    body     selected.file_stem AS geocode_file,
    body     location.ncessch,
    body     location.state_fips,
    body     location.county_fips,
    body     location.operating_state_fips,
    body     location.geo_id AS county_geo_id,
    body     location.geo_sk AS county_geo_sk,
    body     location.geography_status AS county_status
    body    FROM silver_nces_ccd.school_location location
    body      JOIN selected ON selected.run_id = location.run_id;

v gold_noaa_normals.measure_definition
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    body SELECT measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     (((((('NOAA U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020 (annual/seasonal, by station): a 30-year normal, '::text || 'not the value of any one year. NCEI publishes normals for stations, not counties; this '::text) || 'warehouse''s county figure is the unweighted mean of the stations it places inside the '::text) || 'county boundary, counting only stations NCEI flags standard (S) or representative (R) '::text) || 'for that element. It is a derived summary, not an NCEI product. '::text) || statistic) || ' Source: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, '::text) || 'U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020.'::text AS observation_basis
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('annual_mean_temperature'::text,'Annual mean temperature normal, county station mean'::text,'degrees Fahrenheit'::text,'NCEI element ANN-TAVG-NORMAL.'::text), ('annual_mean_maximum_temperature'::text,'Annual mean daily maximum temperature normal, county station mean'::text,'degrees Fahrenheit'::text,'NCEI element ANN-TMAX-NORMAL.'::text), ('annual_mean_minimum_temperature'::text,'Annual mean daily minimum temperature normal, county station mean'::text,'degrees Fahrenheit'::text,'NCEI element ANN-TMIN-NORMAL.'::text), ('annual_precipitation'::text,'Annual precipitation normal, county station mean'::text,'inches'::text,'NCEI element ANN-PRCP-NORMAL.'::text), ('annual_heating_degree_days'::text,'Annual heating degree days normal (base 65 F), county station mean'::text,'degree days (base 65 F)'::text,'NCEI element ANN-HTDD-NORMAL.'::text), ('annual_cooling_degree_days'::text,'Annual cooling degree days normal (base 65 F), county station mean'::text,'degree days (base 65 F)'::text,'NCEI element ANN-CLDD-NORMAL.'::text)) measure(measure, measure_label, unit, statistic);

v gold_noaa_normals.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure AS source_object_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     'noaa_normals_csv:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM gold_noaa_normals.measure_definition;

v gold_noaa_normals.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'NOAA_NORMALS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.measure_label || ' (NOAA Climate Normals 1991-2020, derived county figure)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body     'derived_summary'::text AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_noaa_normals', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/land-based-station/us-climate-normals'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.release_key) AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.published_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(latest.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_noaa_normals.observation_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_noaa_normals.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_noaa_normals.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column station_count bigint
    column station_ids text
    column boundary_vintage integer
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     station_count,
    body     station_ids,
    body     boundary_vintage,
    body     release_key,
    body     published_at,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_noaa_normals.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, published_at DESC, run_id DESC;

v gold_noaa_normals.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column observation_basis text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column station_count bigint
    column station_ids text
    column boundary_vintage integer
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body WITH eligible AS (
    body          SELECT station.run_id,
    body             station.station_id,
    body             station.station_name,
    body             station.latitude,
    body             station.longitude,
    body             station.elevation_m,
    body             station.geo_id,
    body             station.geo_sk,
    body             station.boundary_vintage,
    body             station.geography_status,
    body             station.geography_reason,
    body             station.variable,
    body             station.measure,
    body             station.value_source,
    body             station.value,
    body             station.value_status,
    body             station.missing_reason,
    body             station.measurement_flag,
    body             station.completeness_flag,
    body             station.years,
    body             station.source_record_id,
    body             station.capture_id,
    body             station.archive_version,
    body             station.published_at
    body            FROM gold_noaa_normals.station_observation station
    body           WHERE station.geography_status = 'resolved'::text AND (station.completeness_flag = ANY (ARRAY['S'::text, 'R'::text])) AND station.value_status = 'valid'::text
    body         ), county AS (
    body          SELECT eligible.run_id,
    body             eligible.measure,
    body             eligible.geo_id,
    body             min(eligible.geo_sk) AS geo_sk,
    body             round(avg(eligible.value), 2) AS value,
    body             count(*) AS stations,
    body             string_agg(eligible.station_id, ','::text ORDER BY eligible.station_id) AS station_ids,
    body             min(eligible.boundary_vintage) AS boundary_vintage,
    body             min(eligible.archive_version) AS archive_version,
    body             min(eligible.capture_id::text)::uuid AS capture_id,
    body             min(eligible.published_at) AS published_at
    body            FROM eligible
    body           GROUP BY eligible.run_id, eligible.measure, eligible.geo_id
    body         )
    body  SELECT county.measure AS metric_key,
    body     definition.measure_label,
    body     definition.unit,
    body     definition.observation_basis,
    body     2020 AS year,
    body     '1991-01-01'::date AS period_start,
    body     '2020-12-31'::date AS period_end,
    body     county.geo_id,
    body     county.geo_sk,
    body     'county'::text AS geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain('county'::text) AS geo_level,
    body     'resolved'::text AS geography_status,
    body     county.value,
    body     'valid'::text AS value_status,
    body     county.stations AS station_count,
    body     county.station_ids,
    body     county.boundary_vintage,
    body     (('Normals 1991-2020 '::text || county.archive_version) || ' read '::text) || to_char((county.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'::text) AS release_key,
    body     county.published_at,
    body     md5((((county.measure || '|'::text) || county.geo_id) || '|'::text) || county.run_id::text) AS source_record_id,
    body     county.capture_id,
    body     county.run_id
    body    FROM county
    body      JOIN gold_noaa_normals.measure_definition definition ON definition.measure = county.measure;

v gold_noaa_normals.station_observation
    column run_id uuid
    column station_id text
    column station_name text
    column latitude numeric
    column longitude numeric
    column elevation_m numeric
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column boundary_vintage integer
    column geography_status text
    column geography_reason text
    column variable text
    column measure text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column measurement_flag text
    column completeness_flag text
    column years integer
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column archive_version text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    body SELECT normal.run_id,
    body     normal.station_id,
    body     station.station_name,
    body     station.latitude,
    body     station.longitude,
    body     station.elevation_m,
    body     station.geo_id,
    body     station.geo_sk,
    body     station.boundary_vintage,
    body     station.geography_status,
    body     station.geography_reason,
    body     normal.variable,
    body     normal.measure,
    body     normal.value_source,
    body     normal.value,
    body     normal.value_status,
    body     normal.missing_reason,
    body     normal.measurement_flag,
    body     normal.completeness_flag,
    body     normal.years,
    body     normal.source_record_id,
    body     normal.capture_id,
    body     file.archive_version,
    body     file.published_at
    body    FROM silver_noaa_normals.station_normal normal
    body      JOIN silver_noaa_normals.station station ON station.run_id = normal.run_id AND station.station_id = normal.station_id
    body      JOIN control.noaa_normals_file file ON file.run_id = normal.run_id
    body   WHERE file.status = 'published'::text;

v gold_pep.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column metric_display_name text
    column unit text
    column is_component boolean
    column allows_negative boolean
    column population_universe text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column first_period date
    column last_period date
    body SELECT measure.metric_code AS source_object_key,
    body     measure.display_name AS metric_display_name,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.is_component,
    body     measure.allows_negative,
    body     measure.population_universe,
    body     COALESCE(served.valid_geo_grains, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body     max(fact.transformed_at) AS publication_time,
    body     min(fact.estimate_date) AS first_period,
    body     max(fact.estimate_date) AS last_period
    body    FROM silver_pep.dim_measure measure
    body      JOIN silver_pep.fact_population_estimate fact USING (metric_code)
    body      LEFT JOIN ( SELECT revision.metric_code,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(revision.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(revision.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE revision.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains
    body            FROM gold_pep.population_estimate_revision revision
    body           GROUP BY revision.metric_code) served ON served.metric_code = measure.metric_code
    body   GROUP BY measure.metric_code, served.valid_geo_grains;

v gold_pep.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'CENSUS_PEP'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     metric_display_name,
    body     unit AS units,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN is_component THEN 'component'::text
    body             ELSE 'level'::text
    body         END AS measure_kind,
    body     ARRAY( SELECT gold_glossary.geo_grain(value.value) AS geo_grain
    body            FROM unnest(export.valid_geo_grains) value(value)) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_pep', 'relation', 'population_estimate_revision', 'key', source_object_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     publication_time::text AS source_watermark,
    body     NULL::uuid AS source_run_id,
    body     publication_time,
    body     'U.S. Census Bureau Population Estimates Program'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest.html'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM gold_pep.measure_export export;

v gold_pep.mv_pep_latest
    column capture_id uuid
    column source_code text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column vintage_year smallint
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT reporting.capture_id,
    body     reporting.source_code,
    body     reporting.observation_date,
    body     reporting.period,
    body     reporting.duration_start,
    body     reporting.duration_end,
    body     reporting.time_sk,
    body     reporting.as_of_date,
    body     reporting.updated_at,
    body     reporting.geo_id,
    body     reporting.geo_level,
    body     reporting.state_fips,
    body     reporting.county_fips,
    body     reporting.place_fips,
    body     reporting.state_name,
    body     reporting.county_name,
    body     reporting.place_name,
    body     reporting.geo_latitude,
    body     reporting.geo_longitude,
    body     reporting.metric_code,
    body     reporting.metric_display_name,
    body     reporting.value,
    body     reporting.value_type,
    body     reporting.units,
    body     reporting.seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     reporting.dataset_code,
    body     reporting.vintage_year,
    body     reporting.margin_of_error,
    body     reporting.margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_pep.rpt_pep_observations reporting
    body      JOIN gold_pep.population_estimate_latest latest ON latest.capture_id = reporting.capture_id AND latest.dataset_code = reporting.dataset_code AND latest.pep_vintage = reporting.vintage_year AND ((('CENSUS_PEP:'::text || latest.dataset_code) || ':'::text) || latest.metric_code) = reporting.metric_code AND latest.geo_id = reporting.geo_id AND latest.observation_year = EXTRACT(year FROM reporting.observation_date)::integer;

v gold_pep.population_change
    column capture_id uuid
    column dataset_code text
    column pep_vintage smallint
    column product_code text
    column metric_code text
    column observation_year smallint
    column estimate_date date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_basis_date date
    column summary_level text
    column source_name text
    column functional_status_source text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column unit text
    column source_retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column is_derived boolean
    body SELECT capture_id,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     pep_vintage,
    body     product_code,
    body     metric_code,
    body     observation_year,
    body     estimate_date,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geography_basis_date,
    body     summary_level,
    body     source_name,
    body     functional_status_source,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     unit,
    body     source_retrieved_at,
    body     false AS is_derived
    body    FROM gold_pep.population_estimate_revision
    body   WHERE metric_code = ANY (ARRAY['NPOPCHG'::text, 'NATURALCHG'::text, 'NETMIG'::text]);

v gold_pep.population_estimate_latest
    column capture_id uuid
    column dataset_code text
    column pep_vintage smallint
    column product_code text
    column metric_code text
    column observation_year smallint
    column estimate_date date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_basis_date date
    column summary_level text
    column source_name text
    column functional_status_source text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column unit text
    column source_retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    body SELECT capture_id,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     pep_vintage,
    body     product_code,
    body     metric_code,
    body     observation_year,
    body     estimate_date,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geography_basis_date,
    body     summary_level,
    body     source_name,
    body     functional_status_source,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     unit,
    body     source_retrieved_at
    body    FROM ( SELECT revision.capture_id,
    body             revision.dataset_code,
    body             revision.pep_vintage,
    body             revision.product_code,
    body             revision.metric_code,
    body             revision.observation_year,
    body             revision.estimate_date,
    body             revision.geo_id,
    body             revision.geo_sk,
    body             revision.geo_type,
    body             revision.geography_basis_date,
    body             revision.summary_level,
    body             revision.source_name,
    body             revision.functional_status_source,
    body             revision.value_source,
    body             revision.value,
    body             revision.unit,
    body             revision.source_retrieved_at,
    body             row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY revision.metric_code, revision.geo_id, revision.observation_year ORDER BY (
    body                 CASE
    body                     WHEN dataset.series_kind = 'intercensal'::text THEN 0
    body                     ELSE 1
    body                 END), revision.pep_vintage DESC, (
    body                 CASE
    body                     WHEN revision.summary_level = dataset.native_grain THEN 0
    body                     ELSE 1
    body                 END), revision.dataset_code) AS vintage_rank
    body            FROM gold_pep.population_estimate_revision revision
    body              JOIN silver_pep.pep_dataset dataset ON dataset.dataset_code = revision.dataset_code) ranked
    body   WHERE vintage_rank = 1;

v gold_pep.population_estimate_revision
    column capture_id uuid
    column dataset_code text
    column pep_vintage smallint
    column product_code text
    column metric_code text
    column observation_year smallint
    column estimate_date date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geography_basis_date date
    column summary_level text
    column source_name text
    column functional_status_source text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column unit text
    column source_retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    body WITH ranked AS (
    body          SELECT fact.capture_id,
    body             fact.source_row_index,
    body             fact.source_column_index,
    body             fact.dataset_code,
    body             fact.release_vintage,
    body             fact.product_code,
    body             fact.metric_code,
    body             fact.observation_year,
    body             fact.estimate_date,
    body             fact.geo_id,
    body             fact.geo_sk,
    body             fact.geo_type,
    body             fact.geography_basis_date,
    body             fact.resolution_status,
    body             fact.summary_level,
    body             fact.source_geo_code,
    body             fact.source_name,
    body             fact.functional_status_source,
    body             fact.value_source,
    body             fact.value,
    body             fact.unit,
    body             fact.transformed_at,
    body             capture.retrieved_at AS source_retrieved_at,
    body             row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY fact.dataset_code, fact.release_vintage, fact.metric_code, fact.geo_id, fact.observation_year ORDER BY capture.retrieved_at DESC, fact.capture_id DESC) AS capture_rank
    body            FROM silver_pep.fact_population_estimate fact
    body              JOIN silver_pep.release_load load USING (capture_id)
    body              JOIN raw_capture.response_capture capture USING (capture_id)
    body           WHERE load.completeness_status = 'complete'::text AND fact.resolution_status = 'resolved'::text
    body         )
    body  SELECT capture_id,
    body     dataset_code,
    body     release_vintage AS pep_vintage,
    body     product_code,
    body     metric_code,
    body     observation_year,
    body     estimate_date,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geography_basis_date,
    body     summary_level,
    body     source_name,
    body     functional_status_source,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     unit,
    body     source_retrieved_at
    body    FROM ranked
    body   WHERE capture_rank = 1;

v gold_pep.rpt_pep_observations
    column capture_id uuid
    column source_code text
    column observation_date date
    column period text
    column duration_start date
    column duration_end date
    column time_sk integer
    column as_of_date date
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone
    column geo_id text
    column geo_level text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column geo_latitude double precision
    column geo_longitude double precision
    column metric_code text
    column metric_display_name text
    column value numeric
    column value_type text
    column units text
    column seasonal_adjustment_status text
    column dataset_code text
    column vintage_year smallint
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    body SELECT revision.capture_id,
    body     'CENSUS_PEP'::text AS source_code,
    body     revision.estimate_date AS observation_date,
    body     revision.estimate_date::text AS period,
    body     revision.estimate_date AS duration_start,
    body     revision.estimate_date AS duration_end,
    body     "time".time_sk,
    body     release.release_date AS as_of_date,
    body     revision.source_retrieved_at AS updated_at,
    body     revision.geo_id,
    body     revision.geo_type AS geo_level,
    body     entity.state_fips,
    body     entity.county_fips,
    body     entity.place_fips,
    body     current.state_name,
    body     current.county_name,
    body     current.place_name,
    body     current.latitude AS geo_latitude,
    body     current.longitude AS geo_longitude,
    body     (('CENSUS_PEP:'::text || revision.dataset_code) || ':'::text) || revision.metric_code AS metric_code,
    body     measure.display_name AS metric_display_name,
    body     revision.value,
    body     measure.value_type,
    body     revision.unit AS units,
    body     NULL::text AS seasonal_adjustment_status,
    body     revision.dataset_code,
    body     revision.pep_vintage AS vintage_year,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error,
    body     NULL::numeric AS margin_of_error_pct
    body    FROM gold_pep.population_estimate_revision revision
    body      JOIN silver_pep.dim_measure measure USING (metric_code)
    body      JOIN silver_pep.pep_release release ON release.dataset_code = revision.dataset_code AND release.vintage_year = revision.pep_vintage
    body      JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_entity entity USING (geo_sk)
    body      LEFT JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_current current USING (geo_sk)
    body      LEFT JOIN silver_ref.dim_time "time" ON "time".date_key = revision.estimate_date;

v gold_usda_ers.measure_definition
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column product text
    column kind text
    column observation_basis text
    body SELECT measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     product,
    body     kind,
    body         CASE product
    body             WHEN 'rucc'::text THEN ((('USDA ERS Rural-Urban Continuum Codes, 2023 edition: a classification '::text || 'of counties by metro-area size and, for nonmetro counties, urban '::text) || 'population and adjacency to a metro area (1-3 metro, 4-9 nonmetro); '::text) || 'a code, not a quantity, and not comparable to earlier editions. '::text) || 'Source: USDA, Economic Research Service.'::text
    body             WHEN 'typology'::text THEN ('USDA ERS County Typology Codes, 2025 edition: a flag (1 yes, 0 no) or, '::text || 'for industry dependence, a code; not comparable to earlier editions. '::text) || 'Source: USDA, Economic Research Service.'::text
    body             ELSE ('USDA ERS Food Environment Atlas, July 2025 release: the indicator as '::text || 'ERS publishes it for the year shown. Source: USDA, Economic Research '::text) || 'Service.'::text
    body         END AS observation_basis
    body    FROM ( VALUES ('rural_urban_continuum_code'::text,'Rural-Urban Continuum Code'::text,'code (1-9)'::text,'rucc'::text,'code'::text), ('farming_dependent'::text,'Farming-dependent county'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('mining_dependent'::text,'Mining-dependent county'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('manufacturing_dependent'::text,'Manufacturing-dependent county'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('government_dependent'::text,'Federal/State government-dependent county'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('recreation_dependent'::text,'Recreation county'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('nonspecialized'::text,'Nonspecialized economy'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('industry_dependence'::text,'Industry dependence (which of five industries, 0 for none)'::text,'code (0-5)'::text,'typology'::text,'code'::text), ('low_postsecondary_education'::text,'Low postsecondary education'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('low_employment'::text,'Low employment'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('population_loss'::text,'Population loss'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('housing_stress'::text,'Housing stress'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('retirement_destination'::text,'Retirement destination'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('persistent_poverty'::text,'Persistent poverty (2017-21 and earlier)'::text,'flag (0/1)'::text,'typology'::text,'flag'::text), ('snap_authorized_stores'::text,'SNAP-authorized stores'::text,'stores'::text,'fea'::text,'number'::text), ('snap_authorized_stores_per_1000'::text,'SNAP-authorized stores per 1,000 people'::text,'stores per 1,000 people'::text,'fea'::text,'number'::text), ('snap_households_low_store_access'::text,'SNAP households with low access to a store'::text,'households'::text,'fea'::text,'number'::text), ('snap_households_low_store_access_pct'::text,'SNAP households with low access to a store, percent of households'::text,'percent'::text,'fea'::text,'number'::text)) measure(measure, measure_label, unit, product, kind);

v gold_usda_ers.measure_export
    column source_object_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column kind text
    column observation_basis text
    column schema_version text
    body SELECT measure AS source_object_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     kind,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     'usda_ers_csv:v1'::text AS schema_version
    body    FROM gold_usda_ers.measure_definition;

v gold_usda_ers.metric_publisher
    column source_code text
    column publisher_contract_version text
    column source_object_key text
    column source_object_type text
    column metric_display_name text
    column units text
    column measure_kind text
    column valid_geo_grains text[]
    column valid_time_grains text[]
    column aggregation_characteristic text
    column physical_lineage jsonb
    column source_watermark text
    column source_run_id uuid
    column publication_time timestamp with time zone
    column source_name text
    column source_type text
    column reference_url text
    body SELECT 'USDA_ERS'::text AS source_code,
    body     '1.0'::text AS publisher_contract_version,
    body     served.metric_key AS source_object_key,
    body     'measure'::text AS source_object_type,
    body     export.measure_label || ' (USDA ERS)'::text AS metric_display_name,
    body     export.unit AS units,
    body         CASE export.kind
    body             WHEN 'number'::text THEN 'source_fact'::text
    body             ELSE 'classification'::text
    body         END AS measure_kind,
    body     served.valid_geo_grains,
    body     ARRAY['ANNUAL'::text] AS valid_time_grains,
    body     NULL::text AS aggregation_characteristic,
    body     jsonb_build_object('schema', 'gold_usda_ers', 'relation', 'observation_revision', 'key', served.metric_key) AS physical_lineage,
    body     served.source_watermark,
    body     served.source_run_id,
    body     served.publication_time,
    body     'USDA Economic Research Service county classifications and Food Environment Atlas'::text AS source_name,
    body     'government-statistical-program'::text AS source_type,
    body     'https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/'::text AS reference_url
    body    FROM ( SELECT latest.metric_key,
    body             max(latest.release_key) AS source_watermark,
    body             COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type) ORDER BY (gold_glossary.geo_grain(latest.geo_type))) FILTER (WHERE latest.value IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::text[]) AS valid_geo_grains,
    body             (array_agg(latest.run_id ORDER BY latest.published_at DESC))[1] AS source_run_id,
    body             max(latest.published_at) AS publication_time
    body            FROM gold_usda_ers.observation_latest latest
    body           GROUP BY latest.metric_key) served
    body      JOIN gold_usda_ers.measure_export export ON export.source_object_key = served.metric_key
    body   WHERE served.publication_time IS NOT NULL;

v gold_usda_ers.observation_latest
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column kind text
    column observation_basis text
    column product text
    column edition text
    column attribute text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column fips_code text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column code_label text
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric_key, geo_id, year) metric_key,
    body     measure,
    body     measure_label,
    body     unit,
    body     kind,
    body     observation_basis,
    body     product,
    body     edition,
    body     attribute,
    body     year,
    body     period_start,
    body     period_end,
    body     geo_id,
    body     geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geography_status,
    body     fips_code,
    body     value_source,
    body     value,
    body     value_status,
    body     missing_reason,
    body     code_label,
    body     release_key,
    body     published_at,
    body     retrieved_at,
    body     source_record_id,
    body     capture_id,
    body     run_id
    body    FROM gold_usda_ers.observation_revision revision
    body   ORDER BY metric_key, geo_id, year, retrieved_at DESC, capture_id DESC;

v gold_usda_ers.observation_revision
    column metric_key text
    column measure text
    column measure_label text
    column unit text
    column kind text
    column observation_basis text
    column product text
    column edition text
    column attribute text
    column year integer
    column period_start date
    column period_end date
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geography_status text
    column fips_code text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text
    column missing_reason text
    column code_label text
    column release_key text
    column published_at timestamp with time zone
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone
    column source_record_id text
    column capture_id uuid
    column run_id uuid
    body SELECT fact.measure AS metric_key,
    body     fact.measure,
    body     measure.measure_label,
    body     measure.unit,
    body     measure.kind,
    body     measure.observation_basis,
    body     fact.product,
    body     fact.edition,
    body     fact.attribute,
    body     fact.year,
    body     make_date(fact.year, 1, 1) AS period_start,
    body     make_date(fact.year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
    body     fact.geo_id,
    body     fact.geo_sk,
    body     'county'::text AS geo_type,
    body     gold_glossary.geo_grain('county'::text) AS geo_level,
    body     fact.geography_status,
    body     fact.fips_code,
    body     fact.value_source,
    body     fact.value,
    body     fact.value_status,
    body     fact.missing_reason,
    body     fact.code_label,
    body     (((fact.product || ':'::text) || fact.edition) || ':'::text) || to_char((fact.retrieved_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'::text) AS release_key,
    body     file.published_at,
    body     fact.retrieved_at,
    body     fact.source_record_id,
    body     fact.capture_id,
    body     fact.run_id
    body    FROM silver_usda_ers.fact_observation fact
    body      JOIN control.usda_ers_file file ON file.run_id = fact.run_id
    body      JOIN gold_usda_ers.measure_definition measure ON measure.measure = fact.measure
    body   WHERE file.status = 'published'::text AND (fact.geography_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unsupported'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unmapped'::text]));

r raw_bls.bls_datasets
    column program text NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column title text
    column is_available boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
    column first_seen_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_checked_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_ingested_at timestamp with time zone
    constraint bls_datasets_pkey PRIMARY KEY (program, year)
    index bls_datasets_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bls_datasets_pkey ON raw_bls.bls_datasets USING btree (program, year)

r raw_bls.bls_series
    column program text NOT NULL
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column title text
    column seasonal text
    column measure text
    column area_code text
    column area_text text
    column raw_metadata jsonb
    column first_seen_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column last_checked_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint bls_series_pkey PRIMARY KEY (program, series_id)
    index bls_series_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bls_series_pkey ON raw_bls.bls_series USING btree (program, series_id)
    index bls_series_program_idx CREATE INDEX bls_series_program_idx ON raw_bls.bls_series USING btree (program)

r raw_capture.payload_blob
    column payload_checksum text NOT NULL
    column checksum_algorithm text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sha256'::text
    column payload bytea NOT NULL
    column payload_size bigint NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint payload_blob_check CHECK ((payload_size = octet_length(payload)))
    constraint payload_blob_checksum_algorithm_check CHECK ((checksum_algorithm = 'sha256'::text))
    constraint payload_blob_payload_checksum_check CHECK ((payload_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint payload_blob_pkey PRIMARY KEY (payload_checksum)
    index payload_blob_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payload_blob_pkey ON raw_capture.payload_blob USING btree (payload_checksum)

r raw_capture.response_capture
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column request_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column endpoint text NOT NULL
    column request_parameters jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
    column request_fingerprint text NOT NULL
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column http_status smallint NOT NULL
    column response_headers jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
    column media_type text NOT NULL
    column payload_schema_version text
    column source_revision text
    column payload_checksum text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint response_capture_capture_id_run_id_source_code_key UNIQUE (capture_id, run_id, source_code)
    constraint response_capture_endpoint_check CHECK ((btrim(endpoint) <> ''::text))
    constraint response_capture_http_status_check CHECK (((http_status >= 100) AND (http_status <= 599)))
    constraint response_capture_media_type_check CHECK ((btrim(media_type) <> ''::text))
    constraint response_capture_payload_checksum_fkey FOREIGN KEY (payload_checksum) REFERENCES raw_capture.payload_blob(payload_checksum)
    constraint response_capture_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id)
    constraint response_capture_request_fingerprint_check CHECK ((request_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint response_capture_request_id_run_id_source_code_endpoint_re_fkey FOREIGN KEY (request_id, run_id, source_code, endpoint, request_fingerprint) REFERENCES control.ingestion_request(request_id, run_id, source_code, endpoint, request_fingerprint)
    constraint response_capture_source_code_check CHECK ((source_code ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$'::text))
    index response_capture_capture_id_run_id_source_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX response_capture_capture_id_run_id_source_code_key ON raw_capture.response_capture USING btree (capture_id, run_id, source_code)
    index response_capture_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX response_capture_pkey ON raw_capture.response_capture USING btree (capture_id)
    index response_capture_request_identity_idx CREATE INDEX response_capture_request_identity_idx ON raw_capture.response_capture USING btree (source_code, request_fingerprint, payload_checksum, retrieved_at DESC)
    index response_capture_run_idx CREATE INDEX response_capture_run_idx ON raw_capture.response_capture USING btree (run_id, retrieved_at)
