r silver_bea.dim_line
    column table_code text NOT NULL
    column line_code text NOT NULL
    column table_title text NOT NULL
    column description text NOT NULL
    column unit text NOT NULL
    column dollar_basis text NOT NULL
    column observation_basis text NOT NULL
    column methodology_url text NOT NULL
    column parser_contract_version text NOT NULL
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_line_dollar_basis_check CHECK ((dollar_basis = ANY (ARRAY['current_dollars'::text, 'chained_dollars'::text, 'per_capita_current_dollars'::text, 'persons'::text, 'price_level_us_100'::text])))
    constraint dim_line_line_code_check CHECK ((line_code ~ '^[0-9]+$'::text))
    constraint dim_line_pkey PRIMARY KEY (table_code, line_code)
    index dim_line_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_line_pkey ON silver_bea.dim_line USING btree (table_code, line_code)

r silver_bea.fact_observation
    column table_code text NOT NULL
    column line_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column release_date date NOT NULL
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint bea_fact_code_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint bea_fact_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_observation_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_observation_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text, 'metro'::text, 'provider_area'::text])))
    constraint fact_observation_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text])))
    constraint fact_observation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (table_code, line_code, geo_id, year, capture_id)
    constraint fact_observation_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_observation_table_code_line_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (table_code, line_code) REFERENCES silver_bea.dim_line(table_code, line_code)
    constraint fact_observation_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'withheld'::text, 'not_available'::text, 'not_meaningful'::text, 'below_threshold'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    index bea_fact_lookup_idx CREATE INDEX bea_fact_lookup_idx ON silver_bea.fact_observation USING btree (table_code, line_code, geo_id, year)
    index bea_fact_run_idx CREATE INDEX bea_fact_run_idx ON silver_bea.fact_observation USING btree (run_id)
    index fact_observation_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_observation_pkey ON silver_bea.fact_observation USING btree (table_code, line_code, geo_id, year, capture_id)

r silver_bea.observation_quarantine
    column quarantine_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_bea.observation_quarantine_quarantine_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column error_code text NOT NULL
    column error_summary text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_quarantine_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key UNIQUE (capture_id, source_row_index, error_code)
    constraint observation_quarantine_pkey PRIMARY KEY (quarantine_sk)
    constraint observation_quarantine_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_quarantine_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    index observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key ON silver_bea.observation_quarantine USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, error_code)
    index observation_quarantine_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_quarantine_pkey ON silver_bea.observation_quarantine USING btree (quarantine_sk)

r silver_bea.observation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column table_code text NOT NULL
    column line_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_label text
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint bea_revision_code_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint bea_revision_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text, 'metro'::text, 'provider_area'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index, year)
    constraint observation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint observation_revision_table_code_line_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (table_code, line_code) REFERENCES silver_bea.dim_line(table_code, line_code)
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'withheld'::text, 'not_available'::text, 'not_meaningful'::text, 'below_threshold'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_year_check CHECK (((year >= 1929) AND (year <= 2100)))
    index bea_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX bea_revision_run_idx ON silver_bea.observation_revision USING btree (run_id)
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_bea.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, year)

r silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics
    column labor_stat_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics_labor_stat_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column time_sk integer NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column duration_start date NOT NULL
    column duration_end date NOT NULL
    column period_date date NOT NULL
    column series_id character varying(255) NOT NULL
    column program character varying(50) NOT NULL
    column geo_level character varying(50)
    column geo_id character varying(255)
    column state_fips character varying(2)
    column county_fips character varying(3)
    column value numeric
    column source_value text
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column period character varying(10) NOT NULL
    column period_name character varying(100)
    column measure_code character varying(10)
    column measure_name text
    column seasonal_adjustment character varying(1) DEFAULT 'U'::character varying
    column source_system character varying(50) DEFAULT 'BLS'::character varying
    column capture_id uuid
    column load_batch_id uuid NOT NULL
    column ingested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_pkey PRIMARY KEY (labor_stat_sk)
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_published_value_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_time_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (time_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_time(time_sk)
    constraint fact_labor_statistics_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'invalid'::text])))
    constraint fact_labor_stats_uk UNIQUE (series_id, year, period)
    index fact_labor_statistics_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_labor_statistics_pkey ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (labor_stat_sk)
    index fact_labor_stats_uk CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_labor_stats_uk ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (series_id, year, period)
    index idx_fact_labor_geo_sk CREATE INDEX idx_fact_labor_geo_sk ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (geo_sk)
    index idx_fact_labor_ingested_at CREATE INDEX idx_fact_labor_ingested_at ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (ingested_at)
    index idx_fact_labor_program CREATE INDEX idx_fact_labor_program ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (program)
    index idx_fact_labor_series_id CREATE INDEX idx_fact_labor_series_id ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (series_id)
    index idx_fact_labor_time_sk CREATE INDEX idx_fact_labor_time_sk ON silver_bls.fact_labor_statistics USING btree (time_sk)

r silver_bls_qcew.fact_observation
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column industry_code text NOT NULL
    column own_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column period_start date NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column period_end date NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column period text NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column disclosure_code text
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL

    constraint fact_observation_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text])))
    constraint fact_observation_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text])))
    constraint fact_observation_industry_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (industry_code) REFERENCES silver_bls_qcew.dim_industry(industry_code)
    constraint fact_observation_measure_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (measure_id) REFERENCES silver_bls_qcew.dim_measure(measure_id)

    constraint fact_observation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (measure_id, industry_code, own_code, geo_id, period_start, capture_id)
    constraint fact_observation_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_observation_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'withheld'::text, 'not_published'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    constraint qcew_fact_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint qcew_fact_withheld_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    index bls_qcew_fact_lookup_idx CREATE INDEX bls_qcew_fact_lookup_idx ON silver_bls_qcew.fact_observation USING btree (measure_id, industry_code, own_code, geo_id, period_start)
    index bls_qcew_fact_run_idx CREATE INDEX bls_qcew_fact_run_idx ON silver_bls_qcew.fact_observation USING btree (run_id)

r silver_bls_qcew.observation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column month_index integer NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column period text NOT NULL
    column industry_code text NOT NULL
    column own_code text NOT NULL
    column agglvl_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column period_start date NOT NULL
    column period_end date NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column disclosure_code text
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_industry_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (industry_code) REFERENCES silver_bls_qcew.dim_industry(industry_code)
    constraint observation_revision_measure_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (measure_id) REFERENCES silver_bls_qcew.dim_measure(measure_id)
    constraint observation_revision_month_index_check CHECK (((month_index >= 0) AND (month_index <= 2)))
    constraint observation_revision_own_code_check CHECK ((own_code = ANY (ARRAY['0'::text, '5'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_period_check CHECK ((period = ANY (ARRAY['1'::text, '2'::text, '3'::text, '4'::text, 'a'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index, measure_id, month_index)
    constraint observation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'withheld'::text, 'not_published'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    constraint qcew_revision_period_ordered CHECK ((period_start <= period_end))
    constraint qcew_revision_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint qcew_revision_withheld_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    index bls_qcew_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX bls_qcew_revision_run_idx ON silver_bls_qcew.observation_revision USING btree (run_id)
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_bls_qcew.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, measure_id, month_index)

r silver_cdc.fact_health_observation
    column observation_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_cdc.fact_health_observation_observation_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column asset_id text NOT NULL
    column release_watermark text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column source_run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column value_type_id text NOT NULL
    column stratum_id text NOT NULL
    column period_start integer NOT NULL
    column period_end integer NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column unit text
    column adjustment_status text NOT NULL
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column footnote_code text
    column footnote_text text

    constraint fact_health_observation_check2 CHECK (((confidence_lower IS NULL) OR (confidence_upper IS NULL) OR (confidence_lower <= confidence_upper)))

    constraint fact_health_observation_source_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_health_observation_stratum_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (stratum_id) REFERENCES silver_cdc.dim_stratum(stratum_id)

    index cdc_fact_measure_geo_period_idx CREATE INDEX cdc_fact_measure_geo_period_idx ON silver_cdc.fact_health_observation USING btree (asset_id, measure_id, geo_id, period_start, period_end)
    index fact_health_observation_asset_id_release_watermark_source_r_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_health_observation_asset_id_release_watermark_source_r_key ON silver_cdc.fact_health_observation USING btree (asset_id, release_watermark, source_record_id)

r silver_cdc.observation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column asset_id text NOT NULL
    column release_watermark text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column source_record jsonb NOT NULL
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column measure_label text NOT NULL
    column topic text NOT NULL
    column period_start integer NOT NULL
    column period_end integer NOT NULL
    column geo_source_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_label text
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column unit text
    column value_type_id text NOT NULL
    column value_type_label text NOT NULL
    column adjustment_status text NOT NULL
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column footnote_code text
    column footnote_text text
    column stratum_id text NOT NULL
    column strata jsonb NOT NULL
    column estimate_method text NOT NULL
    column population_basis text NOT NULL
    column total_population numeric
    column population_18_plus numeric
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_revision_adjustment_status_check CHECK ((adjustment_status = ANY (ARRAY['crude'::text, 'age_adjusted'::text, 'source_specific'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_asset_id_check CHECK ((asset_id = ANY (ARRAY['cdi'::text, 'places_county'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_check CHECK ((period_end >= period_start))
    constraint observation_revision_check1 CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_check2 CHECK (((confidence_lower IS NULL) OR (confidence_upper IS NULL) OR (confidence_lower <= confidence_upper)))
    constraint observation_revision_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text, 'unsupported'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index)
    constraint observation_revision_population_18_plus_check CHECK (((population_18_plus IS NULL) OR (population_18_plus >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint observation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint observation_revision_strata_is_array_check CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(strata) = 'array'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_stratum_id_check CHECK ((stratum_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_total_population_check CHECK (((total_population IS NULL) OR (total_population >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'suppressed'::text])))
    index cdc_observation_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX cdc_observation_revision_run_idx ON silver_cdc.observation_revision USING btree (run_id, asset_id, release_watermark)
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_cdc.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)

r silver_census.fact_demographics
    column demographic_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_census.fact_demographics_demographic_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column time_sk integer NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column duration_start date NOT NULL
    column duration_end date NOT NULL
    column estimate_year integer NOT NULL
    column dataset character varying(50) NOT NULL
    column table_id character varying(50) NOT NULL
    column variable_code character varying(100) NOT NULL
    column geo_level character varying(50)
    column geo_id character varying(255)
    column state_fips character varying(2)
    column county_fips character varying(3)
    column estimate_value numeric
    column source_value text
    column value_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'valid'::text
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column margin_of_error_pct numeric
    column variable_label text
    column variable_concept text
    column universe text
    column source_system character varying(50) DEFAULT 'CENSUS_ACS'::character varying
    column capture_id uuid
    column load_batch_id uuid NOT NULL
    column ingested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_demographics_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_demographics_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint fact_demographics_pkey PRIMARY KEY (demographic_sk)
    constraint fact_demographics_published_value_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (estimate_value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_demographics_time_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (time_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_time(time_sk)
    constraint fact_demographics_uk UNIQUE (dataset, table_id, variable_code, geo_id, estimate_year)
    constraint fact_demographics_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'absent'::text, 'blank'::text, 'sentinel'::text, 'invalid'::text])))
    index fact_demographics_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_demographics_pkey ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (demographic_sk)
    index fact_demographics_uk CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_demographics_uk ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (dataset, table_id, variable_code, geo_id, estimate_year)
    index idx_fact_demo_dataset CREATE INDEX idx_fact_demo_dataset ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (dataset)
    index idx_fact_demo_geo_sk CREATE INDEX idx_fact_demo_geo_sk ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (geo_sk)
    index idx_fact_demo_ingested_at CREATE INDEX idx_fact_demo_ingested_at ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (ingested_at)
    index idx_fact_demo_source_year CREATE INDEX idx_fact_demo_source_year ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (source_system, estimate_year)
    index idx_fact_demo_table_id CREATE INDEX idx_fact_demo_table_id ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (table_id)
    index idx_fact_demo_time_sk CREATE INDEX idx_fact_demo_time_sk ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (time_sk)
    index idx_fact_demo_upsert_key CREATE INDEX idx_fact_demo_upsert_key ON silver_census.fact_demographics USING btree (dataset, table_id, variable_code, geo_id, estimate_year)

    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column source_column_index integer NOT NULL
    column source_header text NOT NULL
    column dataset text NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column geo_level text NOT NULL
    column us_source text
    column state_fips_source text
    column county_fips_source text
    column place_fips_source text
    column tract_code_source text
    column variable_name text NOT NULL
    column table_id text NOT NULL
    column measure_type text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column parsed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column parser_version text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'census-acs-array-v1'::text
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_geo_level_tract_check CHECK ((geo_level = ANY (ARRAY['us'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text, 'place'::text, 'tract'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index, source_column_index)
    constraint observation_revision_source_column_index_check CHECK ((source_column_index >= 0))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'absent'::text, 'blank'::text, 'sentinel'::text, 'invalid'::text])))
    index census_observation_revision_slice_idx CREATE INDEX census_observation_revision_slice_idx ON silver_census.observation_revision USING btree (dataset, year, geo_level, state_fips_source, county_fips_source)
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_census.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, source_column_index)

r silver_census_bps.fact_observation
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column structure_type text NOT NULL
    column frequency text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column period_start date NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column period_end date NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column reported_value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column months_reported integer
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint bps_fact_unreported_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint bps_fact_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_observation_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_observation_frequency_check CHECK ((frequency = ANY (ARRAY['monthly'::text, 'annual'::text])))
    constraint fact_observation_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text, 'place'::text])))
    constraint fact_observation_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text])))
    constraint fact_observation_measure_id_structure_type_fkey FOREIGN KEY (measure_id, structure_type) REFERENCES silver_census_bps.dim_measure(measure_id, structure_type)
    constraint fact_observation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (measure_id, structure_type, frequency, geo_id, period_start, capture_id)
    constraint fact_observation_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_observation_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'not_reported'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    index census_bps_fact_lookup_idx CREATE INDEX census_bps_fact_lookup_idx ON silver_census_bps.fact_observation USING btree (measure_id, structure_type, frequency, geo_id, period_start)
    index census_bps_fact_run_idx CREATE INDEX census_bps_fact_run_idx ON silver_census_bps.fact_observation USING btree (run_id)
    index fact_observation_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_observation_pkey ON silver_census_bps.fact_observation USING btree (measure_id, structure_type, frequency, geo_id, period_start, capture_id)

r silver_census_bps.observation_quarantine
    column quarantine_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_census_bps.observation_quarantine_quarantine_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column error_code text NOT NULL
    column error_summary text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_quarantine_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key UNIQUE (capture_id, source_row_index, error_code)
    constraint observation_quarantine_pkey PRIMARY KEY (quarantine_sk)
    constraint observation_quarantine_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_quarantine_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    index observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key ON silver_census_bps.observation_quarantine USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, error_code)
    index observation_quarantine_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_quarantine_pkey ON silver_census_bps.observation_quarantine USING btree (quarantine_sk)

r silver_census_bps.observation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column structure_type text NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column slice_key text NOT NULL
    column frequency text NOT NULL
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_label text
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column period_start date NOT NULL
    column period_end date NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column reported_value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column months_reported integer
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint bps_revision_period_ordered CHECK ((period_start <= period_end))
    constraint bps_revision_unreported_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint bps_revision_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_frequency_check CHECK ((frequency = ANY (ARRAY['monthly'::text, 'annual'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text, 'place'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_measure_id_structure_type_fkey FOREIGN KEY (measure_id, structure_type) REFERENCES silver_census_bps.dim_measure(measure_id, structure_type)
    constraint observation_revision_months_reported_check CHECK (((months_reported >= 0) AND (months_reported <= 12)))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index, measure_id, structure_type)
    constraint observation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'not_reported'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    index census_bps_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX census_bps_revision_run_idx ON silver_census_bps.observation_revision USING btree (run_id)
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_census_bps.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, measure_id, structure_type)

    column year integer NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL

    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL

    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column noise_flag text
    column employment_range text
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL

    constraint fact_area_family_check CHECK ((family = ANY (ARRAY['rac'::text, 'wac'::text])))
    constraint fact_area_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text])))

    constraint lodes_area_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    index fact_area_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_area_pkey ON silver_census_lodes.fact_area USING btree (run_id, family, column_code, geo_id)

r silver_census_sae.fact_estimate
    column dataset_id text NOT NULL
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column estimate_year integer NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_estimate_bounds_ordered CHECK (((confidence_lower IS NULL) OR (confidence_upper IS NULL) OR (confidence_lower <= confidence_upper)))
    constraint fact_estimate_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_estimate_dataset_id_measure_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (dataset_id, measure_id) REFERENCES silver_census_sae.dim_measure(dataset_id, measure_id)
    constraint fact_estimate_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text])))
    constraint fact_estimate_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text])))
    constraint fact_estimate_missing_value_absent CHECK (((value_status <> 'missing'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint fact_estimate_pkey PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, measure_id, estimate_year, geo_id, capture_id)
    constraint fact_estimate_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_estimate_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_estimate_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    index census_sae_fact_lookup_idx CREATE INDEX census_sae_fact_lookup_idx ON silver_census_sae.fact_estimate USING btree (dataset_id, measure_id, geo_id, estimate_year)
    index fact_estimate_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_estimate_pkey ON silver_census_sae.fact_estimate USING btree (dataset_id, measure_id, estimate_year, geo_id, capture_id)

r silver_census_sae.observation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column dataset_id text NOT NULL
    column estimate_year integer NOT NULL
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_label text
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column confidence_lower numeric
    column confidence_upper numeric
    column margin_of_error numeric
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column source_record jsonb NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_revision_bounds_ordered CHECK (((confidence_lower IS NULL) OR (confidence_upper IS NULL) OR (confidence_lower <= confidence_upper)))
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_dataset_id_check CHECK ((dataset_id = ANY (ARRAY['saipe'::text, 'sahie'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_dataset_id_measure_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (dataset_id, measure_id) REFERENCES silver_census_sae.dim_measure(dataset_id, measure_id)
    constraint observation_revision_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_missing_value_absent CHECK (((value_status <> 'missing'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index, measure_id)
    constraint observation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint observation_revision_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    index census_sae_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX census_sae_revision_run_idx ON silver_census_sae.observation_revision USING btree (run_id)
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_census_sae.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, measure_id)

r silver_eia.fact_retail_price
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column week_start date NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column product text NOT NULL
    column duoarea text NOT NULL
    column area_name text
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint eia_fact_missing_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint eia_fact_resolved_has_geography CHECK (((geography_status = 'resolved'::text) = ((geo_sk IS NOT NULL) AND (geo_id IS NOT NULL))))
    constraint eia_fact_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_retail_price_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_retail_price_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'provider_area'::text])))
    constraint fact_retail_price_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text])))
    constraint fact_retail_price_pkey PRIMARY KEY (series_id, week_start, capture_id)
    constraint fact_retail_price_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_retail_price_value_check CHECK (((value IS NULL) OR (value > (0)::numeric)))
    constraint fact_retail_price_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    index eia_fact_lookup_idx CREATE INDEX eia_fact_lookup_idx ON silver_eia.fact_retail_price USING btree (series_id, week_start)
    index eia_fact_run_idx CREATE INDEX eia_fact_run_idx ON silver_eia.fact_retail_price USING btree (run_id)
    index fact_retail_price_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_retail_price_pkey ON silver_eia.fact_retail_price USING btree (series_id, week_start, capture_id)

    constraint observation_quarantine_pkey PRIMARY KEY (quarantine_sk)

r silver_eia.price_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column row_index integer NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column series_id text NOT NULL
    column week_start date NOT NULL
    column duoarea text NOT NULL
    column area_name text
    column product text NOT NULL
    column product_name text
    column units text NOT NULL
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column state_usps text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint eia_revision_missing_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint eia_revision_state_named CHECK (((geo_type = 'state'::text) = (state_usps IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint eia_revision_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint price_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint price_revision_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'provider_area'::text])))
    constraint price_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, row_index)
    constraint price_revision_row_index_check CHECK ((row_index >= 0))
    constraint price_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint price_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint price_revision_state_usps_check CHECK (((state_usps IS NULL) OR (state_usps ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'::text)))
    constraint price_revision_units_check CHECK ((units = '$/GAL'::text))
    constraint price_revision_value_check CHECK (((value IS NULL) OR (value > (0)::numeric)))
    constraint price_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    index eia_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX eia_revision_run_idx ON silver_eia.price_revision USING btree (run_id)
    index price_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX price_revision_pkey ON silver_eia.price_revision USING btree (capture_id, row_index)

r silver_epa_aqs.monitor_fact
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column monitor_id text NOT NULL
    column sample_duration text NOT NULL
    column pollutant_standard text NOT NULL
    column event_type text NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column measure text NOT NULL
    column parameter_code text NOT NULL
    column poc integer NOT NULL
    column site_number text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column completeness text NOT NULL
    column certification text NOT NULL
    column observation_count integer NOT NULL
    column units text NOT NULL
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column date_of_last_change date
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint epa_aqs_monitor_missing_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint epa_aqs_monitor_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint monitor_fact_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint monitor_fact_completeness_check CHECK ((completeness = ANY (ARRAY['Y'::text, 'N'::text])))
    constraint monitor_fact_event_type_check CHECK ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['No Events'::text, 'Events Included'::text, 'Events Excluded'::text, 'Concurred Events Excluded'::text])))
    constraint monitor_fact_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text])))
    constraint monitor_fact_measure_check CHECK ((measure = ANY (ARRAY['pm25_annual_mean'::text, 'ozone_8hour_4th_max'::text])))
    constraint monitor_fact_monitor_id_check CHECK ((monitor_id ~ '^[0-9]{5}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{5}-[0-9]+$'::text))
    constraint monitor_fact_observation_count_check CHECK ((observation_count >= 0))
    constraint monitor_fact_pkey PRIMARY KEY (run_id, monitor_id, sample_duration, pollutant_standard, event_type)
    constraint monitor_fact_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.epa_aqs_file(run_id)
    constraint monitor_fact_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint monitor_fact_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint monitor_fact_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    index epa_aqs_monitor_county_idx CREATE INDEX epa_aqs_monitor_county_idx ON silver_epa_aqs.monitor_fact USING btree (geo_id, year, measure)
    index monitor_fact_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX monitor_fact_pkey ON silver_epa_aqs.monitor_fact USING btree (run_id, monitor_id, sample_duration, pollutant_standard, event_type)

r silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship
    column relationship_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship_relationship_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column ori text NOT NULL
    column relationship_type text NOT NULL
    column source_label text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column resolution_method text
    column resolution_status text NOT NULL
    column confidence_class text NOT NULL
    column reason_code text
    column effective_start date NOT NULL
    column effective_end date NOT NULL
    column geography_vintage integer NOT NULL
    column evidence_source text NOT NULL
    column evidence_capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column release_key text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_check CHECK ((effective_end >= effective_start))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_check1 CHECK (((resolution_status <> 'resolved'::text) OR (geo_id IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_check2 CHECK (((resolution_status = 'resolved'::text) OR (geo_sk IS NULL)))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_confidence_class_check CHECK ((confidence_class = ANY (ARRAY['exact'::text, 'reviewed'::text, 'derived'::text, 'unresolved'::text])))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_evidence_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (evidence_capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_ori_fkey FOREIGN KEY (ori) REFERENCES silver_fbi.dim_agency(ori)
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_pkey PRIMARY KEY (relationship_sk)
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_relationship_type_check CHECK ((relationship_type = ANY (ARRAY['state'::text, 'county'::text, 'place'::text])))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_resolution_method_check CHECK (((resolution_method IS NULL) OR (resolution_method = ANY (ARRAY['exact_state_code'::text, 'county_label_match'::text, 'reviewed_place_crosswalk'::text]))))
    constraint agency_geography_relationship_resolution_status_check CHECK ((resolution_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unresolved'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unsupported'::text])))
    constraint fbi_agency_relationship_product_key UNIQUE (product_id, ori, relationship_type, source_label, geography_vintage, effective_start)
    index agency_geography_relationship_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agency_geography_relationship_pkey ON silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship USING btree (relationship_sk)
    index fbi_agency_relationship_geo_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_agency_relationship_geo_idx ON silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship USING btree (relationship_type, geo_id) WHERE (resolution_status = 'resolved'::text)
    index fbi_agency_relationship_product_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fbi_agency_relationship_product_key ON silver_fbi.agency_geography_relationship USING btree (product_id, ori, relationship_type, source_label, geography_vintage, effective_start)

r silver_fbi.agency_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column release_key text NOT NULL
    column ori text NOT NULL
    column agency_name text NOT NULL
    column agency_type text NOT NULL
    column state_code text NOT NULL
    column state_name text
    column county_labels text[] NOT NULL
    column is_nibrs boolean
    column nibrs_start_date text
    column latitude double precision
    column longitude double precision
    column source_record jsonb NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint agency_revision_agency_name_check CHECK ((btrim(agency_name) <> ''::text))
    constraint agency_revision_agency_type_check CHECK ((btrim(agency_type) <> ''::text))
    constraint agency_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint agency_revision_county_labels_check CHECK ((NOT ('NOT SPECIFIED'::text = ANY (county_labels))))
    constraint agency_revision_latitude_check CHECK (((latitude IS NULL) OR ((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::double precision) AND (latitude <= (90)::double precision))))
    constraint agency_revision_longitude_check CHECK (((longitude IS NULL) OR ((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::double precision) AND (longitude <= (180)::double precision))))
    constraint agency_revision_ori_check CHECK ((ori ~ '^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{7}$'::text))
    constraint agency_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index)
    constraint agency_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint agency_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint agency_revision_state_code_check CHECK ((state_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'::text))
    index agency_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agency_revision_pkey ON silver_fbi.agency_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)
    index fbi_agency_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_agency_revision_run_idx ON silver_fbi.agency_revision USING btree (run_id, product_id, release_key)

r silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation
    column observation_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation_observation_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column release_key text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column subject_type text NOT NULL
    column subject_code text NOT NULL
    column subject_label text NOT NULL
    column source_geo_level text NOT NULL
    column period text NOT NULL
    column period_start date NOT NULL
    column period_end date NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column population_denominator numeric
    column source_run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column transformation_version text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_crime_observation_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'reported'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_crime_observation_check1 CHECK (((value_status <> 'not_reported'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint fact_crime_observation_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['provider_geo_exact'::text, 'agency_only'::text, 'agency_county_bridged'::text, 'agency_place_bridged'::text, 'agency_county_unresolved'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unsupported'::text])))
    constraint fact_crime_observation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (observation_sk)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_product_id_measure_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (product_id, measure_id) REFERENCES silver_fbi.dim_offense_measure(product_id, measure_id)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_product_id_release_key_fkey FOREIGN KEY (product_id, release_key) REFERENCES silver_fbi.dim_ucr_dataset_release(product_id, release_key)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_product_id_release_key_source_record_key UNIQUE (product_id, release_key, source_record_id)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_product_id_release_key_subject_type_fkey FOREIGN KEY (product_id, release_key, subject_type, subject_code, period) REFERENCES silver_fbi.fact_reporting_participation(product_id, release_key, subject_type, subject_code, period)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint fact_crime_observation_source_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_crime_observation_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['reported'::text, 'not_reported'::text])))
    index fact_crime_observation_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_crime_observation_pkey ON silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation USING btree (observation_sk)
    index fact_crime_observation_product_id_release_key_source_record_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_crime_observation_product_id_release_key_source_record_key ON silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation USING btree (product_id, release_key, source_record_id)
    index fbi_fact_capture_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_fact_capture_idx ON silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)
    index fbi_fact_measure_subject_period_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_fact_measure_subject_period_idx ON silver_fbi.fact_crime_observation USING btree (product_id, measure_id, subject_type, subject_code, period)

r silver_fbi.observation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column release_key text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column source_record jsonb NOT NULL
    column ucr_program text NOT NULL
    column offense_code text NOT NULL
    column offense_label text NOT NULL
    column measure_id text NOT NULL
    column measure_form text NOT NULL
    column counted_entity_basis text NOT NULL
    column unit text NOT NULL
    column reported_status text NOT NULL
    column subject_type text NOT NULL
    column subject_code text NOT NULL
    column subject_label text NOT NULL
    column source_geo_level text NOT NULL
    column period text NOT NULL
    column period_start date NOT NULL
    column period_end date NOT NULL
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column population_denominator numeric
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_check CHECK ((period_end >= period_start))
    constraint observation_revision_check1 CHECK (((value_status <> 'reported'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_check2 CHECK (((value_status <> 'not_reported'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_counted_entity_basis_check CHECK ((counted_entity_basis = ANY (ARRAY['offense'::text, 'clearance'::text, 'arrest'::text, 'incident'::text, 'victim'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_measure_form_check CHECK ((measure_form = ANY (ARRAY['absolute_total'::text, 'rate'::text, 'percentage'::text, 'trend'::text, 'category_count'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_period_check CHECK ((period ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-[0-9]{4}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index)
    constraint observation_revision_population_denominator_check CHECK (((population_denominator IS NULL) OR (population_denominator >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint observation_revision_reported_status_check CHECK ((reported_status = ANY (ARRAY['reported'::text, 'estimated'::text, 'mixed'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint observation_revision_subject_type_check CHECK ((subject_type = ANY (ARRAY['national'::text, 'state'::text, 'agency'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['reported'::text, 'not_reported'::text])))
    index fbi_observation_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_observation_revision_run_idx ON silver_fbi.observation_revision USING btree (run_id, product_id, release_key)
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_fbi.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)

r silver_fbi.participation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product_id text NOT NULL
    column release_key text NOT NULL
    column ucr_program text NOT NULL
    column subject_type text NOT NULL
    column subject_code text NOT NULL
    column subject_label text NOT NULL
    column source_geo_level text NOT NULL
    column period text NOT NULL
    column period_start date NOT NULL
    column period_end date NOT NULL
    column population numeric
    column participated_population numeric
    column coverage_percent numeric
    column coverage_basis text NOT NULL
    column participation_status text NOT NULL
    column source_record jsonb NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint participation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint participation_revision_check CHECK ((period_end >= period_start))
    constraint participation_revision_check1 CHECK (((population IS NULL) OR (participated_population IS NULL) OR (participated_population <= population)))
    constraint participation_revision_coverage_basis_check CHECK ((coverage_basis = ANY (ARRAY['provider_population_coverage_percent'::text, 'provider_population_only'::text])))
    constraint participation_revision_coverage_percent_check CHECK (((coverage_percent IS NULL) OR ((coverage_percent >= (0)::numeric) AND (coverage_percent <= (100)::numeric))))
    constraint participation_revision_participated_population_check CHECK (((participated_population IS NULL) OR (participated_population >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint participation_revision_participation_status_check CHECK ((participation_status = ANY (ARRAY['full_participation'::text, 'partial_participation'::text, 'no_participation'::text, 'unknown'::text])))
    constraint participation_revision_period_check CHECK ((period ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-[0-9]{4}$'::text))
    constraint participation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index)
    constraint participation_revision_population_check CHECK (((population IS NULL) OR (population >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint participation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint participation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint participation_revision_subject_type_check CHECK ((subject_type = ANY (ARRAY['national'::text, 'state'::text, 'agency'::text])))
    index fbi_participation_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX fbi_participation_revision_run_idx ON silver_fbi.participation_revision USING btree (run_id, product_id, release_key)
    index participation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX participation_revision_pkey ON silver_fbi.participation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)

    column place_geo_id text NOT NULL
    column place_name text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text NOT NULL
    column place_fips text NOT NULL

    column evidence_url text NOT NULL
    column review_note text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_check CHECK (((effective_end IS NULL) OR (effective_end >= effective_start)))
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_check1 CHECK ((place_geo_id = ((('state:'::text || state_fips) || '|place:'::text) || place_fips)))
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_ori_check CHECK ((ori ~ '^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{7}$'::text))
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_pkey PRIMARY KEY (ori, place_geo_id, effective_start)
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_place_fips_check CHECK ((place_fips ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'::text))
    constraint reviewed_place_crosswalk_state_fips_check CHECK ((state_fips ~ '^[0-9]{2}$'::text))
    index reviewed_place_crosswalk_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reviewed_place_crosswalk_pkey ON silver_fbi.reviewed_place_crosswalk USING btree (ori, place_geo_id, effective_start)

r silver_fcc_bdc.availability_row
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column technology text NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column geography_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column total_units integer NOT NULL
    column speed_02_02 numeric
    column speed_10_1 numeric
    column speed_25_3 numeric
    column speed_100_20 numeric
    column speed_250_25 numeric
    column speed_1000_100 numeric
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column missing_reason text
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint availability_row_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint availability_row_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text])))
    constraint availability_row_geography_type_check CHECK ((geography_type = ANY (ARRAY['nation'::text, 'state'::text, 'county'::text, 'place'::text])))
    constraint availability_row_missing_reason_check CHECK (((missing_reason IS NULL) OR (missing_reason = ANY (ARRAY['no_units'::text, 'blank'::text]))))
    constraint availability_row_pkey PRIMARY KEY (run_id, geo_id, technology)
    constraint availability_row_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.fcc_bdc_read(run_id)
    constraint availability_row_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint availability_row_technology_check CHECK ((technology = ANY (ARRAY['Any Technology'::text, 'Any Terrestrial'::text, 'All Wired'::text])))
    constraint availability_row_total_units_check CHECK ((total_units >= 0))
    constraint availability_row_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    constraint fcc_bdc_row_no_units_no_shares CHECK (((missing_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_units'::text) OR ((total_units = 0) AND (speed_02_02 IS NULL) AND (speed_10_1 IS NULL) AND (speed_25_3 IS NULL) AND (speed_100_20 IS NULL) AND (speed_250_25 IS NULL) AND (speed_1000_100 IS NULL))))
    constraint fcc_bdc_row_shares_in_range CHECK ((((COALESCE(speed_02_02, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(speed_02_02, (0)::numeric) <= (1)::numeric)) AND ((COALESCE(speed_10_1, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(speed_10_1, (0)::numeric) <= (1)::numeric)) AND ((COALESCE(speed_25_3, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(speed_25_3, (0)::numeric) <= (1)::numeric)) AND ((COALESCE(speed_100_20, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(speed_100_20, (0)::numeric) <= (1)::numeric)) AND ((COALESCE(speed_250_25, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(speed_250_25, (0)::numeric) <= (1)::numeric)) AND ((COALESCE(speed_1000_100, (0)::numeric) >= (0)::numeric) AND (COALESCE(speed_1000_100, (0)::numeric) <= (1)::numeric))))
    constraint fcc_bdc_row_status_reason CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) = (missing_reason IS NULL)))
    constraint fcc_bdc_row_valid_shares_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR ((speed_02_02 IS NOT NULL) AND (speed_10_1 IS NOT NULL) AND (speed_25_3 IS NOT NULL) AND (speed_100_20 IS NOT NULL) AND (speed_250_25 IS NOT NULL) AND (speed_1000_100 IS NOT NULL))))
    constraint fcc_bdc_row_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (speed_100_20 IS NOT NULL)))
    index availability_row_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX availability_row_pkey ON silver_fcc_bdc.availability_row USING btree (run_id, geo_id, technology)
    index fcc_bdc_row_geo_idx CREATE INDEX fcc_bdc_row_geo_idx ON silver_fcc_bdc.availability_row USING btree (geo_id)

r silver_fcc_bdc.quarantine
    column quarantine_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_fcc_bdc.quarantine_quarantine_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column error_code text NOT NULL
    column error_summary text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint quarantine_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_code_key UNIQUE (capture_id, source_row_index, error_code)
    constraint quarantine_pkey PRIMARY KEY (quarantine_sk)
    constraint quarantine_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint quarantine_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    index quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_code_key ON silver_fcc_bdc.quarantine USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, error_code)
    index quarantine_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quarantine_pkey ON silver_fcc_bdc.quarantine USING btree (quarantine_sk)

r silver_fema_nri.declaration_revision
    column declaration_id text NOT NULL
    column revision_hash text NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column record_index integer NOT NULL
    column declaration_string text NOT NULL
    column disaster_number integer NOT NULL
    column declaration_type text NOT NULL
    column declaration_date date NOT NULL
    column incident_type text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text NOT NULL
    column county_fips text NOT NULL
    column place_code text NOT NULL
    column designated_area text NOT NULL
    column last_refresh timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint declaration_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint declaration_revision_county_fips_check CHECK ((county_fips ~ '^[0-9]{3}$'::text))
    constraint declaration_revision_declaration_type_check CHECK ((declaration_type = ANY (ARRAY['DR'::text, 'EM'::text, 'FM'::text])))
    constraint declaration_revision_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text, 'area'::text])))
    constraint declaration_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (declaration_id, revision_hash)
    constraint declaration_revision_record_index_check CHECK ((record_index >= 1))
    constraint declaration_revision_revision_hash_check CHECK ((revision_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'::text))

    constraint declaration_revision_state_fips_check CHECK ((state_fips ~ '^[0-9]{2}$'::text))
    constraint fema_declaration_area_has_no_county CHECK (((county_fips = '000'::text) = (geography_status = 'area'::text)))
    constraint fema_declaration_county_has_geo CHECK (((geography_status = 'area'::text) OR (geo_id IS NOT NULL)))
    index declaration_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX declaration_revision_pkey ON silver_fema_nri.declaration_revision USING btree (declaration_id, revision_hash)

r silver_fhfa_hpi.observation_quarantine
    column quarantine_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_fhfa_hpi.observation_quarantine_quarantine_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column error_code text NOT NULL
    column error_summary text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_quarantine_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key UNIQUE (capture_id, source_row_index, error_code)
    constraint observation_quarantine_pkey PRIMARY KEY (quarantine_sk)
    constraint observation_quarantine_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_quarantine_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    index observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key ON silver_fhfa_hpi.observation_quarantine USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, error_code)
    index observation_quarantine_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_quarantine_pkey ON silver_fhfa_hpi.observation_quarantine USING btree (quarantine_sk)

r silver_fhfa_hpi.observation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column measure text NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column fips_source text NOT NULL
    column fips_code text NOT NULL
    column state_abbr text NOT NULL
    column county_name text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column value numeric(12,2)
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column missing_reason text
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fhfa_hpi_revision_missing_has_reason CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) = (missing_reason IS NULL)))
    constraint fhfa_hpi_revision_missing_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint fhfa_hpi_revision_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_fips_code_check CHECK ((fips_code ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_measure_check CHECK ((measure = ANY (ARRAY['annual_change_pct'::text, 'hpi'::text, 'hpi_base_1990'::text, 'hpi_base_2000'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_missing_reason_check CHECK (((missing_reason IS NULL) OR (missing_reason = ANY (ARRAY['provider_missing'::text, 'base_year_unavailable'::text, 'first_recorded_year'::text, 'prior_year_missing'::text]))))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index, measure)
    constraint observation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'not_applicable'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_year_check CHECK (((year >= 1975) AND (year <= 2100)))
    index fhfa_hpi_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX fhfa_hpi_revision_run_idx ON silver_fhfa_hpi.observation_revision USING btree (run_id)
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_fhfa_hpi.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, measure)

    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL

    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column fips_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL

    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column missing_reason text
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL

    constraint hud_fmr_il_revision_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_fips_code_check CHECK ((fips_code ~ '^[0-9]{10}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_geo_type_check CHECK ((geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['county'::text, 'county_subdivision'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_measure_check CHECK ((measure ~ '^(fmr_[0-4]br|median_family_income|income_limit_(30|50|80)_[1-8]p)$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_missing_reason_check CHECK (((missing_reason IS NULL) OR (missing_reason = 'provider_missing'::text)))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index, measure)
    constraint observation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)

    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text])))
    index hud_fmr_il_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX hud_fmr_il_revision_run_idx ON silver_hud_fmr_il.observation_revision USING btree (run_id)

r silver_irs_migration.fact_flow
    column direction text NOT NULL
    column year_pair text NOT NULL
    column subject_geo_id text NOT NULL
    column counterpart_code text NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column year1 integer NOT NULL
    column year2 integer NOT NULL
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column category text NOT NULL
    column counterpart_label text
    column subject_geo_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column origin_geo_id text
    column origin_geo_sk bigint
    column destination_geo_id text
    column destination_geo_sk bigint
    column returns bigint
    column individuals bigint
    column agi numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_flow_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_flow_destination_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (destination_geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint fact_flow_direction_check CHECK ((direction = ANY (ARRAY['inflow'::text, 'outflow'::text])))
    constraint fact_flow_origin_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (origin_geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint fact_flow_pkey PRIMARY KEY (direction, year_pair, subject_geo_id, counterpart_code, capture_id)
    constraint fact_flow_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_flow_subject_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (subject_geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint fact_flow_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'withheld'::text])))
    constraint irs_flow_category_names_no_county CHECK (((category = ANY (ARRAY['county'::text, 'non_migrants'::text])) OR ((origin_geo_id IS NULL) AND (origin_geo_sk IS NULL) AND (destination_geo_id IS NULL) AND (destination_geo_sk IS NULL))))
    constraint irs_flow_endpoints_resolved CHECK (((category <> ALL (ARRAY['county'::text, 'non_migrants'::text])) OR ((origin_geo_id IS NOT NULL) AND (origin_geo_sk IS NOT NULL) AND (destination_geo_id IS NOT NULL) AND (destination_geo_sk IS NOT NULL))))
    constraint irs_flow_valid_measures_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR ((individuals IS NOT NULL) AND (agi IS NOT NULL))))
    constraint irs_flow_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (returns IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint irs_flow_withheld_value_absent CHECK (((value_status <> 'withheld'::text) OR ((returns IS NULL) AND (individuals IS NULL) AND (agi IS NULL))))
    index fact_flow_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_flow_pkey ON silver_irs_migration.fact_flow USING btree (direction, year_pair, subject_geo_id, counterpart_code, capture_id)
    index irs_fact_flow_run_idx CREATE INDEX irs_fact_flow_run_idx ON silver_irs_migration.fact_flow USING btree (run_id)
    index irs_fact_flow_subject_idx CREATE INDEX irs_fact_flow_subject_idx ON silver_irs_migration.fact_flow USING btree (subject_geo_id, direction, year_pair)

    column unit_desc text NOT NULL
    column freq_desc text NOT NULL

    column additive_behavior_known boolean NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

    constraint dim_statistic_check CHECK ((additive_behavior_known = (additive_behavior <> 'not_established'::text)))
    constraint dim_statistic_pkey PRIMARY KEY (statistic_sk)
    constraint dim_statistic_source_desc_check CHECK ((source_desc = ANY (ARRAY['SURVEY'::text, 'CENSUS'::text])))
    constraint dim_statistic_source_desc_statisticcat_desc_short_desc_unit_key UNIQUE (source_desc, statisticcat_desc, short_desc, unit_desc, freq_desc)
    constraint dim_statistic_statistic_sk_check CHECK ((statistic_sk ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    index dim_statistic_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_statistic_pkey ON silver_nass.dim_statistic USING btree (statistic_sk)
    index dim_statistic_source_desc_statisticcat_desc_short_desc_unit_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_statistic_source_desc_statisticcat_desc_short_desc_unit_key ON silver_nass.dim_statistic USING btree (source_desc, statisticcat_desc, short_desc, unit_desc, freq_desc)

    column product_id text NOT NULL
