    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column source_run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index bigint NOT NULL
    column slice_key text NOT NULL
    column commodity_sk text NOT NULL
    column statistic_sk text NOT NULL
    column domain_sk text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column geo_source_code text NOT NULL
    column agg_level_desc text NOT NULL
    column location_desc text NOT NULL
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column freq_desc text NOT NULL
    column begin_code text NOT NULL
    column end_code text NOT NULL
    column reference_period_desc text NOT NULL
    column week_ending date
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column suppression_code text
    column unit_desc text NOT NULL
    column cv_source text NOT NULL
    column cv_value numeric
    column cv_status text NOT NULL
    column cv_symbol text
    column load_time timestamp without time zone
    column source_desc text NOT NULL
    column transformation_version text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_crop_observation_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_check CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_check1 CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_check2 CHECK (((cv_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (cv_value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_check3 CHECK (((cv_status = 'valid'::text) OR (cv_value IS NULL)))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_check4 CHECK (((geo_type = 'unsupported'::text) = (geo_id IS NULL)))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_commodity_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (commodity_sk) REFERENCES silver_nass.dim_commodity(commodity_sk)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_domain_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (domain_sk) REFERENCES silver_nass.dim_domain(domain_sk)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text, 'unsupported'::text])))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (observation_sk)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_product_id_release_watermark_fkey FOREIGN KEY (product_id, release_watermark) REFERENCES silver_nass.dim_dataset_release(product_id, release_watermark)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_product_id_release_watermark_source_r_key UNIQUE (product_id, release_watermark, source_record_id)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_source_desc_check CHECK ((source_desc = ANY (ARRAY['SURVEY'::text, 'CENSUS'::text])))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_source_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_statistic_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (statistic_sk) REFERENCES silver_nass.dim_statistic(statistic_sk)
    constraint fact_crop_observation_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'withheld'::text, 'insufficient_reports'::text, 'not_applicable'::text, 'not_available'::text, 'below_rounding_unit'::text, 'quality_flagged'::text])))
    constraint fact_crop_observation_year_check CHECK (((year >= 1800) AND (year <= 2200)))
    index fact_crop_observation_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_crop_observation_pkey ON silver_nass.fact_crop_observation USING btree (observation_sk)
    index fact_crop_observation_product_id_release_watermark_source_r_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_crop_observation_product_id_release_watermark_source_r_key ON silver_nass.fact_crop_observation USING btree (product_id, release_watermark, source_record_id)

    constraint observation_revision_check1 CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_check2 CHECK (((cv_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (cv_value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_check3 CHECK (((cv_status = 'valid'::text) OR (cv_value IS NULL)))

    constraint observation_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))

    constraint observation_revision_statistic_sk_check CHECK ((statistic_sk ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'withheld'::text, 'insufficient_reports'::text, 'not_applicable'::text, 'not_available'::text, 'below_rounding_unit'::text, 'quality_flagged'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_year_check CHECK (((year >= 1800) AND (year <= 2200)))

r silver_nces_ccd.school_count
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column ncessch text NOT NULL
    column measure text NOT NULL
    column leaid text NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column operating_state_fips text NOT NULL
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column missing_reason text
    column dms_flag text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint nces_ccd_count_not_negative CHECK (((value IS NULL) OR (value >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint nces_ccd_count_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint nces_ccd_count_withheld_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint school_count_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint school_count_dms_flag_check CHECK ((dms_flag = ANY (ARRAY['Reported'::text, 'Not reported'::text, 'Missing'::text, 'Suppressed'::text])))
    constraint school_count_leaid_check CHECK ((leaid ~ '^[0-9]{7}$'::text))
    constraint school_count_measure_check CHECK ((measure = ANY (ARRAY['student_membership'::text, 'teacher_fte'::text, 'frpl_eligible'::text, 'free_lunch_eligible'::text, 'reduced_price_lunch_eligible'::text, 'direct_certification'::text])))
    constraint school_count_missing_reason_check CHECK (((missing_reason IS NULL) OR (missing_reason = ANY (ARRAY['not_reported'::text, 'missing'::text, 'suppressed'::text]))))
    constraint school_count_ncessch_check CHECK ((ncessch ~ '^[0-9]{12}$'::text))
    constraint school_count_operating_state_fips_check CHECK ((operating_state_fips ~ '^[0-9]{2}$'::text))
    constraint school_count_pkey PRIMARY KEY (run_id, ncessch, measure)
    constraint school_count_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.nces_ccd_file(run_id)
    constraint school_count_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint school_count_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'suppressed'::text])))
    index nces_ccd_count_school_idx CREATE INDEX nces_ccd_count_school_idx ON silver_nces_ccd.school_count USING btree (ncessch, measure)
    index school_count_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX school_count_pkey ON silver_nces_ccd.school_count USING btree (run_id, ncessch, measure)

    constraint school_location_leaid_check CHECK ((leaid ~ '^[0-9]{7}$'::text))
    constraint school_location_ncessch_check CHECK ((ncessch ~ '^[0-9]{12}$'::text))
    constraint school_location_operating_state_fips_check CHECK ((operating_state_fips ~ '^[0-9]{2}$'::text))

    constraint school_location_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.nces_ccd_file(run_id)
    constraint school_location_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint school_location_state_fips_check CHECK ((state_fips ~ '^[0-9]{2}$'::text))
    index nces_ccd_location_school_idx CREATE INDEX nces_ccd_location_school_idx ON silver_nces_ccd.school_location USING btree (ncessch)
    index school_location_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX school_location_pkey ON silver_nces_ccd.school_location USING btree (run_id, ncessch)

r silver_noaa_normals.station
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column station_id text NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column latitude numeric NOT NULL
    column longitude numeric NOT NULL
    column elevation_m numeric
    column station_name text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column boundary_vintage integer
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column geography_reason text
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint noaa_normals_station_reason CHECK (((geography_status = 'resolved'::text) = (geography_reason IS NULL)))
    constraint noaa_normals_station_resolved_has_county CHECK (((geography_status = 'resolved'::text) = ((geo_sk IS NOT NULL) AND (geo_id IS NOT NULL))))
    constraint station_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint station_geography_reason_check CHECK (((geography_reason IS NULL) OR (geography_reason = ANY (ARRAY['outside_counties'::text, 'on_county_boundary'::text, 'no_county_boundaries'::text]))))
    constraint station_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text, 'ambiguous'::text])))
    constraint station_latitude_check CHECK (((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::numeric) AND (latitude <= (90)::numeric)))
    constraint station_longitude_check CHECK (((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::numeric) AND (longitude <= (180)::numeric)))
    constraint station_pkey PRIMARY KEY (run_id, station_id)
    constraint station_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.noaa_normals_file(run_id)
    constraint station_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint station_station_id_check CHECK ((station_id ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{11}$'::text))
    index noaa_normals_station_county_idx CREATE INDEX noaa_normals_station_county_idx ON silver_noaa_normals.station USING btree (geo_id)
    index station_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX station_pkey ON silver_noaa_normals.station USING btree (run_id, station_id)

r silver_noaa_normals.station_normal
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column station_id text NOT NULL
    column variable text NOT NULL
    column measure text NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column missing_reason text
    column measurement_flag text
    column completeness_flag text
    column years integer
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint noaa_normals_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint noaa_normals_withheld_has_reason CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) = (missing_reason IS NULL)))
    constraint noaa_normals_withheld_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint station_normal_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint station_normal_completeness_flag_check CHECK (((completeness_flag IS NULL) OR (completeness_flag = ANY (ARRAY['S'::text, 'R'::text, 'P'::text, 'E'::text]))))
    constraint station_normal_measure_check CHECK ((measure = ANY (ARRAY['annual_mean_temperature'::text, 'annual_mean_maximum_temperature'::text, 'annual_mean_minimum_temperature'::text, 'annual_precipitation'::text, 'annual_heating_degree_days'::text, 'annual_cooling_degree_days'::text])))
    constraint station_normal_measurement_flag_check CHECK (((measurement_flag IS NULL) OR (measurement_flag = ANY (ARRAY['M'::text, 'V'::text, 'X'::text, 'Y'::text, 'Z'::text]))))
    constraint station_normal_missing_reason_check CHECK (((missing_reason IS NULL) OR (missing_reason = ANY (ARRAY['missing'::text, 'too_cold_to_compute'::text, 'insufficient_values'::text, 'blank'::text]))))
    constraint station_normal_pkey PRIMARY KEY (run_id, station_id, variable)
    constraint station_normal_run_id_station_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id, station_id) REFERENCES silver_noaa_normals.station(run_id, station_id)
    constraint station_normal_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'::text))
    constraint station_normal_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'not_applicable'::text])))
    constraint station_normal_years_check CHECK (((years IS NULL) OR ((years >= 0) AND (years <= 30))))
    index noaa_normals_station_normal_measure_idx CREATE INDEX noaa_normals_station_normal_measure_idx ON silver_noaa_normals.station_normal USING btree (run_id, measure)
    index station_normal_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX station_normal_pkey ON silver_noaa_normals.station_normal USING btree (run_id, station_id, variable)

r silver_pep.fact_population_estimate
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column source_column_index integer NOT NULL
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column release_vintage smallint NOT NULL
    column product_code text NOT NULL
    column metric_code text NOT NULL
    column observation_year smallint NOT NULL
    column estimate_date date NOT NULL
    column geo_id text
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_basis_date date NOT NULL
    column resolution_status text NOT NULL
    column summary_level text NOT NULL
    column source_geo_code text NOT NULL
    column source_name text
    column functional_status_source text
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column value numeric NOT NULL
    column unit text NOT NULL
    column transformed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_population_estimate_capture_id_source_row_index_sourc_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id, source_row_index, source_column_index) REFERENCES silver_pep.observation_revision(capture_id, source_row_index, source_column_index)
    constraint fact_population_estimate_check CHECK ((observation_year <= release_vintage))
    constraint fact_population_estimate_check2 CHECK ((((resolution_status = 'resolved'::text) AND (geo_id IS NOT NULL) AND (geo_sk IS NOT NULL)) OR ((resolution_status <> 'resolved'::text) AND (geo_sk IS NULL))))
    constraint fact_population_estimate_date_check CHECK ((estimate_date = make_date((observation_year)::integer,
CASE
    WHEN (metric_code = 'CENSUSPOP'::text) THEN 4
    ELSE 7
END, 1)))
    constraint fact_population_estimate_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint fact_population_estimate_metric_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (metric_code) REFERENCES silver_pep.dim_measure(metric_code)
    constraint fact_population_estimate_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index, source_column_index)
    constraint fact_population_estimate_resolution_status_check CHECK ((resolution_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text, 'unsupported'::text])))
    constraint fact_population_estimate_stock_sign_check CHECK (((metric_code <> ALL (ARRAY['ESTIMATESBASE'::text, 'POPESTIMATE'::text, 'CENSUSPOP'::text])) OR (value >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint fact_population_estimate_unit_check CHECK ((unit = ANY (ARRAY['persons'::text, 'per_1000_population'::text])))
    index fact_population_estimate_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_population_estimate_pkey ON silver_pep.fact_population_estimate USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, source_column_index)
    index pep_fact_natural_key_idx CREATE INDEX pep_fact_natural_key_idx ON silver_pep.fact_population_estimate USING btree (dataset_code, release_vintage, metric_code, geo_id, observation_year)

r silver_pep.observation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column source_column_index integer NOT NULL
    column source_header text NOT NULL
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column release_vintage smallint NOT NULL
    column product_code text NOT NULL
    column observation_year smallint NOT NULL
    column metric_code text NOT NULL
    column unit text NOT NULL
    column summary_level text NOT NULL
    column region_code_source text
    column division_code_source text
    column state_fips_source text
    column county_fips_source text
    column place_fips_source text
    column county_subdivision_source text
    column consolidated_city_source text
    column functional_status_source text
    column name_source text
    column state_name_source text
    column value_source text
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column parser_version text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'census-pep-bulk-csv-v1'::text
    column parsed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_check1 CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_check2 CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint observation_revision_dataset_code_release_vintage_product__fkey FOREIGN KEY (dataset_code, release_vintage, product_code) REFERENCES silver_pep.pep_release(dataset_code, vintage_year, product_code)
    constraint observation_revision_observation_year_check CHECK (((observation_year >= 1900) AND (observation_year <= release_vintage)))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index, source_column_index)
    constraint observation_revision_source_column_index_check CHECK ((source_column_index >= 0))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    constraint observation_revision_unit_check CHECK ((unit = ANY (ARRAY['persons'::text, 'per_1000_population'::text])))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'blank'::text, 'sentinel'::text, 'invalid'::text])))
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_pep.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, source_column_index)
    index pep_observation_revision_geography_idx CREATE INDEX pep_observation_revision_geography_idx ON silver_pep.observation_revision USING btree (summary_level, state_fips_source, county_fips_source, place_fips_source)
    index pep_observation_revision_release_idx CREATE INDEX pep_observation_revision_release_idx ON silver_pep.observation_revision USING btree (dataset_code, release_vintage, observation_year, metric_code)

r silver_pep.pep_dataset
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column title text NOT NULL
    column transport text NOT NULL
    column geography_levels text[] NOT NULL
    column summary_levels text[] NOT NULL
    column variable_families text[] NOT NULL
    column parser_version text NOT NULL
    column text_encoding text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'utf-8-sig'::text
    column release_page_url text NOT NULL
    column decennial_base smallint NOT NULL
    column is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column series_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'postcensal'::text
    column era text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
    column native_grain text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
    column derivation text
    column archive_member text
    constraint pep_dataset_geography_levels_check CHECK ((cardinality(geography_levels) > 0))
    constraint pep_dataset_pkey PRIMARY KEY (dataset_code)
    constraint pep_dataset_release_page_url_check CHECK ((release_page_url ~~ 'https://www.census.gov/%'::text))
    constraint pep_dataset_series_kind_check CHECK ((series_kind = ANY (ARRAY['postcensal'::text, 'intercensal'::text])))
    constraint pep_dataset_summary_levels_check CHECK ((cardinality(summary_levels) > 0))
    constraint pep_dataset_transport_check CHECK ((transport = ANY (ARRAY['bulk_csv'::text, 'bulk_text'::text, 'bulk_zip'::text])))
    constraint pep_dataset_variable_families_check CHECK ((cardinality(variable_families) > 0))
    index pep_dataset_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pep_dataset_pkey ON silver_pep.pep_dataset USING btree (dataset_code)

r silver_pep.pep_release
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column vintage_year smallint NOT NULL
    column product_code text NOT NULL
    column data_url text NOT NULL
    column layout_url text NOT NULL
    column release_date date NOT NULL
    column observation_start_year smallint NOT NULL
    column observation_end_year smallint NOT NULL
    column geography_basis_date date NOT NULL
    column schema_version text NOT NULL
    column status text NOT NULL
    column media_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text/csv'::text
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column series_kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'postcensal'::text
    column archive_member text
    constraint pep_release_check CHECK ((observation_start_year <= observation_end_year))
    constraint pep_release_data_url_check CHECK ((data_url ~~ 'https://www2.census.gov/%'::text))
    constraint pep_release_dataset_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (dataset_code) REFERENCES silver_pep.pep_dataset(dataset_code)
    constraint pep_release_dataset_code_vintage_year_product_code_key UNIQUE (dataset_code, vintage_year, product_code)
    constraint pep_release_layout_url_check CHECK ((layout_url ~~ 'https://www2.census.gov/%'::text))
    constraint pep_release_media_type_check CHECK ((media_type = ANY (ARRAY['text/csv'::text, 'text/plain'::text, 'application/zip'::text])))
    constraint pep_release_observation_range_check CHECK (((observation_end_year <= vintage_year) AND ((series_kind <> 'postcensal'::text) OR (observation_end_year = vintage_year))))
    constraint pep_release_pkey PRIMARY KEY (dataset_code, vintage_year)
    constraint pep_release_product_code_key UNIQUE (product_code)
    constraint pep_release_series_kind_check CHECK ((series_kind = ANY (ARRAY['postcensal'::text, 'intercensal'::text])))
    constraint pep_release_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['published'::text, 'archived'::text])))
    index pep_release_dataset_code_vintage_year_product_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pep_release_dataset_code_vintage_year_product_code_key ON silver_pep.pep_release USING btree (dataset_code, vintage_year, product_code)
    index pep_release_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pep_release_pkey ON silver_pep.pep_release USING btree (dataset_code, vintage_year)
    index pep_release_product_code_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pep_release_product_code_key ON silver_pep.pep_release USING btree (product_code)

r silver_pep.release_load
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column dataset_code text NOT NULL
    column release_vintage smallint NOT NULL
    column product_code text NOT NULL
    column source_record_count integer NOT NULL
    column observation_count integer NOT NULL
    column completeness_status text NOT NULL
    column completeness_reason text
    column validated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint release_load_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint release_load_check CHECK ((((completeness_status = 'complete'::text) AND (completeness_reason IS NULL)) OR ((completeness_status = 'incomplete'::text) AND (completeness_reason IS NOT NULL))))
    constraint release_load_completeness_status_check CHECK ((completeness_status = ANY (ARRAY['complete'::text, 'incomplete'::text])))
    constraint release_load_dataset_code_release_vintage_product_code_fkey FOREIGN KEY (dataset_code, release_vintage, product_code) REFERENCES silver_pep.pep_release(dataset_code, vintage_year, product_code)
    constraint release_load_observation_count_check CHECK ((observation_count > 0))
    constraint release_load_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id)
    constraint release_load_source_record_count_check CHECK ((source_record_count > 0))
    index release_load_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX release_load_pkey ON silver_pep.release_load USING btree (capture_id)

r silver_ref.bridge_geo_relationship_version
    column relationship_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_ref.bridge_geo_relationship_version_relationship_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column parent_geo_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column related_geo_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column relationship_type text NOT NULL
    column geography_vintage integer NOT NULL
    column overlap_area_m2 numeric
    column overlap_weight numeric
    column evidence_source text NOT NULL
    column source_snapshot_id uuid NOT NULL
    column ingested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint bridge_geo_relationship_versi_parent_geo_sk_related_geo_sk__key UNIQUE (parent_geo_sk, related_geo_sk, relationship_type, geography_vintage)
    constraint bridge_geo_relationship_version_check CHECK ((parent_geo_sk <> related_geo_sk))
    constraint bridge_geo_relationship_version_overlap_area_m2_check CHECK (((overlap_area_m2 IS NULL) OR (overlap_area_m2 >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint bridge_geo_relationship_version_overlap_weight_check CHECK (((overlap_weight IS NULL) OR ((overlap_weight >= (0)::numeric) AND (overlap_weight <= (1)::numeric))))
    constraint bridge_geo_relationship_version_parent_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (parent_geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint bridge_geo_relationship_version_pkey PRIMARY KEY (relationship_sk)
    constraint bridge_geo_relationship_version_related_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (related_geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint bridge_geo_relationship_version_relationship_type_check CHECK ((relationship_type = ANY (ARRAY['contains'::text, 'intersects'::text, 'adjacent'::text, 'serves'::text, 'provider_crosswalk'::text])))
    constraint bridge_geo_relationship_version_source_snapshot_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    index bridge_geo_relationship_versi_parent_geo_sk_related_geo_sk__key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bridge_geo_relationship_versi_parent_geo_sk_related_geo_sk__key ON silver_ref.bridge_geo_relationship_version USING btree (parent_geo_sk, related_geo_sk, relationship_type, geography_vintage)
    index bridge_geo_relationship_version_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bridge_geo_relationship_version_pkey ON silver_ref.bridge_geo_relationship_version USING btree (relationship_sk)

v silver_ref.dim_geo
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_id text
    column census_geoid text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column name text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column latitude double precision
    column longitude double precision
    column geom geometry(MultiPolygon,4326)
    column is_active boolean
    column source text
    column source_year integer
    column first_seen_year integer
    column last_seen_year integer
    column source_snapshot_id uuid
    column boundary_vintage integer
    column ingested_at timestamp with time zone
    column tract_code text
    column zcta_code text
    column area_name text
    body SELECT geo_sk,
    body     geo_type,
    body     geo_level,
    body     geo_id,
    body     census_geoid,
    body     state_fips,
    body     county_fips,
    body     place_fips,
    body     name,
    body     state_name,
    body     county_name,
    body     place_name,
    body     latitude,
    body     longitude,
    body     geom,
    body     is_active,
    body     source,
    body     source_year,
    body     first_seen_year,
    body     last_seen_year,
    body     source_snapshot_id,
    body     boundary_vintage,
    body     ingested_at,
    body     tract_code,
    body     zcta_code,
    body     area_name
    body    FROM silver_ref.dim_geo_current;

v silver_ref.dim_geo_current
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geo_type text
    column geo_level text
    column geo_id text
    column census_geoid text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column name text
    column state_name text
    column county_name text
    column place_name text
    column latitude double precision
    column longitude double precision
    column geom geometry(MultiPolygon,4326)
    column is_active boolean
    column source text
    column source_year integer
    column first_seen_year integer
    column last_seen_year integer
    column source_snapshot_id uuid
    column boundary_vintage integer
    column ingested_at timestamp with time zone
    column tract_code text
    column zcta_code text
    column area_name text
    body WITH attribute_choice AS (
    body          SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.geo_sk) v.geo_version_sk,
    body             v.geo_sk,
    body             v.geography_vintage,
    body             v.source_snapshot_id,
    body             v.geoidfq,
    body             v.name,
    body             v.usps,
    body             v.lsad,
    body             v.functional_status,
    body             v.legal_statistical_class,
    body             v.land_area_m2,
    body             v.water_area_m2,
    body             v.latitude,
    body             v.longitude,
    body             v.is_active,
    body             v.attribute_checksum,
    body             v.ingested_at
    body            FROM silver_ref.dim_geo_entity_version v
    body           ORDER BY v.geo_sk, v.geography_vintage DESC, v.ingested_at DESC, v.geo_version_sk DESC
    body         ), geometry_choice AS (
    body          SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.geo_sk) v.geo_geometry_sk,
    body             v.geo_sk,
    body             v.boundary_vintage,
    body             v.geometry_source,
    body             v.resolution,
    body             v.source_snapshot_id,
    body             v.geom,
    body             v.geometry_checksum,
    body             v.is_valid,
    body             v.ingested_at
    body            FROM silver_ref.dim_geo_geometry_version v
    body           WHERE v.is_valid
    body           ORDER BY v.geo_sk, v.boundary_vintage DESC, v.ingested_at DESC, v.geo_geometry_sk DESC
    body         )
    body  SELECT entity.geo_sk,
    body     entity.geo_type,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN entity.geo_type = 'nation'::text THEN 'us'::text
    body             ELSE entity.geo_type
    body         END AS geo_level,
    body     entity.geo_id,
    body     entity.census_geoid,
    body     entity.state_fips,
    body     entity.county_fips,
    body     entity.place_fips,
    body     attribute.name,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN entity.geo_type = 'state'::text THEN attribute.name
    body             ELSE state_attribute.name
    body         END AS state_name,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN entity.geo_type = 'county'::text THEN attribute.name
    body             WHEN entity.geo_type = 'tract'::text THEN county_attribute.name
    body             ELSE NULL::text
    body         END AS county_name,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN entity.geo_type = 'place'::text THEN attribute.name
    body             ELSE NULL::text
    body         END AS place_name,
    body     attribute.latitude,
    body     attribute.longitude,
    body     geometry.geom,
    body     attribute.is_active,
    body     'census_geography_reference'::text AS source,
    body     attribute.geography_vintage AS source_year,
    body     entity.first_seen_version AS first_seen_year,
    body     entity.last_seen_version AS last_seen_year,
    body     attribute.source_snapshot_id,
    body     geometry.boundary_vintage,
    body     attribute.ingested_at,
    body     entity.tract_code,
    body     entity.zcta_code,
    body         CASE
    body             WHEN entity.geo_type = ANY (ARRAY['tract'::text, 'zcta'::text]) THEN attribute.name
    body             ELSE NULL::text
    body         END AS area_name
    body    FROM silver_ref.dim_geo_entity entity
    body      JOIN attribute_choice attribute USING (geo_sk)
    body      LEFT JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_entity state_entity ON state_entity.geo_type = 'state'::text AND state_entity.state_fips = entity.state_fips
    body      LEFT JOIN attribute_choice state_attribute ON state_attribute.geo_sk = state_entity.geo_sk
    body      LEFT JOIN silver_ref.dim_geo_entity county_entity ON entity.geo_type = 'tract'::text AND county_entity.geo_type = 'county'::text AND county_entity.state_fips = entity.state_fips AND county_entity.county_fips = entity.county_fips
    body      LEFT JOIN attribute_choice county_attribute ON county_attribute.geo_sk = county_entity.geo_sk
    body      LEFT JOIN geometry_choice geometry ON geometry.geo_sk = entity.geo_sk;

r silver_ref.dim_geo_entity
    column geo_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_ref.dim_geo_entity_geo_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column census_geoid text
    column state_fips text
    column county_fips text
    column place_fips text
    column tract_code text
    column zcta_code text
    column area_code text
    column provider_agency_code text
    column first_seen_version integer NOT NULL
    column last_seen_version integer NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    column updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_geo_entity_check CHECK ((last_seen_version >= first_seen_version))
    constraint dim_geo_entity_check1 CHECK ((((geo_type = 'nation'::text) AND (geo_id = 'us:1'::text) AND (state_fips IS NULL)) OR ((geo_type = 'state'::text) AND (geo_id = ('state:'::text || state_fips))) OR ((geo_type = 'county'::text) AND (geo_id = ((('state:'::text || state_fips) || '|county:'::text) || county_fips))) OR ((geo_type = 'place'::text) AND (geo_id = ((('state:'::text || state_fips) || '|place:'::text) || place_fips))) OR ((geo_type = 'tract'::text) AND (county_fips IS NOT NULL) AND (tract_code IS NOT NULL) AND (geo_id = ((((('state:'::text || state_fips) || '|county:'::text) || county_fips) || '|tract:'::text) || tract_code))) OR ((geo_type = 'zcta'::text) AND (state_fips IS NULL) AND (zcta_code IS NOT NULL) AND (geo_id = ('zcta:'::text || zcta_code))) OR ((geo_type = 'census_region'::text) AND (state_fips IS NULL) AND (area_code ~ '^[1-4]$'::text) AND (geo_id = ('region:'::text || area_code))) OR ((geo_type = 'census_division'::text) AND (state_fips IS NULL) AND (area_code ~ '^[1-9]$'::text) AND (geo_id = ('division:'::text || area_code))) OR ((geo_type = 'metro'::text) AND (state_fips IS NULL) AND (area_code ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'::text) AND (geo_id = ('cbsa:'::text || area_code))) OR ((geo_type = 'provider_area'::text) AND (state_fips IS NULL) AND (area_code ~ '^[a-z_]+:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'::text) AND (geo_id = ('area:'::text || area_code))) OR ((geo_type = 'agency'::text) AND (provider_agency_code IS NOT NULL))))
    constraint dim_geo_entity_county_fips_check CHECK (((county_fips IS NULL) OR (county_fips ~ '^[0-9]{3}$'::text)))
    constraint dim_geo_entity_geo_id_key UNIQUE (geo_id)
    constraint dim_geo_entity_geo_type_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_type) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_type(geo_type)
    constraint dim_geo_entity_pkey PRIMARY KEY (geo_sk)
    constraint dim_geo_entity_place_fips_check CHECK (((place_fips IS NULL) OR (place_fips ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'::text)))
    constraint dim_geo_entity_state_fips_check CHECK (((state_fips IS NULL) OR (state_fips ~ '^[0-9]{2}$'::text)))
    constraint dim_geo_entity_tract_code_check CHECK (((tract_code IS NULL) OR (tract_code ~ '^[0-9]{6}$'::text)))
    constraint dim_geo_entity_zcta_code_check CHECK (((zcta_code IS NULL) OR (zcta_code ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'::text)))
    index dim_geo_entity_geo_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_geo_entity_geo_id_key ON silver_ref.dim_geo_entity USING btree (geo_id)
    index dim_geo_entity_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_geo_entity_pkey ON silver_ref.dim_geo_entity USING btree (geo_sk)

r silver_ref.dim_geo_entity_version
    column geo_version_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_ref.dim_geo_entity_version_geo_version_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column geo_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column geography_vintage integer NOT NULL
    column source_snapshot_id uuid NOT NULL
    column geoidfq text
    column name text NOT NULL
    column usps text
    column lsad text
    column functional_status text
    column legal_statistical_class text
    column land_area_m2 numeric
    column water_area_m2 numeric
    column latitude double precision
    column longitude double precision
    column is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
    column attribute_checksum text NOT NULL
    column ingested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_geo_entity_version_attribute_checksum_check CHECK ((attribute_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint dim_geo_entity_version_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint dim_geo_entity_version_geo_sk_geography_vintage_attribute_c_key UNIQUE (geo_sk, geography_vintage, attribute_checksum)
    constraint dim_geo_entity_version_land_area_m2_check CHECK (((land_area_m2 IS NULL) OR (land_area_m2 >= (0)::numeric)))
    constraint dim_geo_entity_version_latitude_check CHECK (((latitude IS NULL) OR ((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::double precision) AND (latitude <= (90)::double precision))))
    constraint dim_geo_entity_version_longitude_check CHECK (((longitude IS NULL) OR ((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::double precision) AND (longitude <= (180)::double precision))))
    constraint dim_geo_entity_version_pkey PRIMARY KEY (geo_version_sk)
    constraint dim_geo_entity_version_source_snapshot_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint dim_geo_entity_version_water_area_m2_check CHECK (((water_area_m2 IS NULL) OR (water_area_m2 >= (0)::numeric)))
    index dim_geo_entity_version_current_idx CREATE INDEX dim_geo_entity_version_current_idx ON silver_ref.dim_geo_entity_version USING btree (geo_sk, geography_vintage DESC, ingested_at DESC)
    index dim_geo_entity_version_geo_sk_geography_vintage_attribute_c_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_geo_entity_version_geo_sk_geography_vintage_attribute_c_key ON silver_ref.dim_geo_entity_version USING btree (geo_sk, geography_vintage, attribute_checksum)
    index dim_geo_entity_version_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_geo_entity_version_pkey ON silver_ref.dim_geo_entity_version USING btree (geo_version_sk)

r silver_ref.dim_geo_geometry_version
    column geo_geometry_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_ref.dim_geo_geometry_version_geo_geometry_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column geo_sk bigint NOT NULL
    column boundary_vintage integer NOT NULL
    column geometry_source text NOT NULL
    column resolution text NOT NULL
    column source_snapshot_id uuid NOT NULL
    column geom geometry(MultiPolygon,4326) NOT NULL
    column geometry_checksum text NOT NULL
    column is_valid boolean NOT NULL
    column ingested_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint dim_geo_geometry_version_geo_sk_boundary_vintage_geometry_s_key UNIQUE (geo_sk, boundary_vintage, geometry_source, resolution, geometry_checksum)
    constraint dim_geo_geometry_version_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint dim_geo_geometry_version_geom_check CHECK ((st_srid(geom) = 4326))
    constraint dim_geo_geometry_version_geom_check1 CHECK ((NOT st_isempty(geom)))
    constraint dim_geo_geometry_version_geometry_checksum_check CHECK ((geometry_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint dim_geo_geometry_version_pkey PRIMARY KEY (geo_geometry_sk)
    constraint dim_geo_geometry_version_source_snapshot_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_snapshot_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    index dim_geo_geometry_version_geo_sk_boundary_vintage_geometry_s_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_geo_geometry_version_geo_sk_boundary_vintage_geometry_s_key ON silver_ref.dim_geo_geometry_version USING btree (geo_sk, boundary_vintage, geometry_source, resolution, geometry_checksum)
    index dim_geo_geometry_version_geom_idx CREATE INDEX dim_geo_geometry_version_geom_idx ON silver_ref.dim_geo_geometry_version USING gist (geom)
    index dim_geo_geometry_version_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_geo_geometry_version_pkey ON silver_ref.dim_geo_geometry_version USING btree (geo_geometry_sk)

    column geo_type text NOT NULL
    column display_label text NOT NULL
    column canonical_code_length integer
    column is_census_geography boolean NOT NULL
    column product_rank integer NOT NULL
    constraint dim_geo_type_canonical_code_length_check CHECK (((canonical_code_length IS NULL) OR (canonical_code_length > 0)))
    constraint dim_geo_type_pkey PRIMARY KEY (geo_type)
    constraint dim_geo_type_product_rank_check CHECK ((product_rank >= 0))
    index dim_geo_type_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dim_geo_type_pkey ON silver_ref.dim_geo_type USING btree (geo_type)

r silver_ref.geography_resolution
    column resolution_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_ref.geography_resolution_resolution_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column provider_source text NOT NULL
    column provider_dataset text NOT NULL
    column source_geo_type text NOT NULL
    column source_code text NOT NULL
    column source_label text
    column source_vintage integer NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint
    column resolution_method text
    column evidence_capture_id uuid
    column status text NOT NULL
    column reason_code text
    column resolved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint geography_resolution_evidence_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (evidence_capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint geography_resolution_geo_sk_fkey FOREIGN KEY (geo_sk) REFERENCES silver_ref.dim_geo_entity(geo_sk)
    constraint geography_resolution_pkey PRIMARY KEY (resolution_sk)
    constraint geography_resolution_provider_source_provider_dataset_sourc_key UNIQUE (provider_source, provider_dataset, source_geo_type, source_code, source_vintage)
    constraint geography_resolution_resolution_method_check CHECK (((resolution_method IS NULL) OR (resolution_method = ANY (ARRAY['exact_code'::text, 'provider_crosswalk'::text, 'effective_dated_bridge'::text]))))
    constraint geography_resolution_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'unmapped'::text, 'unsupported'::text])))
    index geography_resolution_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX geography_resolution_pkey ON silver_ref.geography_resolution USING btree (resolution_sk)
    index geography_resolution_provider_source_provider_dataset_sourc_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX geography_resolution_provider_source_provider_dataset_sourc_key ON silver_ref.geography_resolution USING btree (provider_source, provider_dataset, source_geo_type, source_code, source_vintage)

r silver_usda_ers.fact_observation
    column attribute text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column product text NOT NULL
    column edition text NOT NULL
    column measure text
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column retrieved_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
    column fips_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_sk bigint
    column geography_status text NOT NULL
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column missing_reason text
    column code_label text
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint fact_observation_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint fact_observation_geography_status_check CHECK ((geography_status = ANY (ARRAY['resolved'::text, 'unmapped'::text])))
    constraint fact_observation_pkey PRIMARY KEY (attribute, geo_id, capture_id)
    constraint fact_observation_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint fact_observation_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'not_applicable'::text])))
    constraint usda_ers_fact_missing_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint usda_ers_fact_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    index fact_observation_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fact_observation_pkey ON silver_usda_ers.fact_observation USING btree (attribute, geo_id, capture_id)
    index usda_ers_fact_lookup_idx CREATE INDEX usda_ers_fact_lookup_idx ON silver_usda_ers.fact_observation USING btree (measure, geo_id, year)
    index usda_ers_fact_run_idx CREATE INDEX usda_ers_fact_run_idx ON silver_usda_ers.fact_observation USING btree (run_id)

r silver_usda_ers.observation_quarantine
    column quarantine_sk bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('silver_usda_ers.observation_quarantine_quarantine_sk_seq'::regclass)
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column error_code text NOT NULL
    column error_summary text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_quarantine_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key UNIQUE (capture_id, source_row_index, error_code)
    constraint observation_quarantine_pkey PRIMARY KEY (quarantine_sk)
    constraint observation_quarantine_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_quarantine_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 0))
    index observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_quarantine_capture_id_source_row_index_error_co_key ON silver_usda_ers.observation_quarantine USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index, error_code)
    index observation_quarantine_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_quarantine_pkey ON silver_usda_ers.observation_quarantine USING btree (quarantine_sk)

r silver_usda_ers.observation_revision
    column capture_id uuid NOT NULL
    column source_row_index integer NOT NULL
    column attribute text NOT NULL
    column run_id uuid NOT NULL
    column measure text
    column year integer NOT NULL
    column fips_code text NOT NULL
    column geo_id text NOT NULL
    column value_source text NOT NULL
    column value numeric
    column value_status text NOT NULL
    column missing_reason text
    column code_label text
    column source_record_id text NOT NULL
    column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    constraint observation_revision_capture_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (capture_id) REFERENCES raw_capture.response_capture(capture_id)
    constraint observation_revision_fips_code_check CHECK ((fips_code ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_missing_reason_check CHECK (((missing_reason IS NULL) OR (missing_reason = ANY (ARRAY['not_available'::text, 'county_did_not_exist'::text, 'incomplete_data'::text, 'blank'::text, 'not_computed_for_geography'::text, 'not_determined'::text]))))
    constraint observation_revision_pkey PRIMARY KEY (capture_id, source_row_index)
    constraint observation_revision_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES control.ingestion_run(run_id)
    constraint observation_revision_source_record_id_check CHECK ((source_record_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text))
    constraint observation_revision_source_row_index_check CHECK ((source_row_index >= 1))
    constraint observation_revision_value_status_check CHECK ((value_status = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'missing'::text, 'not_applicable'::text])))
    constraint usda_ers_revision_missing_has_reason CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) = (missing_reason IS NULL)))
    constraint usda_ers_revision_missing_value_absent CHECK (((value_status = 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NULL)))
    constraint usda_ers_revision_valid_value_present CHECK (((value_status <> 'valid'::text) OR (value IS NOT NULL)))
    index observation_revision_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX observation_revision_pkey ON silver_usda_ers.observation_revision USING btree (capture_id, source_row_index)
    index usda_ers_revision_run_idx CREATE INDEX usda_ers_revision_run_idx ON silver_usda_ers.observation_revision USING btree (run_id)
